articles.title: Researchers Detail iPhone Flaw That Let Apps Record Audio Despite Denied Microphone Permission
articles.text:
A now-patched flaw in Apple's audio service let apps on iPhones and iPads record audio even after the user tapped "Don't Allow" on the microphone prompt.
The first security updates with the fix came out on August 17. Neither Apple nor the two researchers who found the flaw report that it was used in attacks.
Nik Tsytsarkin of Meta Red Team X published the technical details last week. Mustafa Calap, a security engineer who reported the same flaw separately, published his own analysis the same day.
On iPhones, an orange indicator shows when an app is using the microphone. On one of the researchers' earlier test builds, that indicator stayed off while the app recorded.
In Tsytsarkin's tests, the prompt appeared the first time the app opened. Declining it did not stop the recording, and the prompt did not reappear on subsequent launches.
In the earlier build of his technical analysis, the system logs showed no record of the app using the microphone. They named the audio service itself as the recorder.
His demo video shows the indicator while the test app records with no microphone permission. He wrote that the video "was filmed on a later build that appears to have restored the orange microphone indicator."
Calap's test app recorded while its permission still read denied, according to his detailed write-up. No orange indicator appeared in the Dynamic Island or in Control Center. He does not say which of his two test builds that was.
Neither researcher describes a way for users to check whether an app recorded them before the fix. Calap reproduced the bypass on iOS 26.6, released July 27, and on an iPadOS 27 beta.
The bypass needed an app already installed on the device. His two test apps were sandboxed apps with no added entitlements. Their only privacy key was NSMicrophoneUsageDescription, which makes the microphone prompt appear.
In his tests, recording had to start while the app was in the foreground. Once started, it continued after the app went to the background and after the device was locked. The background version also set UIBackgroundModes = audio.
Both apps were installed from Xcode and never went through App Review. So the tests do not show whether App Review would have stopped such an app.
The Meta analysis compared two iOS 27 test builds. Neither researcher reports testing macOS, tvOS, watchOS, or visionOS, though fixes are listed for those systems too.
The bypass covered microphone capture through the audio service only. It did not give the app other privacy permissions.
These releases fix the flaw, which is tracked as CVE-2026-65339:
- iOS 26.6.1 and iPadOS 26.6.1 (August 17), for iPhone 11 and later, iPad Pro 12.9-inch 3rd generation and later, iPad Pro 11-inch 1st generation and later, iPad Air 3rd generation and later, iPad 8th generation and later, and iPad mini 5th generation and later
- iOS 18.7.11 and iPadOS 18.7.11 (October 26), for iPhone XS, iPhone XS Max, iPhone XR, and iPad 7th generation
- macOS Tahoe 26.6.2 (August 17)
- macOS Sequoia 15.8 (September 14)
- tvOS 27 (September 14), for Apple TV 4K 2nd generation and later
- watchOS 27 (September 14), for Apple Watch Series 9 and later
- visionOS 27 (September 14), for Apple Vision Pro (all models)
The researchers describe no setting that blocks the bypass, so installing these updates is the fix.
The iOS 27 notes do not list the flaw, nor do those for later iOS 27 updates as of today. Meta's timeline says the fix shipped in iOS 27.0 beta 5 on August 10.
CISA gives the flaw a CVSS score of 5.0 out of 10. The agency's catalog of known exploited vulnerabilities does not list it, as of the catalog's update late last week.
Apple's notes for the August 17 updates describe the flaw only as one that may let an app leak sensitive user information.
Tsytsarkin wrote: "That description leaves out the most striking part: the app could record after permission was denied, without the orange indicator appearing."
In his own tests, the indicator was missing only on the earlier build. An app does not decide for itself whether it may record. That decision goes through the Transparency, Consent, and Control (TCC) system, which checks which process is asking.
The audio service, called audiomxd, accepted the app's own word about which process was asking. An audit token identifies a process. An app could send the service a token that named audiomxd itself.
The service then treated the app as itself. It took a shortcut meant for its own internal audio and allowed recording without asking TCC. The kernel itself provided the app with the details it needed to impersonate the service.
The fix makes the service check the real caller's identity, which the kernel supplies. Outside callers now need the private entitlement com.apple.private.audio.client-audit-token-override to replace the client identity the service relies on. An app cannot grant itself that entitlement.

articles.title: We've been tracking Black Friday prices all month — these are the 75+ best deals on phones, laptops, TVs, appliances and more

Black Friday is almost here, and retailers across Australia are offering discounts on Apple, Samsung, Dyson, Bose, SharkNinja and more
While my team and I have been tracking and finding some excellent Black Friday deals in Australia since the start of November, the fact remains the major shopping weekend doesn't officially kick off until next Friday, November 27, which is closely followed by Cyber Monday, November 30.

This little pod machine is very popular among TechRadar's Aussie team. We've had past and present staff say how much they love it, and they'd even buy it at full price. With a very compact footprint and plenty of Vertuo pods to choose from, you'll get delicious coffee at just the press of a button.
If you're after a compact model that can feed one or two people, this Philips option is great for under a hundred dollary-doos. Now down to AU$797 in all colours, there's never been a better time to secure Apple's ridiculously good noise cancelling over ears. While the design hasn't changed much, the internals have been upgraded to deliver even better ANC performance, Lossless audio over USB-C and a wealth of useful features made possible by the new H2 chip.
Sony's flagship headphones have finally received a discount worth shouting about, with up to 40% off depending on colour. Arguably one of the best headphones available today, there's no doubting performance here, with beautifully balanced sound and great ANC.
Coffee machines
The best entry-level bean-to-cup coffee maker has received a good discount for Black Friday, although not quite as good as the AU$359 we saw during Prime Day. It's simple to use, taking care of the grinding, tamping and pouring for you. The porta filter will even automatically slide into position for you. Do note there's no milk frothing here, but a matching milk frother is available.
This compact manual coffee machine can pour up to two espresso shots at once and features a steam wand for cafe-quality milk foaming. There's no built-in grinder, but you either use ground coffee beans or invest in a separate grinder using the cash you save with this deal.
If you've already got a decent coffee maker but one without a grinder, just add this Breville machine to get fresh ground coffee. It has over 60 settings for precise control over your beans, meaning you should be able to extract the most delicious shot from the grind catering to your taste.
A welcome saving on Breville's answer to the SodaStream. Not only can you use the InFizz Fusion to carbonate water, but you can fizz any liquid you can think of — other than hot beverages of course. This nifty machine is sure to be a hit during at-home cocktail nights.
Promising simplicity of use, the De'Longhi Magnifica S has an easy-to-use touch control panel that allows you to brew two cups simultaneously with the minimum amount of effort. It also has a silent integrated grinder with 13 settings, plus a handy milk frother too, so it’s a good all-in-one solution.
The Breville Bambino Plus is incredibly simple to use, and can take care of most of the coffee making process for you. Grind some beans into the porta filter, insert it into the group head and use the one-touch controls to brew. It also has a hands-free milk texturing system for expertly frothed milk, while ThermoJet technology means the machine is ready to use in seconds. To get the deal price here, first grab yourself a 10% Breville coupon code.
With a nice saving, it's hard to dismiss this Breville coffee machine deal. The Barista Express has a built-in grinder, tamper, and bean hopper, so there's no need to buy a separate grinder or hand tamp. Available in a few colourways under the same listing, only the Charcoal model gets the full discount.
If you’re after a coffee that makes itself, then it’s hard to go past the Breville Creatista Plus. A great compact pod machine that uses the Original Nespresso pods, and one that can also do milk frothing without requiring a whole other appliance.
We've only reviewed the more expensive Touch model, but if you take your coffee seriously – and want a barista-level cup of joe easily, this is the deal for you. Offering automatic grinding, dosing, tamping and milk texturing, this machine lets you go from beans to latte in seconds.
Vacuum cleaners
This is a fantastic discount on Dyson's most powerful cordless vacuum to date, and what I like even more about it is the quick-release floorhead so you don't have to keep bending to take off or clip it back in again. For your money, you're getting 315AW of suction and a very powerful motor, a new compression dust cup that can hold up to 30 days of compacted dirt, the new anti-tangle FluffyCones floorhead with dust-illuminating light and long runtime too. If you want the latest from the popular brand, this one is it.
Now down by a huge AU$660, Dyson's Detect Submarine houses a powerful suction and a superb runtime of up to 60 minutes. It can handle all floor types, including wet and dry messes.
If you want to get a thorough cleaning experience, the Detect head uses Dyson's LED tech to reveal dust on hardwood floors. It also comes with the standard motorbar head for deep-cleaning carpets and other crevice tools. With a battery life of 60 minutes, this will give your floors a decent clean.
Dyson's featherweight wet floor cleaner has more effective scrubbing, a higher capacity, a removable water tank and a decent battery life that'll last throughout an entire clean. It's a notable upgrade from its predecessor, so if you're in the market for a floorwasher, this is one to consider.
This Shark cordless vac is on the more simple side of things, but it gets the job done with powerful, dynamic suction, that adjusts depending on the floor type you're cleaning.
In our Ecovacs Deebot X8 Pro Omni review, in which it scored an impressive 4.5-star score, we called it a "chatty all-in-one robot vacuum that cleans better than most others". Its biggest drawback is its regular price, but this deal takes care of that — letting you enjoy its strong suction, efficient edge cleaning, effective mopping and smart navigation.
A huge discount on what is a relatively new flagship model from Ecovacs. We haven't tested this version out yet, but if it works as well as the previous X8 Pro Omni did, then I think this is a good premium robovac to consider without the hefty price tag.
Kitchen Aplliances
The Ninja Slushi lets you skip the ice and still enjoy perfectly smooth icy drinks with very little effort. Whether you're craving a frappe, smoothie, or even a cheeky spiked slushi, its multiple drink modes have you covered. Even better, the current deal price is near to the lowest we have seen on Amazon. Check out our Ninja Slushi review for the full rundown.
This compact air fryer packs 1700W of power into a portable design, with two borosilicate glassware containers that serve as both frying baskets and serving dishes. The borosilicate means they can also withstand extreme temperatures, making it easy to take your favourite foods from frozen to crispy, and it's safer to use than any non-stick basket. The Crispi also comes with two removable crisping grates and two snap-on container lids for easy food-storage post-feast.
It's got a cult-like following and two members of our own staff are massive fans. If you love your chilled desserts — ice creams, gelatos, smoothies — but want to control your calorie intake, you really should consider getting the Ninja Creami. This Deluxe edition gets you three containers, which is great value at this price.
Not a big discount and even I balk at recommending a toaster that costs more then AU$50, but I have the Black Truffle model of this 2-slice toaster and trust me when I say it's one of the best toasters I've used. Sure, it's overkill for the average person but if you can get the perfect toast every morning (or arvo or evening), I think it's worth considering.
Securing a spot on our list of the best air fryers, our reviewer said this innovative model from Ninja was the "air fryer of my dreams". It takes a familiar double drawer design, but stacks them on top of each other, resulting in a smaller footprint. Performance is exemplary, but just make sure the food you put in isn't too big, as the drawers themselves are on the smaller side at 4.75L each.
This Ninja kitchen appliance combines a grill and an air fryer in one machine. We liked it so much that we gave it 4.5 stars in our Ninja Smart XL Grille and Air Fryer review. The latest model comes with the same presets as the DG551, but boasts a sleeker, more slimline design. Customer reviews on the listing praise its impressive features, meat-turning reminders and that it's easy to clean.
This Shark fan has twisting ends that allow it to shoot air out in any direction. The blades can be positioned horizontally or vertically too, and while the ends need manual intervention, all other controls can be adjusted via a remote control.
TV
The LG C6 continues to set the bar for what can be achieved in a 'mid-range' OLED TV, and I now consider it the best TV for most people. It serves up sumptuous colours and incredible brightness, and it offers every gaming feature you could ever want. Make sure to hit the Price Beat button for the full saving.
As you can read in our LG StanByMe 2 review, after living with this quirky TV for a few weeks, I found it to be a genuinely useful addition to my home. It can attach to a rollable stand, can be used in a tabletop stand mode, or hung on a wall. It's touchscreen-enabled too, making it great for interactive games. At full price I think it's tough to recommend, but this saving, made possible thanks to Price Beat, helps that somewhat. Make sure to enter code SAVENOW at checkout for the full saving.
It might feature a controversial design in the form of a silver rear panel that can't be removed (but is designed with wall-mounting in mind) but the Samsung S95H is one of the best screens we've ever tested. It pairs a "bright, colourful, contrast-rich picture" with a full suite of gaming features, and it really does demand to be seen. Make sure to hit the Price Beat button for the full saving.
Our reviewer claimed this be "one of the best-value TVs on the market" in our TCL C7L review. It serves up an impressive picture, and is particularly useful as a gaming TV. Throw in excellent colour reproduction by way of the company's new Super Quantum Dot tech, and you have yourself a tempting proposition.
A decent price drop on Sony's mid-range Bravia 5 mini-LED TV. We recently published our review, and found it delivered a superb performance, especially given its price. Expect deep blacks, great contrast and minimal blooming.
We haven’t reviewed this Bose soundbar, but if it’s anything like the brand’s other models, we’re confident it will do a mighty fine job of boosting the sound from your TV, ideal when watching movies. If you want to add even more low-end grunt, it works with the company’s Bass Modules (sold separately). A Dialogue mode helps to boost vocals, and if you fancy a dance around your bedroom or living room, Bluetooth is onboard for you to stream your favourite tunes.
The Sonos Beam Gen 2 is a simply superb soundbar, especially at this price. It delivers a convincing Dolby Atmos soundtrack and it sounds great with music (as you'd expect, being Sonos).
A stonking saving on this uber-powerful JBL Dolby Atmos soundbar. Plus, it has the added benefit of removable side speakers that convert into rear speakers for a full surround effect. They can also be used independently as Bluetooth speakers.
Smart home
Amazon's Echo Dot it's a great smart speaker with decent sound and Alexa built-in. It also has motion detection and can measure temperature, which is handy if you have a connected thermostat. It is a little long in the tooth now, having released in 2022, but it's a bargain at this price.
The Echo Dot Max features almost 3x the bass of the Echo Dot (5th gen), and its sound can automatically adapt to your space, making it the perfect addition to any smart home or party setup. We gave it a nice 4 stars in our review, namely for its great smart home capabilities and stellar sound. Now at its lowest-ever price.
Launched in October, the latest Echo home display devices have gotten a much-needed glow-up Echo Show 8 and the Echo Show 11. Aside from the updated in-cell touch and negative liquid crystal screens, both devices include new front-facing stereo speakers and a custom woofer for room-filling spatial audio. The key difference between the two? The Echo Show 8 has a smaller 8.7-inch display.
With all the same great features as the new Echo Show 8 above, if you're after a larger home display screen to connect to your Ring devices, check recipes while cooking or control your smart devices using Alexa, then the 11-inch Echo Show could be the move for you.
PC & Gaming
A 100Hz-refresh-rate monitor for just AU$100? Sign me up! This display from Lenovo may be a bit small at under 24 inches with a 1080p resolution, but it uses IPS technology for sharp image quality. This is price is the lowest we've seen this monitor go on Amazon.
This handheld gaming PC has been cheaper before, dropping to the AU$899 mark but, then again, nothing really comes cheap these days. Importantly, though, this is a great performer, with a vivid 8-inch display and 144Hz refresh rate for smooth gameplay. It's also rather nice looking and comfortable in the hand.
Phones, tablets & wearables
The Galaxy Tab A11+ picks up where the A9 left off, and at the same price too. This is the base model, with just Wi-Fi connectivity and 128GB of storage, but you can expand that easily to up to 2TB via a microSD card. If you need an Android tablet for daily use like browsing, watching videos and maybe playing a few games, this one's well worth considering.
The Google Pixel 11 Pro was just released in August 2026, but it's already getting more than AU$500 off the sticker price for Black Friday, although this is hardly a surprise given how frequently Google runs discounts on its Pixel handsets in recent years. It saw a price hike over last year's Pixel 10 Pro, but its storage options now start at 256GB, and it has a brighter display, a new glass camera housing and a faster Tensor G6 processor.
The Pixel 11 Pro above is great, but having used the base Pixel 11 myself, I'd argue it's the smarter buy for most people, especially at this sub-AU$1,000 price. It features the same Tensor G6 chipset, 12GB of RAM and 7 years of software support, and it also has three camera lenses like the Pro (although lower-spec ones).
As far as mid-range/budget Android smartphones go, you can't go wrong with the Google Pixel 10a, especially with Android 17 set to get a full release next month (or you can access the Android 17 beta now if you're feeling adventurous). While I've criticised the phone for being too similar to its predecessor, the Pixel 9a, it's still a really good budget Android phone, and this discount makes it even more of a bargain.
With more storage than the standard Paperwhite, a brighter screen and wireless charging, the Paperwhite Signature Edition is arguably better value than the base model above if you think you'll make full use of the storage and its wireless charging capabilities. If not, you're better off going with the standard Paperwhite, although its meagre discount is rather disappointing.
The Kindle Colorsoft is one of the best ereaders with a colour display, even offering a feature to make the hues more vivid. While I wouldn't recommend at full price, this discount makes it a little easier on the pocket for the 32GB version that also has wireless charging.
Kindles are known for their reading capabilities, but with the Kindle Scribe, you get that and a whole lot more. With a wide range of writing features, you can take notes, create sketches and brainstorm like a pro. I love its 10.2-inch glare-free screen with an ambient light sensor, and it's battery life is excellent too. It's now the previous-gen model, but arguably better value than the 2025 3rd-gen release.
Samsung's answer to the AirTag, the SmartTag 2 works with select Samsung phones to help you find mislaid items. It has a built-in hole for easier attachments, up to 700 days of battery life and it's water-resistant. If you're always losing stuff, this is a worthy investment that drops the price of each individual tracker to a mere AU$17.25 apiece.
The Vivoactive 5 contains a lot of the premium Garmin features found in its more expensive offerings, while also priced closer to conventional smartwatches. These features include on-board GPS, on-device storage for offline music via Spotify, and fitness metrics like Body Battery and VO2 Max.
We called this the best smart ring for battery life (rated up to 12 days + a further 150 days with the charging case) while also being a more affordable option than Oura and Samsung at full price. The Gen 2 added a sleep apnoea tracker to make up for the price hike over its predecessor. Again, be sure to source the sizing kit first as not all smart rings are made the same.
Cameras
Sitting in a sweet spot between Fujifilm’s compact models and the pricier enthusiast models like the X-S20 or X-T5, the X-T30 uses the familiar 26.1MP X-Trans sensor and Fujifilm’s latest processing engine, so you still get that lovely Fuji colour, quick autofocus, and plenty of film simulations without paying flagship prices.
This camera has gone viral in other countries, so much so that's it's hard to find stock. In Australia, however, there's plenty, and it offers fabulous value, especially since this is single-lens kit that's cheaper than the RRP of the body alone. It's one of the tiniest cameras available today and still comes packed with features for entry-level hybrid shooters. So go on, you won't regret it.
Beauty & grooming
If you didn't know what a 'sonic' brush is, it's quieter and gentler than an oscillating electric toothbrush (like Oral-B). The DiamondClean 9000 has 4 cleaning modes, and one of them gets you 3 intensities. This value pack gets you a his-and-hers version, plus the glass is actually the charger.
Offering one of the most fuss-free shaves, the Philips OneBlade 360 is a nigh-on essential tool for any man's grooming routine. The cutting blade itself can move in any direction, ensuring constant, comfortable contact with your face to remove your beard entirely, while an included guard comb allows you to trim your facial fuzz to a desired length.
The Lawn Mower 5.0 Ultra is a solid choice if you want one device for general trimming and getting a closer shave. It includes interchangeable SkinSafe trimmer and foil heads, a built-in LED light and a waterproof design for wet or dry use, while USB-C charging and the included travel case make it easier to take on the road.
We're huge fans of the Shark CryoGlow here at TechRadar. The brand's advanced face mask combines LED facial care with a clever InstaChill cooling system to help reduce under-eye puffiness. During testing, we found this unique model to be very comfortable and capable of surprisingly good results. While a little pricey, the CyroGlow could be worth it if you're already spending a lot of cash on your skincare routine.
If you like it Crispi... go Pro
Ninja is a dab hand when it comes to kitchen appliances, particularly air fryers. So when the bigger version of its popular Crispi air fryer arrived in Australia, you can bet your bottom dollar I was excited. And now it's received a monster discount at Amazon (in pink), or a still-great discount direct at Ninja in all other colours for Black Friday, it's well worth checking out.
It's retail price is actually AU$499, but Ninja is slashing AU$150 off as an introductory offer. There's no confirmation from the brand how long this offer will last, so you might want to hurry, but for AU$349.99, this is one heck of a purchase.
It comes with two glass baskets — a smaller 2.3L and the biggest 5.7L option — with their respective lids, plus it can handle six functions, including dehydration, bake/prove and roast. You can even buy an additional mid-sized 3.8L glass basket if you want to make it fit your family's size.
Either way, I'm sold!
Ninja Crispi Pro (pink): AU$266.39 from Amazon
Ninja Crispi Pro (all colours): AU$349.99 from Ninja Kitchen
Black Friday shopping tips
Shopping Black Friday deals can be an absolute minefield! There might be seasoned bargain hunters among you who know how to spot a great deal, but others might be overwhelmed. This is also when scams abound and you need to find your around those too. So, how do you actually find the best bargains?
Well, spending time to do some research is always the best way, but below are some of my tips to make sure you get the deal you've been holding out for.
- Firstly, start by making a list of what you want to buy, then keen an eye on the price history. You can use tools like CamelCamelCamel if you're a regular Amazon shopper, or even check price comparison sites like Getprice.
- Figure out what kind of specs you're after, but be flexible – the top line might be beyond your budget even after discount, but a slightly lower-specced model might suit you just fine and save you a lot of cash too.
- So, you've found the deal you were looking for a retailer, but always widen your net and check other stores – someone will price beat (if not price match) and you could even score yourself additional incentives like a bundle package or a free gift. Definitely shop around.
- While it's fair to say the best deals will be during the actual 4-day Black Friday to Cyber Monday period – which is November 27 to November 30 this year – retailers are starting their sales early and prices may or may not change over the next few weeks. If you hold off, stocks might be out and you could miss out. These early deals are well worth considering – if a price looks right to you, don't hesitate to commit.
- And in case the price does drop further after you've made your purchase, I'd strongly recommend leaving the item in its box till the sale is fully over. That way you can always return it and buy it elsewhere for a better price.
You spin me right round
Turntables continue to increase in popularity, but with so many models on the market, available in a range of styles and prices, choosing the ideal one for your needs can be tricky.
If you're new to the turntable game, then this JBL Spinner BT aims to make the process as simple as possible. You get everything you need to get you up and running in the box, complete with a genuinely useful set of instructions to help you attach the drive belt and adjust the counterweight.
It also has a built-in phono stage, something that's necessary in order to get sound actually playing out of your speakers. Having a built-in phono stage means you can connect it to any amplifier you wish. You can bypass it though, if your amplifier has a dedicated phono input.
It's party piece, however, is that it supports Bluetooth too, meaning you can wirelessly connect it to any of the best Bluetooth speakers. It couldn't be easier!
And now it's available for a low price of just AU$395 at Amazon, although only in the black/gold finish. Take it from me, I have one of these myself, and it's wonderfully talented deck.
• JBL Spinner BT: was AU$649.95 now AU$395 at Amazon
Also available at The Good Guys for AU$390 with Price Beat.
Our Black Friday deals coverage is live!
We've been tracking Black Friday deals since the start of November, but now our live coverage has been set free, this has become the only page you need to bookmark to ensure you don't miss the biggest and best deals this holiday shopped period.
Black Friday sales in Australia technically don't kick off until next Friday, November 27, but with the Amazon Black Friday sale already live, many other Australian retailers are following suit and releasing their deals to the public.
That's great news for us and you, because it gives us all plenty of time to shop. You'll already find a solid selection of our favourite offers on this page, but as I mentioned, make sure to check back regularly, because the TechRadar team and I will be keeping it updated over the next couple of weeks.
Happy shopping!!

articles.title: Nvidia vendió USD 115.800 millones en un trimestre y prevé superar los 130.000 millones sin contar China
articles.text:
Nvidia informó que facturó USD 115.800 millones en el trimestre cerrado el 25 de octubre, más del doble que un año antes, en su primer balance desde que Jensen Huang renunció como director ejecutivo. La cifra superó tanto la previsión de la propia compañía como la de los analistas.
Los ingresos crecieron 103% frente a un año antes y 20% respecto del trimestre anterior. En agosto, Nvidia había proyectado USD 108.000 millones, según The Verge, y los analistas consultados por la firma LSEG esperaban USD 109.100 millones, según CNBC.
El negocio de centros de datos aportó USD 107.600 millones, 110% más que un año antes. La división que incluye juegos y computadoras personales facturó USD 8.200 millones, 42% más. La ganancia neta fue de USD 65.300 millones.
Para el trimestre en curso, la empresa prevé ingresos de USD 130.000 millones, con un margen de error de 3% hacia arriba o hacia abajo. Los analistas esperaban USD 125.100 millones, según LSEG.
La compañía aclaró que no cuenta con ventas de chips para centros de datos a China, y estimó que su margen bajará a entre 71% y 72%, desde 74,8%.
El directorio descartó que Huang vuelva
La conferencia con inversores empezó con unas palabras del presidente del directorio, Harvey Jones. Dijo que Huang renunció tras revelar una conducta personal inconsistente con el código de conducta, los estándares y las normas culturales de la empresa. El directorio aceptó la renuncia por unanimidad y no piensa reinstalarlo, afirmó.
Jones advirtió que la compañía no respondería preguntas sobre la renuncia ni sobre la investigación en curso, según The Verge.
La directora financiera Colette Kress, que dirige Nvidia de forma interina, dijo que en la empresa todo sigue con normalidad. Según CNBC, también elevó a 75% el crecimiento esperado para el año fiscal 2028, frente al 70% previsto antes.
Huang, que renunció el 12 de noviembre según NDTV Profit, días después de que el directorio abriera una investigación independiente por informes sobre sus relaciones personales, publicó ese mismo día su primera declaración desde la salida.
“Si el directorio decide que mi regreso es lo mejor para los accionistas, los empleados y la empresa, me sentiría honrado de volver como director ejecutivo”, escribió, según CNBC. También reconoció “serios errores” en su vida personal.
China es la mayor fuente de incertidumbre, según CNBC. El Departamento de Comercio de Estados Unidos anunció el lunes un cambio que impediría alquilar chips de Nvidia a empresas chinas, lo que pone en riesgo ingresos futuros.
Los inversores respondieron con alzas y recompras
Tras la publicación de los resultados, las acciones de Nvidia subieron más de 3% en las operaciones posteriores al cierre de la Bolsa, según CNBC.
En el trimestre, la empresa devolvió USD 28.100 millones a sus accionistas mediante recompras de acciones y dividendos. Le quedan unos USD 227.300 millones autorizados para recomprar acciones, tras un aumento de USD 150.000 millones aprobado en septiembre.
Nvidia también informó que comenzó a enviar Vera Rubin NVL72, su nueva plataforma de servidores para IA, que según la compañía tuvo el arranque de producción más rápido de su historia. Entre los clientes que ya la usan figuran CoreWeave, Google Cloud, Microsoft Azure y Oracle Cloud Infrastructure.
Nvidia pagará su próximo dividendo trimestral, de USD 0,25 por acción, el 23 de diciembre a los accionistas registrados al 2 de diciembre. Mientras tanto, según NDTV Profit, el directorio busca a un director ejecutivo permanente.

articles.title: Tomb Raider Studio Crystal Dynamics Lays Off Even More Workers
articles.text:
Tuesday, November 17th 2026
Tomb Raider Studio Crystal Dynamics Lays Off Even More Workers
Crystal Dynamics has seemingly had to conduct its fifth round of layoffs in the last two years, following a round of layoffs in March that saw 20 workers lose their jobs. The news broke via Vertical Slice, who cited several LinkedIn posts from Former Crystal Dynamics employees, including a UI software engineer, a developer working on internal procedural tools, and a game design lead. While it's still unclear just how many workers were laid off during this latest round of layoffs, Crystal Dynamics has since issued a statement confirming the layoffs.
Crystal Dynamics via Vertical SliceCrystal Dynamics made a difficult, but necessary business decision to reduce our current studio staff by 8 people. Whenever we phase roles off a project, we make every effort to find new spots for our great colleagues first. Everyone affected receives a full severance package as well as job placement assistance to aid them through this transition. We wish them the best and hope to work together in the future.
The studio is currently working on the upcoming Tomb Raider Legacy of Atlantis and Tomb Raider Catalyst, and it's unclear how these layoffs will affect that development, however, Catalyst has already been delayed by Crystal Dynamics more than once, so it would almost be surprising if it weren't delayed again due to the studio's lost workforce.
Source:
				Vertical Slice

articles.title: New GitDoor and GraphDoor Backdoors Turn GitHub and SharePoint Into Covert C2 Channels
articles.text:
Government sectors in Asia and Africa have been targeted by an active cyber intrusion campaign that delivers to previously undocumented backdoors that leverage legitimate services like Microsoft SharePoint and GitHub for command‑and‑control (C2).
The activity has been codenamed Operation ShadowCloud by Kaspersky. The Russian cybersecurity company said it identified the campaign in early 2026.
"The threat actor behind it is abusing the legitimate MeshAgent utility to drop two brand-new backdoors," Kaspersky researchers Saurabh Sharma and Noushin Shabab said in a two-part analysis. "These implants hide their command‑and‑control (C2) traffic behind cloud services Microsoft SharePoint, GitHub, and Ably, allowing the implants to blend in with normal traffic, effectively evading network-based detections."
The modular backdoors, dubbed GraphDoor and GitDoor for their choice of the cloud platform used for C2, enable the download of additional plugins on demand and the execution of shellcode directly in memory to extend their functionality. Traffic between infected systems and the C2 servers is proxied by deploying a modified Erfrp client and Ably messaging service-based plugins.
The starting point of the attack has been traced back to a MeshCentral Agent, a legitimate remote access tool that's used for remote desktop control, command‑line access, and file management. The attack is said to have targeted an unspecified Taiwanese organization.
The exact method by which the utility is installed on the host remains unknown. However, signs point to the "reuse of a prior infection already present on the network," Kaspersky added.
The MeshCentral Agent is configured to contact a hard-coded C2 server ("wss://27.102.66[.]162:443/agent.ashx") and then fetch three payloads staged on the endpoint -
- A legitimate binary used for DLL sideloading (start.exe, pythonw.exe, and zoomit.exe)
- A rogue loader DLL used to unpack and execute the next-stage malware (jli.dll, SbieDll.dll, python39.dll, WINMM.dll, and libcef.dll)
- An encrypted file containing the core payload
At least two different DLL loaders have been identified to date, each employing its own method to decode and launch the encrypted backdoor payload by injecting it into the current process's memory.
"Loader (Type 1) employs a hybrid scheme: first running the data through an RC4 stream cipher and then applying an XOR mask, while Loader (Type 2) simplifies the process by using a straight XOR operation alone," Kaspersky noted.
The end goal is to deploy backdoors like GitDoor and GraphDoor, which employ a number of encryption and obfuscation techniques like control flow flattening and nested helper functions to complicate analysis efforts and make it harder to trace genuine execution flow.
GitDoor, as the name implies, uses GitHub for C2. It relies on two distinct repositories for receiving command payloads ("/repos/LatonyCharnleyaW/Havo") and uploading the results of the execution ("/repos/LatonyCharnleyaW/Trix"). While the Havo repository is public, the Trix repository is private.
The creation date of these repositories suggests that preparations for the campaign have been underway since at least the end of 2024. GitDoor supports 26 commands that allow the backdoor to -
- Perform file management
- Log keystrokes
- Launch a proxy, including using Ably
- Load shellcode to Base64-encoded Common Object File Format (COFF) binaries and terminate the backdoor
The custom shellcode feature is used to download and run different modules that facilitate the following functions -
- Conduct process injection using methods like Asynchronous Procedure Call (APC) injection
- Enumerate and manage Windows services
- List files and directories, wipe file contents, and recursively delete a directory
- Conduct network-related activity by displaying active TCP connections and modify firewall rules
- Manage processes, including dumping the memory of the process with a specified process ID into a file and terminating specific processes
- Execute commands using "cmd.exe"
- Enumerate, create, and run scheduled tasks
- Enumeration Windows Registry keys and values recursively and set a value in the Registry
- Extract user information, along with local groups and its members
- Add of a new Windows user account or add a user to a global or a local group
- Record keystrokes to a file ("%APPDATA%\Microsoft\SystemCertificates\Cache\logs.dat")
- Dump cookies from Google Chrome and Microsoft Edge directly from the process memory using CookieKatz
- Use Mimikatz to dump credentials from Windows LSASS
- Capture screenshots of the entire screen or a specific window identified by its process ID
- Extract WhatsApp's database decryption key
- Initiate NTLM authentication to an attacker-controlled destination
- Calculate system idle time and display the last time a user was active on the host using mouse movement and keyboard input
GraphDoor, on the other hand, opens a named pipe, creates a directory named "Intel_Log" inside the system's Application Data folder, and gathers system information to send back to the attacker.
To establish communications with the C2 server, it authenticates with a malicious application using "login.microsoftonline.com" on port 443 and uses the access token to communicate with the Microsoft Graph API and ultimately stage the data on the SharePoint drive.
The malware then fetches three plugin modules from the server and launches them in parallel to carry out screenshot capture, process listing, and keylogging. It also proceeds to reestablish contact with the SharePoint website to retrieve the commands to be executed on the machine.
The complete list of plugins supported by GraphDoor is as follows -
- kl.ts, to log keystrokes at "%APPDATA%\Microsoft\SystemCertificates\Cache\logs.dat"
- pr.ts, to list running processes
- scr.ts, to take screenshots of the window that matches a supplied process ID and save them as JPEG images
- moveDir.ts, to move the legitimate executable, the malicious loader DLL, and the encrypted backdoor file to specific target path
- channel.ts, to launch the proxy
- abchannel.ts, to use the Ably messaging service to proxy traffic
- ab2channel.ts, a covert SOCKS5 proxy that tunnels TCP traffic through Ably's Pusher‑compatible WebSocket service
In addition, GraphDoor's custom shellcode capability expands on GitDoor to support two additional commands that allow it to run commands using "cmd.exe," as well as MZ executables.
The identity of the threat actor behind the campaign is unknown, but Kaspersky said it shares some degree of overlap with a China-nexus activity that Sophos tracks under the moniker Bronze Sandcastle. Tactical similarities have also been observed with prior campaigns undertaken by FamousSparrow and CopperTurtle (aka BlackTech).
"On several victim systems, these groups shared the same staging directories as the GitDoor backdoor, with their implants deployed within a one-day window of GitDoor deployment," the company concluded. "While this does not prove a direct link, it suggests that a Chinese-speaking group may be developing and/or utilizing the GitDoor and GraphDoor backdoors."
"By using cloud-based storage and messaging services, the actors blend in with normal traffic (as cloud API calls to Microsoft Graph, GitHub, and Ably are indistinguishable from legitimate enterprise usage, evading many network-based detections), and enable dynamic payload delivery, where on-demand plug-ins and shellcode are retrieved from cloud repositories, allowing for rapid updates and functional extensions without modifying host files."

articles.title: Prise de contrôle de comptes : Surfshark One mise sur une protection tout-en-un
articles.text:
Messagerie, réseaux sociaux, comptes bancaires… Les pirates disposent de nombreuses techniques pour s’emparer de vos accès. Voici comment leur mettre des bâtons dans les roues !
L’une des menaces les plus sous-estimées, et qui mérite pourtant bien plus d’attention, est « l’Account Takeover ». Derrière cet anglicisme se cache une pratique vicieuse, sur laquelle reposent de nombreuses escroqueries.
Le principe est de prendre le contrôle d’un compte légitime, associé à une véritable identité, à des données personnelles concrètes et, parfois, à des moyens de paiement. Les informations récupérées ouvrent alors de nombreuses portes avec la possibilité d’agir à court, moyen ou long terme (ce qui renforce encore davantage les risques).
Comment les pirates prennent-ils le contrôle de vos comptes ?
Parmi les différentes méthodes utilisées, l’ingénierie sociale occupe une place grandissante. Plutôt que de s’attaquer directement aux systèmes informatiques, les pirates cherchent à manipuler les personnes pour obtenir les informations dont ils ont besoin. Et avec le développement de l’intelligence artificielle, ces tentatives de manipulation deviennent toujours plus crédibles et difficiles à déceler.
L’ingénierie sociale : exploiter la confiance et l’inattention
Les scénarios sont nombreux, souvent bien construits, et surtout en lien avec des situations du quotidien, c’est d’ailleurs ce qui rend ces attaques si redoutables. Il suffit d’un moment d’inattention… On est fatigué, préoccupé, pressé, on baisse un peu sa garde… Et l’on se fait piéger.
Dans certains cas, les victimes communiquent leurs identifiants ou leur mot de passe, pensant se connecter à un service légitime. Dans d’autres, elles ne révèlent que quelques informations en apparence anodines. Pourtant, en recoupant ces renseignements avec d’autres données, les pirates peuvent reconstituer une partie de leur identité numérique, usurper leur identité et, dans certaines circonstances, parvenir à accéder à leurs comptes.
Les attaques techniques : d’autres moyens de compromettre vos comptes
Mais l’ingénierie sociale est loin d’être leur seule arme. Les méthodes plus classiques n’ont pas disparu pour autant : bourrage d’identifiants, attaques par force brute, logiciels malveillants, enregistreurs de frappe, détournement de carte SIM ou encore attaques de l’homme du milieu restent d’actualité.
Et ces différentes approches ne sont pas nécessairement employées séparément. Les pirates peuvent aussi les combiner pour multiplier leurs chances de réussite.
Ces signaux d’alerte qu’il ne faut pas ignorer
Puisqu’il est impossible de rester vigilant à chaque instant, il est judicieux de savoir repérer les signes d’une activité suspecte.
Certains indices, parfois discrets, doivent vous mettre la puce à l’oreille : un compte auquel vous ne parvenez plus à accéder alors qu’il fonctionnait parfaitement la veille, une demande de réinitialisation de mot de passe que vous n’avez pas initiée, un message envoyé depuis votre compte sans que vous en soyez l’auteur, ou encore une notification de connexion depuis un appareil ou un lieu inhabituel.
Des réflexes pour mieux se protéger
Certaines habitudes simples peuvent vous aider à mieux protéger vos comptes ou, à défaut, compliquer la tâche des pirates s’ils parviennent à mettre la main sur vos données.
Commencez par utiliser un mot de passe long, robuste et différent pour chaque service. Si l’un d’eux tombe entre les mains de pirates, ils ne pourront pas s’en servir pour accéder à vos autres comptes.
Pensez à activer l’authentification à deux facteurs. On est d’accord, cette fonction tape parfois sur les nerfs, mais elle ajoute une protection supplémentaire si vos identifiants tombent entre de mauvaises mains. Gardez également vos appareils et vos logiciels à jour, et évitez de communiquer des informations sensibles sur des sites.
Enfin, dernier conseil, qui est de plus pertinent face aux capacités étonnantes de l’IA : appuyez-vous sur une solution de sécurité !
Un dispositif tout-en-un comme solution ?
Le mieux est de se tourner vers une solution qui rassemble plusieurs outils de protection au sein d’un même abonnement, comme Surfshark One. Si l’entreprise européenne est surtout connue pour son VPN, elle propose également d’autres fonctionnalités :
Surfshark Alert, par exemple, surveille certaines données personnelles et vous prévient si elles apparaissent dans une fuite de données. Pour éviter de se trouver dans ce cas de figure, Alternative ID permet de créer une identité alternative, notamment avec une adresse e-mail dédiée.
Lorsque les menaces s’invitent directement sur vos appareils, Surfshark Antivirus est présent pour prendre le relais. Il aide à détecter et à bloquer les logiciels malveillants en temps réel, avec une protection pouvant couvrir jusqu’à cinq appareils sous Windows, macOS ou Android.
Et puis, il y a Scam Protection, un ensemble de fonctionnalités qui aide à repérer les tentatives d’arnaque, notamment dans les SMS, les e-mails ou sur les sites Internet. Un complément plutôt pertinent face aux techniques d’ingénierie sociale évoquées plus haut.
Surfshark One à 2,49 €/mois pour le Black Friday
Pour à peine plus que le prix d’un pain au chocolat (ou d’une chocolatine, on vous laisse trancher ce débat), Surfshark propose son abonnement One à 2,49 € par mois à l’occasion du Black Friday.
Dans le détail :
- 88 % de réduction.
- 3 mois supplémentaires offerts.
- 67,23 € pour les 27 premiers mois.

articles.title: Partidos del Mundial Sub-17 por Pirlo TV: la opción gratuita que pone en peligro a tus dispositivos
articles.text:
Durante el desarrollo del Mundial Sub-17 de la FIFA Qatar 2026, la búsqueda de transmisiones deportivas gratuitas experimenta un crecimiento masivo. Plataformas de distribución no autorizada como Pirlo TV atraen a millones de espectadores que intentan evadir el pago de licencias oficiales.
Sin embargo, el acceso a estos portales web implica una exposición directa a redes de cibercrimen estructuradas para vulnerar computadoras personales y teléfonos móviles mediante la explotación de navegadores e ingeniería social.
Redirecciones maliciosas y falsos reproductores
Pirlo TV no aloja el contenido audiovisual en sus propios servidores, sino que indexa enlaces de terceros. La monetización de esta infraestructura se basa en redes de publicidad maliciosa (malvertising). Los reproductores de video incrustados en la página están cubiertos por capas invisibles (clickjacking).
Al intentar reproducir el partido, ajustar el volumen o cerrar un anuncio, el usuario activa redirecciones forzadas hacia dominios externos. Estos sitios promueven la descarga de supuestos códecs de video, actualizaciones urgentes del reproductor o perfiles VPN obligatorios. Estos archivos son, en realidad, troyanos diseñados para exfiltrar credenciales del sistema o secuestrar información local.
Secuestro del navegador y notificaciones invasivas
Una táctica estandarizada en los enlaces de Pirlo TV es bloquear la visualización del encuentro deportivo hasta que el espectador concede permisos de notificación en el navegador web (Chrome, Edge, Safari).
Al aceptar esta condición bajo la premisa de “verificar que no es un robot”, el atacante obtiene acceso persistente para enviar alertas emergentes fraudulentas directamente al escritorio del sistema operativo o a la pantalla de inicio del móvil, incluso cuando la pestaña de transmisión está cerrada. Estas alertas simulan ser advertencias de antivirus caducados o mensajes del sistema, buscando inducir a la víctima a pagar por software de extorsión (scareware) o ingresar a sitios de phishing bancario.
Criptominería web silenciosa
La duración reglamentaria de un partido de fútbol asegura que el usuario mantendrá la página web abierta de forma ininterrumpida durante más de 90 minutos. Los ciberdelincuentes aprovechan este tiempo de retención prolongado inyectando secuencias de código (scripts) de cryptojacking en el sitio.
Mientras el Mundial Sub-17 se reproduce, el navegador secuestra en segundo plano el poder de procesamiento del procesador (CPU) y la tarjeta gráfica (GPU) del dispositivo para minar criptomonedas a favor de los operadores del sitio. Los síntomas técnicos inmediatos incluyen la ralentización extrema de otras aplicaciones, el encendido al máximo de los ventiladores de refrigeración y un consumo acelerado de la batería, lo que a mediano plazo genera un estrés térmico que degrada los componentes de hardware.
Protocolo de limpieza y mitigación técnica
Si el usuario ingresó a Pirlo TV para visualizar los partidos del Mundial Sub-17 y ejecutó descargas, hizo clic en anuncios o aceptó permisos emergentes en el navegador, debe aplicar de inmediato el siguiente protocolo de desinfección:
- Revocación de permisos web. Ingrese a la configuración de Privacidad y Seguridad de su navegador, acceda al apartado de “Configuración de sitios” (o “Ajustes de sitios web”) y elimine cualquier permiso de notificaciones, cámara o ubicación otorgado a dominios desconocidos.
- Eliminación de extensiones y archivos. Revise la carpeta de Descargas del sistema para eliminar ejecutables recientes (.exe, .apk, .dmg) que no haya solicitado conscientemente. Asimismo, desinstale cualquier extensión o complemento de navegador añadido sin su consentimiento explícito.
- Análisis con herramientas EDR/Antivirus. Ejecute un escaneo profundo del sistema operativo utilizando Microsoft Defender o una solución de seguridad de terceros de reputación comprobada para localizar y poner en cuarentena posibles troyanos o scripts persistentes.
- Auditoría de rendimiento. Abra el Administrador de tareas (Windows) o el Monitor de actividad (macOS) con el navegador cerrado. Confirme que el porcentaje de uso de la CPU y la memoria RAM haya regresado a valores de reposo habituales (generalmente por debajo del 10 %), descartando así la ejecución de procesos de criptominería residuales.

articles.title: The Game Awards: GTA VI Nominated for Game of the Year Before It Even Launches
articles.text:
Tuesday, November 17th 2026
The Game Awards: GTA VI Nominated for Game of the Year Before It Even Launches
The Game Awards has published its official nominations list for the 2026 awards. Grand Theft Auto 6, the most anticipated game of the decade, has indeed made the nominations but only by a single day, as the cutoff is November 20. It is also the most nominated game at The Game Awards 2026 with eight nominations, including Game of the Year, Best Game Direction, Best Narrative, Best Art Direction, Best Score and Music, Best Audio Design, Best Action/Adventure Game, plus a Best Performance nomination for Lucia actor, Manni L.Perez. Control Resonant and Resident Evil Requiem follow with six nominations each. The jury can apparently get early access to games, which is why we see GTA VI on the list even before it has launched. However, it's still unclear how much time the jury actually spent with the game before nominations were locked in.
Other nominations for Game of the Year include Control Resonant, Resident Evil Requiem, Phantom Blade Zero, 007 First Light, and The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time Remake. On a personal level, I find something quite amusing about that nominations list, since the original Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time first came out for the Nintendo 64 in 1998, while GTA VI is still a day away from launch at the time of writing. That's a 28-year gap between the oldest and youngest nominees, at least from a certain viewpoint. The 2026 remake of Ocarina of Time has made dramatic improvements over the original and has also performed exceptionally well. It sold over 5.2 million units in its first four days and has also earned four nominations at The Game Awards. Winners will be revealed on December 10 at the Peacock Theater in Los Angeles, and fan voting is open until December 9.
Source:
				The Game Awards

articles.title: El estudio de Civilization despidió a un tercio de su plantilla días antes del estreno de GTA VI
articles.text:
Firaxis Games, el estudio de Take-Two Interactive que desarrolla las series de videojuegos Civilization y XCOM, despidió a unas 60 personas, cerca de un tercio de su plantilla, según informó Bloomberg. La directora del estudio, Heather Hazen, también dejará la empresa, algo que confirmó la compañía.
La noticia llega pocos días antes del lanzamiento de Grand Theft Auto VI, el título de Rockstar Games, otro sello de Take-Two. Según VGC, el juego ya figura como el más reservado de la historia en PlayStation y Xbox, y Take-Two dijo que las reservas superan “con creces” sus expectativas iniciales.
Bloomberg atribuyó la cifra de 60 despidos a personas familiarizadas con los recortes. La empresa no la confirmó. Un portavoz de 2K, la división de Take-Two que dirige a Firaxis, sí confirmó la reestructuración y la salida de Hazen en una declaración enviada a Bloomberg y a Game Developer.
La explicación de la empresa
“Firaxis está en reestructuración y se reorienta en torno a la fortaleza central del estudio: diseñar juegos de estrategia de primer nivel”, dijo el portavoz de 2K. Según la declaración, el tamaño del estudio se reduce para concentrarse en el diseño, la tecnología y la experiencia del jugador.
La misma declaración describe la jornada como dura, pero necesaria, para la salud futura del estudio, sus franquicias y sus fans. La compañía agradeció a cada integrante del equipo por su aporte y habló de “despedirse de colegas talentosos”.
Sobre Hazen, el portavoz explicó que ella considera este el momento adecuado para entregar la dirección, de modo que el próximo líder del estudio tenga “plena responsabilidad” sobre esta nueva etapa desde el comienzo. 2K no informó quién la reemplazará.
El estudio tiene sede en Hunt Valley, en el estado de Maryland. Además de Civilization y XCOM, desarrolló Marvel’s Midnight Suns, según Game Developer. La publicación también precisó que los despidos llegan días después de que Take-Two presentara sus resultados del segundo trimestre.
Un XCOM con problemas, según empleados
Según Bloomberg, que cita a personas con conocimiento interno, el desarrollo de un nuevo juego de XCOM había enfrentado dificultades. VGC añadió, a partir de ese reporte, que el proyecto había incumplido hitos clave y que los despidos podrían provocar un cambio de rumbo.
2K no comentó el estado de ese título, que no fue anunciado de forma oficial. Si llega al mercado, sería el primer juego de la serie desde XCOM: Chimera Squad, de 2020, según VGC.
El último lanzamiento de Firaxis fue Civilization VII. Según VGC, recibió buenas críticas de la prensa especializada, pero opiniones mixtas de los jugadores, y Take-Two informó que sus ventas tuvieron un “comienzo lento” poco después del estreno.
Ni 2K ni Take-Two informaron cambios en el soporte o las actualizaciones de Civilization VII. Tampoco precisaron cuántos de los despedidos trabajaban en cada proyecto del estudio.
El portal especializado Portal GTA 6 indicó que Take-Two reafirmó el 19 de noviembre como fecha de estreno de Grand Theft Auto VI al presentar sus resultados trimestrales.
Todo lo que necesitas saber sobre Civilization VII
Sid Meier’s Civilization VII es un videojuego de estrategia por turnos desarrollado por Firaxis Games, en el cual los jugadores asumen el rol de un líder histórico para construir y guiar un imperio desde los albores de la humanidad hasta la edad moderna.
El objetivo principal consiste en fundar asentamientos, gestionar recursos, investigar tecnologías, cultivar la cultura y participar en la diplomacia o la guerra contra otras facciones para alcanzar diferentes tipos de victoria.
Esta entrega mantiene la legendaria premisa de la franquicia de “construir un imperio que resista la prueba del tiempo”, pero ofreciendo una experiencia más dinámica mediante la expansión orgánica de los territorios y un sistema diplomático basado en la influencia.
La característica más innovadora del título es la estructuración de la partida en tres grandes Eras (Antigüedad, Exploración y Modernidad) y la desvinculación total entre los líderes y sus naciones. En lugar de controlar la misma civilización de principio a fin, los jugadores deben evolucionar su imperio al concluir cada era, adoptando una nueva identidad histórica que se desbloquea según las decisiones, logros y el entorno geográfico de la etapa anterior.
Asimismo, al permitir elegir líderes independientemente de la civilización, el juego facilita combinaciones estratégicas inéditas, las cuales se complementan con otras mecánicas nuevas como la distinción de asentamientos entre pueblos y ciudades, la presencia de grandes ríos navegables y el uso de unidades de Comandantes para liderar ejércitos en el campo de batalla.

articles.title: Apple Tightens macOS App Permissions to Limit Data Access Amid AI Agent Security Risks
articles.text:
Apple on Monday introduced new controls that allow Mac users to give more granular access to data they give to apps, including those that use artificial intelligence (AI) agents.
The changes, currently previewed in macOS 27.3 beta 2, relate to increased transparency and more options for two of its APIs: Device Control and Data Access, and Full Disk Access.
"Before granting an app such extraordinary access, users should understand that it puts all of the data on their Mac at risk," Apple said in a statement. "These changes are designed to help them do that and to empower them to make informed decisions about their own data and privacy."
To that end, Device Control and Data Access is being split into two settings: System & App Protection Override and Accessibility.
Other changes include -
- A single method for granting permissions by selecting the requesting app from a list
- Encouraging users to grant access to just the specific apps (for System & App Protection Override) or folders (for Full Disk Access) that are required for their workflows
- Increased visibility into the range of data that apps will receive access to or have control over when users grant full permissions
- An option for users to configure apps to ask every time they require access
- A transparency indicator when one app is controlling another app using System & App Protection Override
Apple stressed that app permissions previously granted by users will remain intact, adding that developers should be prepared to make changes to their onboarding workflows to ensure their apps can handle scenarios where access is granted to only a limited set of folders or apps via these APIs.
In addition, apps that use Full Disk Access for disk backup or the new Accessibility settings for assistive technologies can request entitlements to offer the same experience for new installations that they offered before macOS 27.3.
"Currently, known apps aren't affected and will keep the same experience without an entitlement," the tech giant added. "Additional entitlement details will be available soon."
The development comes a little over a month after Apple began taking steps to tighten controls around the Full Disk Access macOS setting due to security risks posed by artificial intelligence (AI) agents.

articles.title: Roblox fait l’objet de près de 200 poursuites liées à des accusations d’exploitation sexuelle de mineurs
articles.text:
Près de 200 familles américaines accusent Roblox d’avoir laissé des adultes se faire passer pour des enfants sur sa plateforme afin d’approcher les leurs. Mais l’entreprise exige de régler ces litiges loin des tribunaux, et deux sénateurs veulent l’en empêcher.
Le républicain Josh Hawley et le démocrate Dick Durbin enquêtent sur Roblox depuis août, et ils avaient invité son patron, David Baszucki, à témoigner mardi devant la sous-commission du Sénat américain chargée de la criminalité et du terrorisme. David Baszucki a décliné. « Il pense peut-être qu’il est silencieux, mais en réalité, il témoigne, et ce à quoi il témoigne, c’est de sa priorité donnée à l’argent plutôt qu’aux personnes », a raillé Josh Hawley, qui préside cette sous-commission.
Avec leur projet de loi, les deux sénateurs veulent permettre aux familles de victimes de poursuivre Roblox en justice, au lieu de passer par l’arbitrage, une procédure privée sans procès public, que Roblox impose dans ses conditions d’utilisation. Et d’après Roblox, plus d’un tiers de ses joueurs quotidiens dont l’âge a été vérifié ont moins de 13 ans, et ont accepté ces conditions en créant leur compte.
Roblox oppose ses conditions d’utilisation aux familles
Devant la justice, Roblox a fait valoir qu’en acceptant ses conditions d’utilisation, ses joueurs renoncent à leur droit de saisir un tribunal. « Il est impossible qu’un enfant de 8 ans puisse lire ces termes et renoncer ensuite à son droit à un procès », s’est indignée la sénatrice républicaine Katie Britt, une copie du contrat de plusieurs pages entre les mains.
Spécialiste de l’arbitrage forcé, Myriam Gilles enseigne le droit à l’université Northwestern, et elle n’aurait « jamais imaginé devoir comparaître devant cette instance pour parler de son utilisation contre des enfants de 9 ans ». Josh Hawley et Dick Durbin proposent d’interdire l’arbitrage forcé dans les affaires d’exploitation sexuelle d’enfants et de préjudices subis en ligne.
Auprès de Wired, Sara Kanawati Stephany, responsable de la communication politique de Roblox aux États-Unis, estime qu’« une position juridique concernant l’arbitrage ne reflète pas le bilan d’une entreprise en matière de sécurité ». L’entreprise ajoute qu’elle bloque les images et les vidéos dans les conversations, et qu’elle crée pour les moins de 16 ans des comptes protégés par défaut.
D’anciens joueurs racontent avoir été manipulés par des adultes sur Roblox
Michael Schlep avait 12 ans quand un développeur de jeux s’est lié d’amitié avec lui dans un salon de discussion public de Roblox, avant de poursuivre la conversation en privé. Devant les sénateurs, ce créateur de contenu a raconté avoir ensuite été exposé à de la pornographie violente et à des idéologies racistes extrêmes. Il dénonce aujourd’hui sur YouTube des pédocriminels présumés de la plateforme, ce qui lui a valu une mise en demeure de Roblox.
Un ancien Marine, entendu sous le pseudonyme de Woody Doe, a affirmé avoir été manipulé puis agressé sexuellement à 11 ans par un adulte rencontré sur le jeu. Il poursuit Roblox, à qui il reproche de ne pas avoir averti les parents et les enfants des dangers de la plateforme.
En France, la haute-commissaire à l’Enfance, Sarah El Haïry, avait parlé en janvier d’un « repaire de pédocriminels ». Roblox a ouvert depuis aux enfants français des comptes Kids sans chat pour les moins de 9 ans, et des comptes Select pour les 9-15 ans.
Pour accéder au chat, Roblox exige en outre une estimation de l’âge par analyse du visage. Khari James, conseillère juridique principale au National Center on Sexual Exploitation, une association américaine, doute de la fiabilité de cette technologie. Selon elle, un prédateur peut acheter un compte vérifié, et cette seule vérification lui donne « un accès total à tous les enfants présents sur Roblox ». « Roblox est peut-être un monde virtuel, mais les enfants sont bien réels », résume Khari James.
- Des dizaines de milions de jeux disponibles dans le catalogue.
- Les échanges de messages et d'objets virtuels entre utilisateurs.
- La possibilité de créer des jeux sans compétence avancée de codage.

My clues will help you solve the NYT's Connections puzzle today and keep that streak going

- GREEN: THINGS BEES PRODUCE: BUZZ, COMB, HONEY, VENOM

What is NYT Connections?
NYT Connections is one of several increasingly popular word games made by the New York Times. It challenges you to find groups of four items that share something in common, and each group has a different difficulty level: green is easy, yellow a little harder, blue often quite tough and purple usually very difficult.
On the plus side, you don't technically need to solve the final one, as you'll be able to answer that one by a process of elimination. What's more, you can make up to four mistakes, which gives you a little bit of breathing room.
It's a little more involved than something like Wordle, however, and there are plenty of opportunities for the game to trip you up with tricks. For instance, watch out for homophones and other word games that could disguise the answers.
It's playable for free via the NYT Games site on desktop or mobile.

NVIDIA DLSS gives GeForce RTX and RTX Spark the highest levels of image quality, and a range of options for accelerating performance. This week, we're highlighting the launch of EVE Vanguard's 24/7 alpha, which is accelerated and enhanced by DLSS 4.5, and bringing you news of DLSS 4.5 upgrades and additions for Assetto Corsa Rally, Blender, Lightyear Frontier, and Teardown.

Fenris Creations' EVE Vanguard is an extraction-adventure FPS set in the universe of the long-running EVE Online. Players deploy as technologically immortal Warclones onto hostile planetary surfaces to complete high-risk missions, secure resources, battle rival players and hostile forces, and build strength between deployments through persistent progression. Player actions will contribute to an evolving conflict across New Eden.
Gamers looking to play the game ahead of its 2027 Steam release can play now via the EVE launcher by purchasing a Founder Pack, which gives alpha access to the game. To accelerate performance and enhance image quality on GeForce RTX systems, this initial release includes support for DLSS 4.5 with Super Resolution, Multi Frame Generation, DLAA, and Reflex.
Assetto Corsa Rally Upgrades To DLSS 4.5 & Adds Dynamic Multi Frame Generation
505 Games and Supernova Games Studios' Assetto Corsa Rally delivers an uncompromising rally simulation that captures the raw intensity and precision of the sport. Developed in technical partnership with Kunos Simulazioni, Assetto Corsa Rally was developed on the base of Assetto Corsa's acclaimed physics engine, specifically refined for the needs of this motorsports discipline, and a customized build of Unreal Engine 5.
Assetto Corsa Rally introduces a rally-specific chapter to the Assetto Corsa franchise, designed to deliver a demanding and immersive experience where weather, road, and car setups all matter and dedicated driver training and skills are a key element to succeed in driving. From the gravel stages of Wales to the tarmac stages of Alsace, Assetto Corsa Rally introduces 3D laser-scanned stages & meticulously modelled vehicles, professional co-driver support, and realistic dynamics for FWD, RWD, and AWD vehicles. Every second on the road is a high-stakes challenge, where surface grip, weather, and time of day constantly impact your every decision.
Assetto Corsa Rally launched into Early Access last year with DLSS 4 with Multi Frame Generation, Frame Generation, and Super Resolution. Coming soon, its suite of tech will be upgraded to DLSS 4.5 for enhanced image quality and performance, and support for Dynamic Multi Frame Generation will be added, further optimizing each racer's experience.

Blender is a free, open source, with a suite of industry-leading tools for 3D modelling and rendering, used for the creation of content and effects for TV, film, and many other disciplines.

Like GeForce RTX gamers, RTX Spark users can activate DLSS 4.5 Super Resolution and Dynamic Multi Frame Generation, and NVIDIA Reflex, accelerating and enhancing gameplay.

FRAME BREAK's Lightyear Frontier is an open-world farming adventure set on a planet at the far edge of the galaxy. GeForce Rewards - Claim A War Thunder Ready For Battle Pack While Supplies Last
