articles.title: Hijacked Optimizely Scripts Served Card Skimmer and iOS Exploit Kits to CNN, BBC and Zoom Visitors
articles.text:
An attacker exploited a flaw in Optimizely Web Experimentation to plant malicious code in some of the scripts that customers' websites load from the service, Optimizely said early today.
Visitors to sites run by at least 178 organizations, including CNN, the BBC and Zoom, received the code yesterday, according to Report URI, a firm that monitors the scripts websites run.
The code was built to replace crypto wallet addresses with the attacker's own addresses and to capture card details, but the firm cannot see how many card numbers were exposed to the attacker. The vendor says it has fixed the flaw and removed the code.
On iPhones and iPads, the code was also set up to load a second stage that the firm identifies as an iOS exploit kit, but it reports no iPhones actually being taken over.
In an incident notice posted at 01:02 UTC, Optimizely said the attacker had "exploited a vulnerability in Experimentation" and used it to add malicious JavaScript to some customer projects.
The vendor has also taken steps to secure affected user accounts and added protections to stop unauthorized code from being delivered. The notice does not say how the flaw worked, how many projects were changed, when the fix went in, whether the attacker still has any access, or what customers should do.
Smartsheet's script was cleaned once and then re-infected with a hidden version of the code, which indicates the attacker still had access at that point, according to the firm.
Writing before the notice appeared, the firm said it did not know how the attacker got write access to so many unrelated customer projects: "That's for Optimizely to explain."
Sites that use the service to run experiments on their pages load a script from the vendor, called a snippet. The snippet updates itself whenever the customer changes a setting, according to the vendor's snippet documentation. Each time it loads, it runs a field of custom code called Project JavaScript.
The attacker wrote a loader into the Project JavaScript of customer projects and left the rest of each snippet untouched, Report URI said in its technical analysis. The snippets were still served from cdn.optimizely.com with the vendor's own certificate, so every page that loaded one also ran the loader.
Some sites serve the snippet from their own domain, and those were affected too, because the content comes from the same project.
The loader came in three versions. Most snippets loaded 1688360[.]cc/track.js directly, one version hid that address in base64 so a text search for the domain would miss it, and another carried a full copy of the payload that runs if the domain is blocked.
Cynet, whose endpoint detection flagged browser connections to the attacker's server, traced the loader to a file served from cdn.optimizely.com in an endpoint investigation. Its researchers also captured the code on CNN and Zoom pages. A site that delivered the code has not necessarily had its own systems compromised, the researchers say.
The firm checked 1,611 Optimizely snippets, mostly identified through its own crawl data, and found code in 188 of them, belonging to 178 organizations. It says the real number is likely higher because it could only check the snippets it found in time. Its post lists all 178, with their domains.
Besides CNN, the BBC and Zoom, the infected snippets belonged to Salesforce, GitLab, IKEA, HSBC, Equifax, Air France-KLM, Ledger and Peacock, among others. The vendor's own main site and login page also carried the code. Some researchers call the campaign OPTIMJACK.
The first injection was seen at 04:21 UTC yesterday, in the BBC's snippet. A mass cleanup began at about 20:40 UTC, and by 21:52 UTC only TalkTalk's snippet still carried the code.
That first injection loaded webshell[.]lol, which the firm calls the same actor's injector. The injector had also been planted through Kissmetrics, StorifyMe and Minute Media scripts since late last week, and it first appeared on Turkish sites on September 17.
The payload, a file called track.js, replaces valid crypto wallet addresses with the attacker's in page text, forms, links, the clipboard and outgoing requests.
It swaps only an address that passes its chain's checksum and sits near a payment word such as wallet, deposit or send, according to a payload analysis by StepSecurity. Copying is not safe either: an address a visitor copies from one of these pages may already be the attacker's by the time it is pasted into a wallet.
A card skimmer, added at 13:43 UTC, captures the card number, expiry date, and CVV when they are submitted via the site's form fields and sends them to the attacker's server. It cannot read cards entered in a cross-origin payment iframe, such as Stripe's hosted fields or Adyen's.
The code sends the visitor's cookies and a screenshot of the page to the attacker only after it swaps an address near wallet or payment wording. It cannot read cookies marked HttpOnly.
The firm identifies the iOS exploit kits as Coruna and DarkSword, as documented by Google researchers. The Coruna exploit kit targets iOS 13.0 to 17.2.1, and the DarkSword exploit kit targets iOS 18.4 to 18.7.
On iPhones and iPads, the code loads a script called boot.js from two .icu domains. That script reads the iOS version and opens an exploit chain in a hidden iframe: Coruna for iOS 13 to 17, DarkSword for iOS 18, and, for iOS 26, a separate chain that so far only collects details about the device.
Between 17:13 and 17:57 UTC, the attacker also added a Coruna iframe to every visit from iOS 18.6 or earlier. Those pages reload every 60 seconds to retry the exploit, a sign a visitor could notice. The kit's own comments mark iOS 18.7.3 and later, and iOS 26.3 and later, as patched, according to the firm.
Cynet's researchers retrieved the second stage using an emulated iPhone browser and describe what they saw as conditional delivery, "not a successful compromise of a physical iPhone or iPad."
The firm says crypto has already been stolen. As of 19:25 UTC yesterday, the attacker's wallets had received about $7,040, all within roughly nine hours.
StepSecurity put the total across the same addresses at about $6,600. Two of the addresses were already in use before the injections began, and its analysts wrote that "the chain does not show which transfers came from victims."
What Site Owners and Visitors Should Check
Report URI recommends these checks for sites that use Optimizely Web Experimentation:
- Open the Project JavaScript in every project and the custom code in every experiment, and look for 1688360, atob( or any script you did not write. The atob( check finds the base64 version of the loader.
- Review which users, API tokens and integrations can write to your account, and rotate their credentials.
- If your own forms take card details, treat cards entered on Monday as possibly exposed.
- Treat session tokens or other secrets kept in cookies without the HttpOnly flag as exposed, and rotate them.
- Deploy a Content Security Policy with a strict script-src and connect-src. Allowing cdn.optimizely.com does not help, because the code came from that host, and strict-dynamic or unsafe-eval let the payload run on some sites.
- Consider telling your customers that your site served them the code.
The firm kept a copy of every infected snippet, with hashes and timestamps, and could share them with affected organizations and CERTs (computer emergency response teams) on request.
For anyone who visited an affected site on Monday, the firm advises:
- Update iPhones and iPads to iOS 18.7.3 or later, or iOS 26.3 or later.
- Compare any crypto payment made that day with the address you meant to pay. If the two differ, the address may have been swapped.
- If you paid by card on one of the sites, watch your card statements.
A snippet that is clean now may still have served the code on Monday. StepSecurity also advises:
- Block the indicators below, and search logs back to 08:00 UTC on Monday.
- Fetch every snippet you serve, search it for 1688360, .icu and track.js, and record its Last-Modified header.
- Ask Optimizely which of your project IDs were changed, and when and how.
- Keep third-party tags off checkout pages, and take card details through the payment provider's own fields in a cross-origin iframe.
- Replace any card entered on an affected site on Monday, and check wallet addresses on a hardware wallet's screen rather than against copied text.
- Consider having iPhones and iPads on iOS 18.6 or earlier that visited affected sites checked for signs of compromise.
Cynet treats cdn.optimizely.com as a legitimate delivery host rather than an indicator, and it advises against broad blocks of that host or of the affected news sites.
The payload changed multiple times during the day, so a single file hash will not capture every version. These indicators come from the researchers' published lists:
- Domain: 1688360[.]cc, the payload host, with the paths /track.js, /card.php and /hit.php
- IP: 136.113.106[.]136, the address 1688360[.]cc pointed to
- Domain: 5vobauua3ojpklx[.]icu, iOS stage
- Domain: eil786npto9u5bq[.]icu, iOS stage
- Domain: webshell[.]lol, the injector loaded by the first injection, seen at 04:21 UTC on Monday
- SHA-256: f7b84b9a94f749f8ced3f0112d0a66894e8bbc3b4aa5592021d1b8976a9bad40, final version of track.js
- SHA-256: 617df364120adc47fb4f55dcc0c69a9b6c9e108a92c60bc2b64a266254ab02f3, earliest captured version of track.js

articles.title: Junta directiva de Nvidia “no pretende restituir a Jensen Huang como CEO”
articles.text:
La junta directiva de Nvidia confirmó este martes 17 de noviembre que no pretende restituir a Jensen Huang como director ejecutivo de la compañía, pese a una campaña pública para su regreso tras la dimisión que presentó la semana pasada. La decisión se dio a conocer durante la conferencia telefónica de resultados trimestrales de la empresa, informó Reuters.
El presidente de la junta directiva, Harvey Jones, explicó que Jensen Huang “renunció voluntariamente a sus puestos de presidente, CEO y miembro de la junta” la semana pasada. Según Jones, el órgano directivo aceptó la dimisión por unanimidad y “no pretende restituir a Jensen como CEO”.
Jones expresó su confianza en Colette Kress, jefa financiera de la empresa, quien ocupa de manera interina el cargo de directora ejecutiva. El presidente de la junta describió el episodio como una “transición inesperada” y sostuvo que el órgano directivo actúa en beneficio de Nvidia en este proceso.
La compañía contrató a una firma especializada para “dirigir la búsqueda” de un líder “permanente” que suceda a Huang al frente de la empresa de semiconductores. Jones no detalló un plazo para concluir ese proceso ni adelantó nombres de posibles candidatos.
Horas antes de la conferencia telefónica, Huang había emitido un comunicado en el que se dijo dispuesto a volver a dirigir Nvidia si la junta directiva tomaba esa decisión. En el mismo texto, agradeció las “llamadas de empleados, inversores, socios y clientes para que vuelva como CEO”, en referencia a la campaña que surgió tras conocerse su salida de la compañía.
Los sucesos que motivaron la salida de Jensen Huang
La salida de Huang se produjo luego de que se lo vinculara con una relación sentimental con Alice Huang, exdirectora ejecutiva de Megaspeed, una empresa de centros de datos con sede en Singapur. Ambos comparten apellido, pero no tienen parentesco.
Alice Huang fue señalada por funcionarios estadounidenses, según información publicada por The New York Times, como una presunta espía reclutada por la principal agencia de inteligencia de China; Bloomberg News informó que la mujer reside actualmente en ese país. Su empresa, además, fue objeto de sospechas por presuntamente ayudar a desviar chips de Nvidia hacia territorio chino, un asunto que la compañía afirmó haber investigado y descartado.
El gobierno de Singapur publicó un comunicado en el que precisó que Alice Huang sí fue investigada en el país, aunque no por espionaje, sino por una pesquisa vinculada a posibles declaraciones falsas en la compra de servidores informáticos, que también abarcó a varias empresas, entre ellas Megaspeed.
Las autoridades le retiraron el pasaporte en junio de 2025 para impedir que abandonara el país mientras duraban las investigaciones. En febrero de este año concluyeron que no existían pruebas suficientes de delitos relacionados con esas declaraciones, aunque determinaron que la mujer “proporcionó información que sabía que era inexacta... con el fin de minimizar su papel en Megaspeed”. Recibió una advertencia severa y una prohibición de ingreso a Singapur; le devolvieron el pasaporte el 26 de febrero y abandonó el país ese mismo día.
El domingo previo a su renuncia, Huang había admitido haberle sido infiel a su esposa y pidió disculpas por haberla lastimado a ella y a sus hijos. Días después, The New York Times publicó que el ejecutivo mantuvo otra relación sentimental con una empleada de su propia compañía. Nvidia ya investiga el vínculo que Huang reconoció públicamente, mientras el FBI realiza sus propias pesquisas sobre el caso.
El consejo de administración de la empresa había señalado previamente que las interacciones de Huang con Alice Huang “no eran inusuales ni inesperadas”, antes de que se conociera la magnitud del escándalo; tras la publicación de The New York Times el fin de semana del 8 y 9 de noviembre, el directorio inició una investigación externa independiente.

articles.title: Apple en panne : iCloud, App Store et Apple Music touchés par une vaste interruption
articles.text:
Retaper le mot de passe de votre compte Apple sur votre iPhone ne vous a peut-être servi à rien. Apple affirme que cette panne, ressentie jusqu’en France, vient d’une mise à jour de ses systèmes internes, et non d’une cyberattaque.
Des internautes ont signalé les premiers dysfonctionnements vers 17 h 45, heure de Paris. Apple a d’abord indiqué que tous ses services fonctionnaient, avant de reconnaître sur sa page d’état du système un problème de connexion au compte iCloud pour « tous les utilisateurs », et des pannes sur l’App Store, Apple Music et AppleCare. Puis l’entreprise a ajouté iCloud Mail, le site iCloud.com et plusieurs services destinés aux écoles et aux entreprises. Les signalements recensés par Downdetector portaient aussi sur des difficultés avec Apple Pay et l’assistance d’Apple. Et sans accès à votre compte Apple, vous ne pouvez plus vous connecter non plus aux autres services où vous utilisez cet identifiant, selon TechCrunch.
Les conseillers des Apple Store privés de leurs outils de vente
Apple n’a donné aucun détail sur la mise à jour à l’origine de la panne, mais ses salariés l’ont subie eux aussi. D’après Bloomberg, Apple a dû rétablir à la fois les systèmes de ses employés et vos services. Dans ses boutiques, les clients n’ont pas pu finaliser leurs achats.
À l’Apple Store du Marché Saint-Germain, à Paris, les conseillers ne pouvaient plus se servir des applications avec lesquelles ils encaissent les ventes et gèrent les retraits de commande, a raconté un lecteur à MacGeneration. Selon lui, toutes les boutiques françaises étaient touchées, une information que le site n’a pas pu vérifier. Les signalements concernaient aussi GSX, le logiciel avec lequel Apple gère les réparations, et l’activation des appareils. Des acheteurs d’un nouvel iPhone ont ainsi expliqué sur Reddit qu’ils ne parvenaient pas à l’activer.
Apple écarte la piste d’une cyberattaque
Sur les réseaux sociaux, certains ont soupçonné un piratage, cinq jours après la panne mondiale de Microsoft 365, qui avait privé de messagerie de nombreuses entreprises dans plus de 70 pays. Microsoft avait lui aussi relié cette panne à une intervention sur son réseau, et non à un pirate. Dans un communiqué transmis à Bloomberg, Apple dément toute attaque. « La plupart de nos systèmes sont de nouveau opérationnels après les interruptions de service survenues ce matin suite à une mise à jour interne », assure l’entreprise, qui promet de rétablir les autres « au plus vite ». En début de soirée, heure de Paris, Apple signalait encore des pannes sur sa page d’état pour iCloud Mail, iCloud.com, AppleCare et ses outils pour les entreprises et les écoles.
Le 10 novembre, iCloud Mail, Photos et la connexion au compte Apple avaient connu une première panne de près de deux heures et demie. Et on vous rapportait une panne de tous les services d'Apple en janvier dernier. Et après l’incident de Microsoft, des escrocs ont envoyé de faux e-mails qui promettaient de récupérer vos messages bloqués, et Microsoft a alerté ses clients. Si vous devez retaper votre mot de passe Apple dans les prochains jours, faites-le uniquement dans les Réglages de votre iPhone, jamais à partir d’un lien reçu par e-mail ou par SMS.
En attendant, à l'heure où on vous écrit cet article, les services touchés fonctionnent à nouveau normalement.

articles.title: Zelda: Ocarina of Time Remake Tops US Physical Sales for 2026
articles.text:
Tuesday, November 17th 2026
Zelda: Ocarina of Time Remake Tops US Physical Sales for 2026
The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time Remake sold over 1 million physical copies in the US during its launch week, according to data shared by Circana's Mat Piscatella on Bluesky. That single week was enough to make it the best-selling physical game of 2026 in the US, and it didn't even need a full week. The data runs through November 7, so the figure only covers the first three days after the game's November 5 launch. It's the first game to pass 1 million physical units in a US launch week since The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom in 2023. These are numbers for physical copies only, so digital sales are, of course, excluded. Nintendo already announced 5.2 million total units sold in four days, which was the best four-day haul for any Nintendo-published Switch 2 game so far.
Like everything else in the gaming space right now, Ocarina of Time Remake has to watch out for Grand Theft Auto VI. Rockstar's game launches on November 19, but it does not have a physical edition in the true sense of the word. Its boxed edition comes with just a download code, but that may not be a problem for Circana's data. According to Piscatella, Circana counts the code-in-a-box products as physical software, alongside discs, carts, and Switch 2 game-key cards. He separately argued that fans of physical media should be glad that game-key cards and code-in-a-box releases are selling well, since that may keep physical retail around for just a bit longer. Nintendo has said that it has no plans to end Switch 2 physical game releases, while Sony is ending disc production for new PlayStation games in 2028.

articles.title: ConnectWise Warns ScreenConnect Attacks Continue as SCKit Targets Unpatched Systems
articles.text:
ConnectWise on Monday said it completed its investigation into unauthorized access targeting partner ScreenConnect environments, and recommended customers to ensure that the technician client is running version 26.6.5 or later.
The company said additional activity targeting on-premises environments continues to be reported where the identified third-party extensions remain enabled and ScreenConnect has not been updated to the latest version.
"On-premises partners must immediately disable the identified extensions and update ScreenConnect to the latest supported version," the company said.
It's worth noting that version 26.6.5 addresses a critical-severity flaw in ScreenConnect client tracked as CVE-2026-84869 (CVSS score: 9.9) that could allow files to be transferred and executed through an active remote session without authorization or Host confirmation in certain circumstances.
As highlighted by Huntress and Blackpoint Cyber last week, unknown threat actors are suspected to be exploiting an authentication flaw in RMM+ versions 1.0.31 and 1.0.32 to execute unauthorized commands while bypassing ScreenConnect's regular authentication controls.
The attacks have been found to deploy a multi-component toolkit dubbed SCKit that's capable of spreading from infected customer devices to MSP technicians' computers and compromising additional managed networks by means of a C# module called RelayTrap ("RelayTrap.cs").
Specifically, the malware employs a worm-like technique that exploits CVE-2026-84869 to execute malicious code on a technician's workstation when they connect to an infected device to investigate a problem. There is no evidence this worm-like behavior has succeeded in the latest campaign.
Huntress has since said it detected another spike in SCKit-related activity on November 13, 2026, impacting 205 hosts across 41 organizations.
"Across the incidents, we saw the new ScreenConnect client being hosted at 185.241.211[.]197, which is associated with 1337 Services GmbH, a bulletproof hosting provider known for previously hosting malicious traffic," the company said.
"In one of the incidents, we saw a rogue ScreenConnect client establish persistence via a service called Windows Update Agent, posing as a legitimate system component. The service executable (UpdateConnect.ClientService.exe) was placed in C:\ProgramData\Windows Update Agent (de362a425905bcc4)\ and configured to run under the LocalSystem account."
In response to the incident, ConnectWise has taken the step of disabling five third-party extensions, including Labtech Plus, RMM Plus, RMM+, RMM Plus Password Link, and RMM+ Password Link, across 400 partner environments. That said, the presence of these extensions alone does not imply those environments were impacted.
The company is also urging partners not to re-enable or reinstall the extensions until further guidance. "Disabling extensions and updating software do not remove unauthorized access or persistence already established on affected devices," it added.

articles.title: ¿El fin del mentor tradicional? Cómo la IA está hackeando la incubación de startups en el Perú
articles.text:
Imaginemos a un equipo emprendedor cualquiera, en cualquier ciudad de Sudamérica, tiene la suerte de ser aceptado por una incubadora en Lima se debe postular para alcanzar una plaza y le tocan sus primeras sesiones de mentoría con tres de los mentores de turno. El primero le recomienda salir al mercado y empezar a vender, el segundo cree que les falta más investigación para definir su cliente objetivo y el último le dice que todo está bien, pero “sería mejor crear planes más atractivos”. Los tres tienen años en la incubadora y muy buenas intenciones, pero, el equipo termina sus tres primeras mentorías con más dudas que certezas: ¿a quién crees que le hicieron caso?
Una buena incubadora de negocios se sustenta por su amplia y sólida red de mentores, profesionales, con experiencia en múltiples industrias, capaces de orientar en las distintas etapas de un proyecto. Y siempre serán fundamentales. El problema surge cuando esa orientación depende más de las creencias y sesgos de cada mentor que de la información disponible sobre el negocio.
Desde el 2019, he participado en procesos de incubación y evaluación de emprendimientos y por eso estas situaciones me son muy familiares.
El ayudar a otros, es una actividad que necesita empatía, cercanía y humanidad y, precisamente por eso, lo llevamos a nuestra forma personal de ver el mundo. Tendemos a interpretar los problemas desde lo que conocemos, desde lo que vivimos o desde lo que nos marcó en nuestra profesión.
No juzgo el valor de la experiencia sería absurdo hacerlo, lo que no encaja con la incubación de negocios es convertirla en una especie de verdad que el emprendedor debe aceptar sin mayor discusión.
Entonces me pregunto: ¿estamos ayudando a tomar mejores decisiones o estamos dándoles las respuestas desde nuestras convicciones?
El problema no somos los mentores, es la forma en que ayudamos.
Imaginemos una incubadora universitaria que convoca cien proyectos y cuenta con veinte mentores / docentes. Los emprendimientos son diferentes entre si, pero todos necesitan definir qué problema resuelven, quién lo sufre, qué otras soluciones existen y qué tendencias los favorecen en el mercado.
Si cada mentor utiliza criterios diferentes ¿cómo podemos comparar los avances de esos cien proyectos?
Se vuelve una tarea más que complicada.
Incluso si existe una metodología institucional, aplicarla puede variar de un mentor a otro, de un proyecto a otro, de un programa a otro.
Una startup va a recibir una valoración favorable de un mentor y una mala de otro. ¿Cambió el proyecto? No. Lo que cambió fue la persona que la evaluó.
Durante mucho tiempo, esto era imposible de resolver. Hoy tenemos herramientas que vienen a aliviar todo este proceso y así aparece la inteligencia artificial en la incubación
La IA ha venido a abrir posibilidades que hace tres o cuatro años parecían imposibles. Hoy se pueden desarrollar plataformas capaces de, a partir de la información de los propios emprendimientos, contrastarla con criterios establecidos propios o de manual e identificar donde deben actuar los mentores.
¿Esto no significa que la IA puede determinar si un negocio tendrá éxito? No, pero nunca va a tener sesgos por su experiencia previa. Su respuesta dependerá de la calidad y consistencia de los datos, de los parámetros utilizados y de la capacidad humana para tomar decisiones.
Con un “filtro IA” previo, en lugar de iniciar una mentoría preguntando de qué trata el proyecto, el especialista podría iniciar con un diagnóstico estándar de enfoque de mercado, revisar los riesgos y concentrarse en aquello que realmente necesita atención según su expertise.
Desde fuera, no parece un cambio espectacular, pero va a transformar la manera en que usamos el recurso más escaso de cualquier programa de incubación: el tiempo del equipo y de los mentores.
Las universidades latinoamericanas comienzan el cambio
En Lima, algunas universidades ya están probando soluciones de IA como herramientas de apoyo, tanto para sus procesos de incubación como para sus clases de emprendimiento.
La intención es optimizar la evaluación, medir el enfoque de mercado y ofrecer a los mentores mejores elementos de juicio para ayudar con más claridad a los emprendedores.
Por eso, no imagino incubadoras sin mentores. Imagino mentores que llegan mejor preparados a sus sesiones, que cuentan con mejor información y que pueden dedicar más tiempo a ayudar a los emprendedores a interpretar lo que está ocurriendo.
Eso sí, también tendrán que acostumbrarse a algo que será incómodo sustentar sus recomendaciones con evidencias y reconocer cuándo una opinión personal no aplica.
En Montevideo, también se están explorando desarrollos propios desde el ámbito universitario y ya es tecnología estándar junto a sus metodologías de acompañamiento.
Todavía es temprano para determinar qué impacto tendrán estas experiencias, pero una incubadora que sistematiza sus metodologías y registra sus avances puede aprender de cada generación de startups, identificar brechas comunes, mejorar progresivamente la calidad de los proyectos y, en conjunto, conocer el efecto real del acompañamiento.
Por supuesto, la tecnología no resolverá por sí sola todas las limitaciones de los ecosistemas latinoamericanos. Seguiremos necesitando mentores, redes de contacto, acceso a inversión y mejores condiciones para emprender. Pero disponer de información más ordenada puede ayudarnos a utilizar esos recursos más eficientemente y con mayor criterio.
Después de todo, el verdadero propósito de una mentoría no es conseguir que el emprendedor piense como su mentor, sino ayudarlo a desarrollar el criterio necesario para construir su propio camino.

articles.title: GPT-6.2 arrive dans ChatGPT et Codex : quand choisir Sol et quand passer à Astra ?
articles.text:
OpenAI renouvelle ses deux modèles pour le travail. Sol a de sérieux arguments pour rester le choix du quotidien, y compris pour les développeurs. Astra, lui, se distingue dès qu’on lui confie tout un dossier.
Vous avez une présentation à rendre, les chiffres du trimestre dans un fichier et, pour toute consigne, un « reprends celle de la dernière fois ». C’est précisément le genre de corvée qu’OpenAI a choisi de montrer pour présenter GPT-6.2. Et pour une fois, on peut juger sur pièces : les diapositives de l’ancienne et de la nouvelle version d’Astra sont consultables côte à côte. Mais avant de se précipiter sur le plus ambitieux des deux modèles, son petit frère mérite qu’on s’y arrête.
Sol a de bonnes raisons de rester votre premier choix
GPT-6.2 Sol prend la relève de GPT-6.1 Sol. OpenAI promet qu’à abonnement égal, on pourra lui confier davantage de tâches avant d’atteindre son plafond. L’explication tient en partie à la quantité de texte que le modèle doit générer pour arriver au bout d’une demande. Pour qui a déjà vu son quota fondre au beau milieu d’un projet, l’argument a de quoi faire tendre l’oreille. Reste à savoir combien on y gagnera sur ses propres dossiers.
Le chiffre le plus parlant vient du développement logiciel. Sur FrontierCode 2.0, l’exercice consiste à modifier un projet existant avec une exigence assez terre à terre : est-ce qu’un responsable du projet accepterait la modification en l’état ? D’après les résultats présentés par OpenAI, avec les deux modèles poussés à leur niveau de raisonnement maximal, Sol termine à un demi-point d’Astra pour environ un cinquième du coût. De quoi commencer par Sol quand on travaille dans Codex et réserver Astra aux problèmes qui résistent.
Ce qu’Astra change dans un document qu’on doit vraiment rendre
Revenons à notre présentation. Dans l’exemple publié par OpenAI, les deux générations d’Astra repèrent qu’un remboursement de droits de douane a gonflé le bénéfice du distributeur. La différence se joue ensuite dans la diapositive elle-même. La nouvelle version fait ressortir la hausse de 5,3 % des ventes dès le titre et distingue ce qui vient des magasins et du commerce en ligne. Surtout, elle en tire une consigne pour le prochain budget : évitez de compter sur un deuxième remboursement. Voilà une diapo dont on comprend l’intérêt avant même que quelqu’un prenne la parole.
Il y a tout de même une bonne raison de vérifier le résultat produit par l'IA : Dans sa fiche d’évaluation, OpenAI décrit deux tests où les nouveaux modèles ont plus souvent passé sous silence un obstacle rencontré en cours de route. Par exemple, le fichier qu’on leur demandait de modifier manquait à l’appel. Des consignes ajoutées dans Codex ont réduit le phénomène, selon l'éditeur, mais quand une présentation doit partir chez un client, on préférera tout de même savoir dès le départ s’il manque une pièce au dossier.
Qui peut les utiliser, et à quel prix ?
Les deux modèles arrivent dans ChatGPT Work et Codex pour les abonnés Plus, Pro, Enterprise et Edu. La nouveauté pour les abonnés Pro 200, c’est l’accès au mode Ultrafast sur Sol, tandis que l’offre Pro 500 donne accès à ce mode accéléré sur les deux modèles. En entreprise et dans l’enseignement, les utilisateurs éligibles pourront en profiter une fois l’option activée par leur administrateur.
Pour les développeurs qui passent par l’API, Sol conserve les tarifs de son prédécesseur : 2 dollars par million de tokens en entrée et 10 dollars en sortie. Astra descend à 8 et 40 dollars respectivement, soit une baisse de 20 % par rapport à GPT-6 Astra. À volume égal, le calcul est donc vite fait : Astra coûte encore quatre fois le prix de Sol. Tout l’enjeu est de savoir combien d’allers-retours il vous épargnera sur le travail qui vous attend.
- Assistant IA extrêmement polyvalent
- Fonctionnalités gratuites nombreuses
- Automatisation de tâches complexes

articles.title: 'Oil wells that never run dry': Syntholene's CEO says one geothermal borehole can make unlimited jet fuel — but the company's Iceland plant has only made hydrogen so far
articles.text:
'Oil wells that never run dry': Syntholene's CEO says one geothermal borehole can make unlimited jet fuel — but the company's Iceland plant has only made hydrogen so far
"Unlimited fuel, forever": Syntholene's CEO makes a bold pitch
- Syntholene CEO Dan Sutton claims a single 10MW geothermal well equals about 200 football fields of desert solar and can feed "unlimited fuel, forever"
- Syntholene's Iceland demo has produced hydrogen and passed a company-funded Imperial College review, but has not produced synthetic fuel, and the review gave no costs
- The company has not named its carbon source, and its biggest customer link, Icelandair, is a non-binding letter conditional on scale and price
Dan Sutton, cofounder and CEO of the Canadian-listed synthetic fuel startup Syntholene, has a big claim for a single, albeit massive, hole in the ground.
In a post on X, he shared a clip of what he called a 10MW geothermal borehole and said it matches roughly 200 football fields of solar panels in the world's sunniest desert, plus another five fields of batteries to keep the output steady.
Sutton added that the well could deliver baseload energy for more than a century if well maintained, and that Syntholene's process is designed to turn wells like it into "low-cost oil wells that never run dry," signing off with the statement that "This is how we make unlimited fuel. Forever."
The math checks out, but the reading might be overwhelmingly optimistic
The post lands less than a month after Syntholene published a paid independent review of its demonstration plant in Iceland, and it is worth considering the message on its merits, with scrutiny in tow, as a message from the CEO of a company whose most recent private placement raised about $2.3 million at $0.45 per unit.
Some of the claims hold up better than one might be expected, but the most important one, the part where the geothermal well becomes an oil well, has not been demonstrated yet.
For starters, the post does not mention whether it is considering the 10MW mentioned as electricity or heat, a distinction that matters considerably when doing the math.
A 10MW electrical well running at a 90% capacity factor would produce about 79GWh a year. That capacity factor is realistic for mature geothermal: Calpine's 2025 figures for The Geysers in California show 5,471,562 net MWh generated in 2024 from a maximum capacity of 694 net MW, which works out to roughly 90%.
Sign up to the TechRadar Pro newsletter to get all the top news, opinion, features and guidance your business needs to succeed!
The most cited US data on solar land use, from NREL's 2013 study, found that generation-weighted solar plants need about 3.5 acres per GWh per year on average, and large fixed-tilt PV around 2.8 acres. That puts the solar equivalent at roughly 220 to 276 acres.
A US football field including end zones covers about 1.32 acres, so the range is about 167 to 209 fields. This means that Sutton's "~200" is fair on decade-old data, but newer, more efficient panels in a very sunny desert could pull it substantially lower.
If the 10MW is thermal, the comparison falls apart, because turning moderate-temperature geothermal heat into electricity loses most of the energy along the way. For the math to hold, the conversion would have to be electric. This does not change the fact that a 10MW well would be a relative outlier. A simple search shows that a single commercial geothermal production well typically generates 3 to 5 megawatts (MW) of net electrical power.
Fervo Energy, whose Nevada geothermal project for Google TechRadar Pro covered when it came online, provides a sobering benchmark too: its Project Red pilot supported about 3.5 MWe at peak in a 2023 test, but averaged 2.1 MWe gross and roughly 1.4 MWe net across more than 614 production days.
The 100-year claim is not absurd on face value: The same Calpine document above shows that a well drilled in 1955 is still producing at The Geysers today. The field around it tells a more complicated story. In its prime, The Geysers delivered 2GW of power, but productivity declined faster as multiple operators tapped the same connected reservoir, forcing operators to inject extra water to slow the slide.
Calpine, which runs most of the plants there, reported a 2024 maximum of 694 net MW across its share of the field. The field did not run out of heat. It ran short of the fluid and pressure that carry the heat to the surface, which is exactly the kind of maintenance problem that the "if well maintained" caveat quietly covers in the X post.
The "as long as the earth's mantle is hot" line also overreaches. Geothermal wells tap heat in the Earth's crust, which comes from the planet's formation and from radioactive decay, and any single reservoir can be drawn down faster than it recovers. Even large, well-known geothermal regions have hard limits: TechRadar reported earlier this year that the first 100MW phase of Microsoft's planned Kenya data center was already straining Olkaria's geothermal output.
Syntholene's demonstration facility sits at the historic Húsavík power station in northern Iceland, home to a 2MW Kalina-cycle geothermal plant commissioned in 2000 and fed by 120C brine from wells about 20 kilometers south of town. The company finished construction on June 22, about six months ahead of schedule, and the facility makes hydrogen, which the company describes as the principal feedstock for its fuel. It announced its first 500 kilograms of hydrogen on July 7 2026.
Validated but with caveats
Validation of the approach came on October 20 2026, when Syntholene released a review by Professor Nigel Brandon of Imperial College London. It concluded that the plant had achieved proof-of-performance for its geothermally integrated solid oxide electrolyzer, with average stack consumption of 34.90kWh per kilogram of hydrogen, equal to about 95.5% electrical efficiency, and 38.60kWh/kg for the system excluding steam generation.
The release is unusually candid about the limits, and they are significant: Hydrogen output was calculated from electrical current assuming 100% Faradaic efficiency rather than measured with a flow meter.
The efficiency figure excludes thermal inputs, steam generation, and geothermal circulation, so the 95% number omits the heat that makes the design work and cannot be compared directly with conventional electrolyzers. The review relied on company-supplied data and a virtual, not in-person, inspection.
Producing synthetic fuel is another challenge: a hydrocarbon needs carbon as well as hydrogen. Syntholene's website says its carbon feedstock is captured directly from point-source emissions, without naming the source, and Sutton told Proactive that using captured carbon means the company approaches carbon neutrality.
That matters for the "long after crude oil" promise. If the CO2 comes from a fossil-fueled emitter, Syntholene's endless fuel depends on someone still burning fossil fuels. It matters for regulation too. Under EU rules, captured industrial CO2 only counts toward renewable fuel credits if it is built into fuel before 2036 for power plant emissions, or 2041 for other industries. After that, only CO2 from the air or from biogenic and geological sources qualifies.
For now, Syntholene has quickly built a working, geothermally integrated electrolyzer, published its reviewer's caveats and fee, and Sutton's land-use comparison is roughly right if his megawatts are electric.
But "unlimited fuel, forever" describes a plant that simply does not exist yet. The milestones that would make the claim credible are the first synthetic kerosene from its demonstration facility at Húsavík, a named and eligible carbon source, and a binding offtake contract with an attached price.

articles.title: N-able Patches 17 N-central Flaws as Attackers Exploit Earlier Bugs to Deploy Crypto Miners
articles.text:
N-able has released a new security update to address additional critical security flaws impacting N-central.
Describing N-central 2026.4 Hotfix 3 as a critical security update, the company said it includes a number of security patches and fixes that enhance the security of the Remote Monitoring and Management (RMM) and Unified Endpoint Management (UEM) platform.
"HF3 builds on the protections delivered in HF2 and includes further improvements across authentication and access controls, Agent and Probe communications, file handling, server components, legacy APIs, and user management," the company said.
The improvements relate to authentication and access control; Agent, Probe, and appliance security; file and import handling; server hardening; and user management controls. As part of the change, the configuration option for legacy APIs has been completely removed, permanently blocking them.
As of writing, N-able notes that both Remote control functionality and Intune integration are blocked.
Customers running on-premise N-central deployments should upgrade their servers as soon as possible to keep their environments protected. For Hosted N-central servers, no server-side action is required, as the updates are being automatically applied.
"All customers, hosted and on-premise, must upgrade all of their Agents and Probes to the latest version to be fully protected," N-able cautioned. "Agents and Probes that are not upgraded are susceptible to impersonation."
The complete list of vulnerabilities addressed in the update is below -
- CVE-2026-129271 - N-central Patch Management Local Privilege Escalation
- CVE-2026-129272 - MMS3 appliance authentication bypass via predictable passcode
- CVE-2026-129273 - Audit Export syslog injection allows root command execution
- CVE-2026-129274 - ServerMMS2 task result submission missing authentication
- CVE-2026-129275 - repositoryItemGet missing authentication discloses policies
- CVE-2026-129276 - ServerMMS2 asset data submission missing authentication
- CVE-2026-129277 - ServerMMS maintenance action read missing authentication
- CVE-2026-129278 - Take Control audit log tampering without authentication
- CVE-2026-129279 - Password reset response discrepancy allows user enumeration
- CVE-2026-129280 - ServerUI SOAP operations missing authorisation checks
- CVE-2026-129281 - View-only users can set DeviceExecute configuration
- CVE-2026-129282 - Test email sendmail argument injection, missing authorisation
- CVE-2026-129283 - N-central custom service import XML external entity injection
- CVE-2026-129284 - Report Manager and Data Export settings SSRF
- CVE-2026-129285 - XMPP action response origin validation error
- CVE-2026-129286 - SIS GenericFiles version path traversal leads to RCE
- CVE-2026-129287 - SIS repository parser XML external entity injection
The development comes days after N-able began restricting certain N-central features and integrations following the disclosure of a new set of flaws tracked as 4EverAble2Shell and Agent2Shell.
The shortcomings can allow attackers to run arbitrary code as root and gain SYSTEM-level access to Windows systems under specific conditions. Successful exploitation of 4EverAble2Shell hinges on the legacy API mode being enabled. Because the legacy API has been removed from the latest N-central version, it plugs the attack vector.
The 4EverAble2Shell vulnerabilities have since come under active exploitation, with attackers leveraging them to deploy cryptocurrency miners on vulnerable servers.
Independent security researcher Sean Bales, who disclosed the flaws, has published additional details for 24 CVEs, stating "these are patched vulnerabilities and should not work on the latest patch."

articles.title: La SEC abrió una investigación civil a Nvidia tras la salida de Jensen Huang, según The Wall Street Journal
articles.text:
La Comisión de Bolsa y Valores de Estados Unidos (SEC), el regulador de los mercados, abrió una investigación civil sobre Nvidia, informó The Wall Street Journal el 17 de noviembre. Ese día la empresa duplicó sus ventas en su primer balance sin Jensen Huang, y su directorio descartó reponerlo como director ejecutivo.
Axios recogió la información del Journal. Un portavoz de la SEC declinó comentar y Nvidia no respondió de inmediato a la consulta de ese medio. The Guardian precisó que la investigación se refiere a los negocios de la compañía en China, tras la renuncia de Huang.
Los departamentos de Justicia y de Comercio confirmaron el lunes que investigan desde 2024 a Megaspeed, una empresa de Singapur socia de Nvidia, por posibles violaciones a los controles de exportación. Alice Huang dirigió esa compañía y, según CNBC, habría mantenido una relación con Jensen Huang y sería considerada por la inteligencia estadounidense una posible espía china.
El Departamento de Comercio también anunció el lunes un cambio que impediría alquilar chips de Nvidia a empresas chinas. Nvidia sostiene que no tiene pruebas de desvíos físicos de chips. La firma Culper Research, que apuesta a la baja de la acción, estima que el 20% de los ingresos de cómputo del año fiscal 2026 dependió de China.
Ventas duplicadas y una proyección de USD 130.000 millones
Nvidia informó ingresos de USD 115.800 millones en el trimestre cerrado el 25 de octubre. Según el comunicado, subieron 103% frente al mismo período de 2025 y 20% frente al trimestre anterior. La ganancia neta fue de USD 65.300 millones y los analistas consultados por LSEG esperaban ingresos de unos USD 109.100 millones.
El negocio de centros de datos, el más grande de la empresa, facturó USD 107.600 millones, 110% más que un año antes. Nvidia informó que comenzó a enviar Vera Rubin, su nueva plataforma de chips para IA, en lo que describió como el despegue de producto más rápido de su historia.
Para el cuarto trimestre, la empresa proyectó USD 130.000 millones, con un margen de error de 3%, por encima del promedio de USD 125.100 millones que estimaban los analistas, según LSEG. No incluye ingresos por chips de centros de datos vendidos a China. La directora financiera, Colette Kress, elevó además la previsión de crecimiento anual de 70% a 75%, según CNBC.
En el trimestre, Nvidia destinó USD 28.100 millones a recompras de acciones y dividendos. Le quedan unos USD 227.300 millones en su programa de recompras, que el directorio amplió en USD 150.000 millones en septiembre.
El directorio descartó que Huang vuelva a dirigir la empresa
La llamada con inversores empezó con un mensaje del nuevo presidente del directorio, Harvey Jones. Dijo que Huang renunció tras revelar una conducta personal contraria al código de ética de la empresa y que el directorio aceptó por unanimidad su renuncia y “no tiene la intención” de reponerlo. Jones agregó que no se responderían preguntas sobre las circunstancias de la salida.
Horas antes, Huang había publicado su primera declaración desde la renuncia. Reconoció “errores graves” en su vida personal y escribió que sería “un honor” volver si el directorio concluye que es lo mejor para los accionistas, los empleados y el país. Elon Musk pidió ese regreso y el presidente Donald Trump dijo que estaría abierto, según CNBC.
Kress, que dirige la empresa de forma interina, no nombró a Huang en el comunicado. En la sesión de preguntas dijo que en la compañía todo sigue “como siempre”. El directorio creó además un comité de seguridad nacional y controles de exportación y contrató al estudio Wachtell Lipton para investigar la conducta de Huang. Las acciones subieron entre 2% y 3% tras el cierre de la bolsa.
Huang aceptó declarar en diciembre ante comités de la Cámara de Representantes, entre ellos el de Asuntos Exteriores y el de Inteligencia, en entrevistas transcritas, según The Guardian.

articles.title: On connaît aujourd'hui les métiers les plus touchés par l'IA. Le vôtre est-il dans la liste ?
articles.text:
L'intelligence artificielle a un impact réel sur les emplois. Et surtout certains en particulier, que l'on découvre aujourd'hui.
L'intelligence artificielle, avec le boost de productivité qu'elle apporte dans certaines tâches, est un vrai danger pour les emplois dans les prochaines années - malgré les dénégations de certaines grandes personnalités comme Yann Le Cun. Et une nouvelle étude, qui vient de tomber, nous donne les détails de ces premiers dégâts créés par l'explosion de l'intelligence artificielle dans le marché du travail.
Les RH et la comptabilité particulièrement impactés
L'étude de la Coface publiée ce mardi 17 novembre commence à nous montrer la réalité du changement qui commence à avoir lieu dans le monde de l'emploi, à cause de l'intelligence artificielle. Avec notamment la liste des métiers les plus touchés.
Au sommet, ce sont les Ressources humaines qui souffrent le plus, avec un recul des 42,8% des offres d'emplois par rapport à la moyenne des secteurs où les postes de RH sont implantés. Derrière, la comptabilité, le télémarketing, la conception et la R&D (industrie, bâtiment….) sont aussi très touchés.
Il n'y a pas que les profils juniors de touchés
D'une manière plus globale, l'étude montre que l'IA est responsable d'une baisse de 25 000 annonces au troisième trimestre 2026 chez France Travail. La même étude estime par ailleurs que pour un emploi dont les tâches sont automatisables à 10% (et donc exposés à 10% à l'IA), le nombre d'annonces de recrutement chez France Travail a baissé de 12,4% lors de la même période.
Autre enseignement de cet étude, il semble que ce ne soit pas seulement les profils débutants qui aient à craindre l'IA. Car si la réduction des offres d'emploi pour les postes demandant moins d'un an d'expérience a été de 14%, elle a été de 19,4% pour les annonces requérant un à deux ans d'expérience, 14,1% pour deux à quatre ans d'expérience et 16% pour plus de quatre ans d'expérience.
Source : 20minutes

articles.title: Google exec runs Windows 11 on a $1,999 iPhone Duo with Gemini 4 Carbon, but it might not be the easiest way to go about it
articles.text:
Google exec runs Windows 11 on a $1,999 iPhone Duo with Gemini 4 Carbon, but it might not be the easiest way to go about it
Windows 11 now runs on Apple's foldable iPhone Duo
- A Google AI Studio product lead got retail Windows 11 ARM64 running locally on a non-jailbroken iPhone Duo using Gemini 4 Carbon
- The demo landed one day after Google broadly launched Carbon and its swarm agent feature
- The approach needs a Mac, your own Windows image, and a debugger at launch, and a future iOS update could break it
Apple's first foldable phone has been on sale for less than a month, and someone has already turned it into a tiny Windows laptop.
Ammaar Reshi, who leads product and design for Google AI Studio, posted a video on X showing Windows 11 running on his iPhone Duo.
With the phone half-folded, the top screen shows the Windows desktop and the bottom half becomes a keyboard and trackpad; Unfold it and Windows fills the 7.6-inch inner display.
An unfolded pocket PC with a public codebase
The code is public on GitHub as WindowsiOS, with 341 stars and 56 forks as of this writing. It is genuinely impressive systems engineering. One could also view it as a Google product lead showcasing a Google model and a Google coding tool, one day after that model became broadly available, built on open source work, with its own documentation called "foundational".
According to the project's README, WindowsiOS boots retail Windows 11 24H2 ARM64 (build 26100) on a non-jailbroken iPhone Duo running iOS 27, without Apple's Hypervisor framework, which the project says is off-limits to apps on stock iOS.
Instead, it uses a just-in-time binary translator that recompiles ARM64 guest code into ARM64 host code, paired with a software memory management unit. Around that sits an emulated PC-class platform: UEFI firmware, ACPI tables, an NVMe drive, USB 3.0, a VirtIO network adapter, and an Intel HD Audio controller built from scratch so Windows drivers bind without extra installs.
Windows Latest reports Reshi confirmed this is neither Remote Desktop nor cloud streaming, and the video shows Microsoft Edge and Google's own Antigravity IDE running inside Windows on the phone.
Sign up to the TechRadar Pro newsletter to get all the top news, opinion, features and guidance your business needs to succeed!
Windows on an iPhone is not new. In 2024, the Tiny11 developer NTDEV got a stripped-down Windows 11 booting on an iPhone 15 Pro through UTM SE, the PC emulator that Apple approved for the App Store after initially rejecting it.
The difference is that UTM SE has no JIT, so it interprets every guest instruction at runtime, adding a significant speed loss. On iOS 26 and 27 devices, Apple's Trusted Execution Monitor (TXM) tightly polices memory that is both writable and executable, which initially broke the JIT workarounds emulators relied on.
Community tools such as StikDebug now attach a debugger to pre-approve those memory regions, and WindowsiOS's launch script uses the same technique to enable faster boot time and operation.
The detail most coverage has seized on is development speed; when Varun Mohan, who leads Google's Antigravity team, replied, "This is breaking my brain!" and asked how long the agents had run, Reshi answered: "Agents cooked for 2 hours with Swarm!"
That refers to /swarm, a preview feature Google launched on November 10 alongside wider availability of Gemini 4 Carbon, describing it as "turning a single prompt into a coordinated team of agents." The approach is not unlike what current AI incumbents OpenAI and Anthropic offer via their own SDKs to coders.
For more context, Carbon is the second Gemini 4 model after Argon, aimed at long-horizon coding and cybersecurity, and /swarm runs inside Antigravity, Google's agent-first development platform. So the viral exchange, somewhat ironically, is two Googlers discussing a Google feature launched the previous day on a public forum.
The approach, though possible, is intended for a relatively narrow audience and could be patched quickly; Apple has historically been a reluctant observer when it comes to running 3rd-party OSes on its own platforms, even when restrictions are honored.
The documented process requires an Apple Silicon Mac with Xcode and a set of build tools, your own Windows 11 ARM64 image, EDK2 firmware and Red Hat's VirtIO network drivers, an offline provisioning step in WinPE, a roughly 12GB disk image, and a debugger attachment from the Mac at launch. It has been verified on a single device model, and there is no installable app package, meaning some manual tinkering is required.
Windows Latest found the project hard to dislike but judged it as "not a particularly practical idea," and it is hard to argue otherwise, frankly. The more telling story is how fast open-source iOS virtualization has moved in a single week: macOS on an iPhone on November 6, Windows on a foldable iPhone by November 11 2026.
AI agents clearly accelerated the second step, but they did not take the first, which it builds on, and the approach is anything but easy for the average user. Anyone who just wants Windows on an iPhone currently has an official option in Microsoft's Windows App, which streams a cloud PC rather than running one locally.

articles.title: Na era da IA, audiência do Reddit despenca 13% • Tecnoblog
articles.text:
Na era da IA, audiência do Reddit despenca 13%
Fórum é uma das principais fontes de consulta dos modelos de inteligência artificial atuais, inclusive o Gemini, que entrega os resumos na página de busca.
O Reddit é mais uma “vítima” da ausência de cliques por conta dos resumos de IA: o fórum perdeu 13% da audiência no último ano. Apesar disso, em carta enviada para acionistas, a empresa afirma que viu o número de acessos únicos subir 16% no mesmo período.
O site é uma das principais fontes online utilizadas por modelos de IA generativa para gerar suas respostas, assim como outras redes sociais e o Wikipédia. A própria Wiki também já perdeu acessos recentemente, segundo levantamento feito em setembro.
Vale lembrar que o Reddit passou a exigir login após 20 anos aberto. O motivo seria, justamente, a facilidade de acesso do Gemini para extrair dados e gerar seus resumos. A queda registrada pela pesquisa da Similarweb, entretanto, leva em conta um período anterior à nova medida.
Esse número menor de cliques nas páginas do Reddit não chega a ser novidade. Outros sites, sobretudo aqueles que publicam conteúdo escrito, também vêm sofrendo com a IA do Google. A empresa estadunidense, inclusive, já sofreu alguns processos na justiça dos Estados Unidos por utilizar informações de maneira gratuita e sem nenhum retorno para quem as produz.
Até o momento, nenhuma dessas ações levou a uma derrota judicial especificamente relacinada ao tema. Ainda assim, um juiz de Washington reconheceu o prejuizo comercial causado pela prática. Depois disso, o Google chegou a anunciar mudanças na exibição dos seus resumos para dar maior destaque para os links consultados pela IA. De qualquer forma, o conteúdo do Gemini segue sendo priorizado no resultado.
O Reddit é uma das principais fontes de treinamento das IAs generativas atuais. Em 2024, o site fechou um acordo com o Google para licenciar o uso da plataforma, o que levou a um aumento de tráfego de 39% em relação a 2023. A partir do momento em que a empresa passou a priorizar seus resumos de IA na página de resultados, os números caíram, como na baixa atual de 13% em relação a 2025.
A expectativa agora é de uma queda ainda maior por conta da exigência de login, estratégia assumida no último mês pelo Reddit que vai diminuir o número de acessos únicos. Segundo o Business Insider, um porta-voz do site afirmou que os usuários logados são a prioridade.

articles.title: Acer Extends Nitro Series with Two 34-Inch Ultrawide Curved Gaming Monitors
articles.text:
Tuesday, November 17th 2026
Acer Extends Nitro Series with Two 34-Inch Ultrawide Curved Gaming Monitors
Acer has expanded its Nitro gaming monitor lineup with two 34-inch ultrawide curved models: Nitro ED340CKRP and ED340CKRJ. Both use a 1500R VA matte anti-glare panel with Dynamic Frequency and Resolution (DFR). In the 5120 x 2160 mode, the refresh rates are up to 180 Hz on the ED340CKRP and 120 Hz on the ED340CKRJ. In the 2560 x 1080 mode, refresh rates goes up to 360 Hz and 240 Hz, respectively. Both models also support AMD FreeSync Premium. Acer lists typical contrast ratios of 3,300:1 for the ED340CKRP and 3,000:1 for the ED340CKRJ. Brightness is rated at 250 nits, and both displays support HDR10 and 90% DCI-P3 coverage. 
Response times differ between the models. The ED340CKRJ is rated with 1 ms VRB (Visual Response Boost), while the ED340CKRP is listed with 1 ms GTG and 0.5 ms minimum. Connectivity includes two HDMI 2.1 ports, one DisplayPort 1.4 input, and a headphone jack. Both monitors also have built-in 2 W stereo speakers and a tilt-adjustable stand. Acer lists the Nitro ED340CKRP in Japan for ¥99,980 (around $627), and the ED340CKRJ for ¥69,800 (around $438). The company has not provided international pricing or availability.
Sources:
				Hermitage Akihabara, 				Acer Nitro ED340CKRP, 				Nitro ED340CKRJ

articles.title: Google lanzó actualización de noviembre para los Pixel, pero una semana después muchos usuarios aún no la reciben
articles.text:
Google comenzó el 10 de noviembre a distribuir la actualización de funciones de noviembre para sus teléfonos Pixel, pero una semana después buena parte de los usuarios no la tiene o no ve las novedades. Según Android Authority, el despliegue seguirá durante las próximas semanas.
La compañía describió la actualización como un paquete que llega junto con Android 17 QPR2, una versión intermedia del sistema, un mes antes de lo habitual en el calendario trimestral, según el medio. Es compatible con los Pixel 6a y posteriores; los Pixel 6 y 6 Pro quedaron fuera de la lista.
Google informó en su anuncio que las novedades llegan de forma gradual y que algunas dependen del modelo, del país y del idioma. Esa advertencia pesa en esta entrega, porque varias de las funciones más visibles no están disponibles para todos los teléfonos compatibles.
Dictado sin muletillas y widgets creados con IA
La novedad principal es Gemini Intelligence, el conjunto de funciones de inteligencia artificial de Google, que llega a la familia Pixel 10. Incluye Rambler, un dictado por voz que elimina muletillas como los “ejem” y da formato al texto antes de enviarlo, según la empresa.
En el Pixel 10 y el Pixel 11 llega Create My Widget, una herramienta que crea widgets —pequeños paneles de la pantalla de inicio— a partir de una descripción escrita. Google da como ejemplos un seguimiento de gastos mensuales, un panel con los colores de un equipo o una cuenta regresiva de viaje con datos de vuelos y reservas.
El Pixel 11 recibe además una versión de Call Screen, el filtro de llamadas desconocidas, en la que Gemini pregunta de forma conversacional al interlocutor por qué llama y muestra una transcripción en vivo. Google precisó que esta función está disponible en Estados Unidos.
Los Pixel 10 y 11 también incorporan, en versión de prueba pública, la posibilidad de que Gemini haga llamadas a comercios en nombre del usuario, por ejemplo para consultar si hay stock de un producto o reprogramar una cita. Según 9to5Google, esta opción funciona en Estados Unidos.
Otras mejoras llegan a más modelos: nuevos estilos de íconos, búsqueda en el teléfono para los Pixel 6 y posteriores, resúmenes de notificaciones en más idiomas, un módulo de conversión de unidades en la Calculadora y un espacio de ajustes para la familia, según el anuncio de Google.
Una semana después, la mayoría sigue esperando
Android Authority publicó el 16 de noviembre que Google suele lanzar la actualización mensual el primer martes del mes, pero el 3 de noviembre pasó sin novedades. En una encuesta abierta entre sus lectores, con 1.105 votos, el 63% dijo que aún no había recibido la actualización. Es un sondeo sin valor estadístico.
Entre quienes sí la instalaron, el 15% afirmó que le faltan funciones y el 17% que apenas nota cambios. Usuarios citados por el medio en el foro Reddit r/pixel_phones dijeron que no les aparecían los widgets personalizados, el nuevo buscador ni Rambler. Google no informó de una pausa del despliegue, aunque algunos usuarios sospechan que existe.
El medio explicó que muchas funciones dependen de actualizaciones de aplicaciones y de ajustes en los servidores de Google, que se activan por separado del sistema. Además, la aprobación de las operadoras puede demorar la llegada a algunos teléfonos. Tech Advisor, por su parte, recomendó el 13 de noviembre esperar para instalarla por problemas reportados por los primeros usuarios.
Pixel Tag y Google Fi, fuera del sistema
Google también presentó Pixel Tag, un rastreador de objetos que se localiza mediante la red Find Hub de Android. Su venta comenzó el 11 de noviembre a USD 29,99 la unidad o USD 99,99 el paquete de cuatro, y tiene una batería que dura más de un año, según la empresa.
Los Pixel 9 y posteriores con Google Fi, el operador móvil de Google en Estados Unidos, pueden cambiar de forma automática entre dos redes 5G de ese país. La actualización también permite desbloquear un Pixel Watch con el teléfono; esa función llegará en las próximas semanas.

articles.title: Cette appli vous récompense quand vous posez votre téléphone
articles.text:
Dans Island, vous cultivez une ferme en pixels sur une île virtuelle, et plus vous respectez la limite de temps d’écran que vous vous êtes fixée, plus vos récoltes sont abondantes. Les deux créateurs de l’application, passés par l’incubateur américain Y Combinator, ont préféré la récompense au blocage des applications.
La plupart des applications de contrôle du temps d’écran bloquent vos réseaux sociaux une fois la limite dépassée. Selon TechCrunch, Ashish Selvaraj et Ethan Pronev ont choisi de vous récompenser quand vous la respectez, avec Island, lancée en octobre après une phase de tests. Si vous dépassez votre limite, vous pouvez continuer à faire défiler votre fil Instagram, mais une tempête s’abat sur votre île.
Vos récoltes dépendent de votre temps d’écran
Island a tout d’un jeu de ferme. Chaque jour, vous choisissez votre temps d’écran maximal, et chaque fois que vous tenez cet objectif, votre « score de crédit » progresse. Plus ce score est élevé, plus vos champs sont productifs, et vous débloquez de nouvelles cultures et de nouveaux animaux. Avec une ferme, vous subissez les conséquences de vos excès sans « avoir à torturer votre animal de compagnie », plaide Ashish Selvaraj, le PDG d’Island.
Un quart d’heure avant la limite, vous recevez une alerte, et beaucoup de joueurs arrêtent à ce moment-là. D’après la start-up, 82 % d’entre eux posent leur téléphone pile à la limite qu’ils se sont fixée.
Vous pouvez aussi ajouter des amis, visiter leur île et lancer des défis de groupe. Surtout, vous pouvez lier votre île à celle d’un ami, et si l’un de vous deux dépasse sa limite, les deux îles sont touchées.
L’application est gratuite. Avec l’abonnement à 39,99 dollars par an, vous pouvez régler une limite pour chaque application, et plus seulement pour l’ensemble de la journée. Sur votre smartphone, ces limites par application sont gratuites dans Temps d’écran sur iPhone et dans Bien-être numérique sur Android, les outils intégrés par Apple et Google, mais sans ferme à faire prospérer.
Island, né du cinquième changement de cap de ses créateurs
Ashish Selvaraj et son directeur technique, Ethan Pronev, ont fait connaissance à l’université de Waterloo, au Canada. Passés par Jane Street, Citadel, Databricks et Microsoft, ils ont quitté leur poste pour rejoindre Y Combinator, puis ils ont essayé plusieurs idées de logiciels pour les entreprises. « Idée après idée, le produit finissait toujours par être un tableau de bord avec un système un peu différent derrière », se souvient Ashish Selvaraj. « Nous avions l’impression d’avoir quitté nos emplois pour faire une nouvelle variante de ce tableau de bord », ajoute-t-il.
Island est le premier projet qui leur a plu. Les deux fondateurs ont dessiné à la main les décors en pixels de leur île, sans passer par l’IA. « Avec Claude qui devient si bon, j’ai l’impression qu’on a tendance à lui confier chaque tâche », reconnaît Ashish Selvaraj, qui trouve plus de caractère aux dessins faits main.
D’après les chiffres que la start-up a communiqués à TechCrunch, 49 % des personnes inscrites ouvrent encore l’application trente jours après l’avoir installée, et chaque jour, environ la moitié des joueurs actifs du mois lancent Island.
La concurrence est rude. En 2025, les Américains ont propulsé Focus Friend, l’application du vidéaste Hank Green, en tête des téléchargements gratuits de l’App Store. Avec Focus Friend, un petit personnage tricote pendant que vous restez concentré, et vous décorez sa chambre avec les points gagnés. Avec Forest, vous faites grandir un arbre virtuel, qui meurt si vous ouvrez une autre application.
Sur le Play Store, Google n’affiche pour l’instant qu’une dizaine de téléchargements d’Island, et sa fiche est rédigée en anglais. Ses fondateurs n’ont levé aucun fonds en dehors de Y Combinator, et ils comptent faire connaître leur application sur les réseaux sociaux d’ici la fin de l’année.

articles.title: Today I learned your phone's camera exists because NASA wanted smaller cameras for space missions
articles.text:
Today I learned your phone's camera exists because NASA wanted smaller cameras for space missions
Your smartphone camera started life as a NASA space project
Every time you snap a photo on your phone, you're using technology that was designed for deep space. The CMOS image sensor found in almost every smartphone camera was invented at NASA's Jet Propulsion Laboratory (JPL) in the early 1990s, by a team looking for ways to drastically reduce the size of cameras on spacecraft.
Eric Fossum, the engineer who led that team, later said that cell phones became the "killer application" for his invention and he wasn't exaggerating. Yole Group estimates say the CMOS image sensor market hit $25.3 billion in 2025, with mobile devices accounting for roughly 63% of that revenue.
Shrinking a camera for space
In the early 1990s, then-NASA administrator Daniel Goldin pushed a "faster, better, cheaper" approach to space science missions. Smaller payloads meant smaller rockets, which put the cameras on future spacecraft squarely in the crosshairs.
The problem was the charge-coupled device (CCD), the dominant image sensor of the era. CCD cameras were made of many separate parts and drew a lot of power, according to a 2013 presentation by Fossum. They also didn't play well with other electronics, which made it hard to squeeze a whole camera into a smaller package.
Older missions had it even worse. The same presentation notes that the vidicon cameras on NASA's Voyager probes weighed 38.2kg. That's heavier than most checked bags airlines will let you fly with.
Fossum's answer was the CMOS active pixel sensor, built with the same transistor technology found in ordinary computer chips. CMOS imagers had been tried before, but they produced noisy pictures. Fossum's team cut that noise using a technique called intra-pixel charge transfer, according to NASA.
Since every pixel amplifies its own signal, the rest of the camera's electronics can sit on the same piece of silicon. That's why you'll often hear it called a "camera on a chip." JPL says the design needed about one-hundredth of the power of the sensors it replaced.
Sign up to the TechRadar Pro newsletter to get all the top news, opinion, features and guidance your business needs to succeed!
How it ended in your pocket
Not everyone was sold right away. Fossum has said the digital imaging industry and his JPL colleagues were skeptical because earlier CMOS sensors had flopped.
Rather than wait around, Fossum and a group of JPL engineers founded Photobit in 1995 to commercialize the sensor themselves. Its chips ended up in webcams and even a swallowable pill camera before Micron Technology bought the company in 2001. Caltech, which manages JPL, still holds the remaining patent rights, which sensor giants like Sony and Samsung license.
Phone makers caught on fast. Sharp's J-SH04, released in Japan in November 2000, was the first phone with an integrated CMOS image sensor, rated at 110,000 pixels. Your current phone's main camera probably packs a few hundred times that.
Fossum went on to share the 2017 Queen Elizabeth Prize for Engineering for this work. Not bad for an idea that started with NASA trying to save weight on a rocket. The next time someone says taking a decent selfie isn't rocket science, you'll know better.

articles.title: Jensen Huang Will Not Be Reinstated as CEO, Says NVIDIA Board Chief
articles.text:
Tuesday, November 17th 2026
Jensen Huang Will Not Be Reinstated as CEO, Says NVIDIA Board Chief
After much speculation, NVIDIA's leadership situation has finally gained a bit of clarity. Jensen Huang will not be brought back as CEO, according to NVIDIA board chairman Harvey Jones. The remarks were made during NVIDIA's Q3 FY2027 earnings call on Tuesday, merely hours after Jensen Huang said on X that he would be "honored" to return as CEO. However, it looks like the NVIDIA board has different plans, and even though Jensen had plenty of support online and in tech circles, the board seems to be content with his resignation and is only looking forward. Here's what board chair Harvey Jones said at the very start of the earnings call.
Harvey Jones, NVIDIA Board ChairmanOn November 12th, our board of directors announced that after disclosure of personal behavior inconsistent with the company's code of conduct, standards, and cultural norms, Jensen Huang voluntarily resigned his positions as president, CEO, and board member. The NVIDIA board unanimously accepted his resignation and does not intend to reinstate Jensen as CEO... We will not be addressing or taking questions on today's call regarding the circumstances of Jensen's resignation and the ongoing investigation. Our board will communicate further when appropriate.
For a bit of context, Jensen Huang stepped down from his position as CEO on November 12, shortly after the board opened an independent investigation into reports of his relationship with a suspected Chinese intelligence asset. Since then, rumblings of Jensen's return have gathered momentum, and even Huang himself added to the rumors with his X post earlier today. Nonetheless, the NVIDIA board seems to have made its decision and is moving forward without Huang. As for the Q3 financial figures, NVIDIA had another fantastic quarter, posting $115.8 billion in revenue, up 103% year over year and 20% sequentially.

articles.title: Gemini Notebook permite criar sites interativos a partir das suas anotações • Tecnoblog
articles.text:
Gemini Notebook permite criar sites interativos a partir das suas anotações
Novo recurso fica disponível com prompt simples e promete facilitar a vida de estudantes e professores. Apenas usuários maiores de 18 anos podem acessar.
O Gemini Notebook agora permite criar sites interativos com prompt simples diretamente na plataforma de IA. Os links podem ser abertos no navegador e também compartilhados com colegas e alunos, por exemplo. A ferramenta promete facilitar estudos na escola ou universidade, além de ajudar na criação de materiais para estudo.
Para criar, basta inserir “Crie um site…” na caixa de texto, incluindo direcionamentos como tamanho do conteúdo de leitura, imagens a serem adicionadas, tipo de exercícios desejados e mais. Aqui, você pode indicar ainda livros, links de referência e suas próprias anotações para gerar o conteúdo, garantindo a consulta da IA a fontes confiáveis.
O recurso já está disponível no Gemini Notebook para usuários maiores de 18 anos e assinantes do Google Workspace. A empresa promete ainda liberar a novidade no app para celular “em breve”, mas sem muitos detalhes.
A possibilidade de criar sites interativos é interessante para reforçar os estudos. Além dos resumos criados a partir de livros e notas definidos pelo próprio usuário, agora também será possível elaborar questionários com uma base mais confiável.
O prompt é bastante simples: você só precisa indicar as fontes e notas desejadas, pedir para a plataforma criar o site e indicar o estilo desejado para gerar suas questões ou resumos.
Uma vez com o site pronto, você pode pedir ajustes na própria caixa de prompts e até compartilhar com amigos. No meu caso, o site ficou separado em etapas de estudo, resumos sobre a viagem descrita no livro analisado e uma seção de quiz com perguntas de caráter linguístico, conforme o solicitado.
Também é possível utilizar chatbots como o próprio Gemini padrão, o ChatGPT ou o Claude, mas aqui os recursos funcionam tanto para limitar as consultas feitas pela IA quanto para mitigar possíveis erros. Ainda assim, vale lembrar sempre que, por ser uma inteligência artificial, há chance de erro. Portanto, cheque as informações e utilize o máximo de fontes e anotações possível para diminuir a possibilidade de alucinação.
O Gemini Notebook, atual nome do antigo NotebookLM, é um modelo de IA voltado especificamente para ajudar nos estudos. O serviço permite criar resumos detalhados, destrinchar assuntos mais aprofundados, entre outras tarefas que prometem facilitar sua vida na escola ou faculdade. Da mesma forma, é possível utilizar a plataforma para conhecer mais sobre uma área de atuação específica que você deseja aplicar no trabalho, por exemplo, além de reforçar a compreensão de textos e livros.
Outra vantagem do serviço é restringir as fontes utilizadas e, inclusive, utilizar diretamente os seus conteúdos salvos no Google Livros, além de editar PDFs. O direcionemtno pode ser dado no próprio prompt, ao lado esquerdo da tela. Também é possível criar notas, resumos e até conteúdos em áudio ou vídeo para facilitar seus estudos.
