articles.title: Melhor celular Xiaomi em 2026: qual modelo comprar? • Tecnoblog
articles.text:
Melhor celular Xiaomi em 2026: qual modelo comprar?
A Xiaomi vende as linhas de celulares Redmi, Poco e Xiaomi no Brasil; descubra, neste guia do Tecnoblog, qual smartphone da marca é o ideal para o seu dia a dia
Quem procura o melhor celular Xiaomi em 2026 encontra opções para todos os perfis e bolsos, dos modelos mais baratos aos smartphones topo de linha.
A marca oferece linhas bem definidas: a Redmi, conhecida pelo ótimo custo-benefício; a Poco, voltada para quem busca mais desempenho pagando menos; e a linha principal da Xiaomi, que reúne os aparelhos mais avançados em câmeras, tela e performance.
Neste guia, você confere qual é o melhor celular Xiaomi para comprar em 2026, com indicações por categoria, faixa de preço e tipo de uso.
O Poco F9 Ultra é um smartphone premium com performance extremamente avançada. Ele é alimentado pelo chip Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 (3 nm) aliado a 12 GB ou 16 GB de RAM, e ainda conta com o chipset VisionBoost D8 (12 nm) para reforço gráfico durante as jogatinas.
A tela AMOLED de 6,9″ também se destaca, com taxa de atualização de 185 Hz para máxima fluidez em games. Também há um subwoofer independente que deixa jogos e vídeos ainda mais imersivos, com afinação certificada pela Bose.
A bateria grande de 8.050 mAh promete até dois dias de autonomia longe das tomadas. E o celular ainda conta com um kit triplo de câmeras que conseguem gravar em 8K @ 30 fps.
A desvantagem é o preço alto: o smartphone é encontrado na faixa dos R$ 7 mil a R$ 12 mil em lojas online, a depender da versão de armazenamento e RAM.
O Xiaomi 15T Pro aposta em máximo desempenho com um processador MediaTek Dimensity 9400+ construído em litografia de 3 nanômetros. O chip promete alta eficiência energética ao rodar o sistema Android com customização HyperOS 3 em conjunto com 12 GB de memória RAM.
Esse smartphone tem tela de 6,83” com tecnologia AMOLED e taxa de atualização de 144 Hz, para maior fluidez gráfica, além de proteção Gorilla Glass 7i contra riscos e arranhões acidentais.
Já o conjunto de câmeras se destaca pela parceria com a Leica, e traz uma lente periscópica de 50 megapixels para zoom óptico de 5x. O Xiaomi 15T Pro faz vídeos em até 8K @ 30 fps.
O Xiaomi 17T também oferece performance avançada para jogos e tarefas mais exigentes, com o processador MediaTek Dimensity 8500-Ultra (4 nm) e 12 GB de RAM LPDDR5X. E ainda traz 512 GB de armazenamento para comportar seus apps preferidos.
Mas o principal destaque está no kit de câmeras Leica, que grava em até 4K @ 60 fps e inclui uma teleobjetiva de 50 MP com zoom óptico de 5x. Inclusive, as capturas à distância durante o nosso review ficaram excelentes.
Fora isso, o celular conta com uma tela AMOLED de 6,59″ e 120 Hz, além de uma bateria de 6.500 mAh que durou cerca de 48 horas. E o aparelho já pode ser encontrado na casa dos R$ 4.000, que é um preço bem abaixo do preço de lançamento de R$ 8.699,99.
O Xiaomi 15T tem desempenho um pouco inferior do que a versão Pro devido ao chip MediaTek Dimensity 8400 Ultra, construído em 4 nm. Ainda assim, para quem pretende gastar abaixo de R$ 4 mil em um novo celular, ele deve proporcionar uma experiência sem travamentos até com apps mais exigentes, com auxílio da memória RAM de 12 GB.
A tela deste aparelho também é de 6,83 polegadas, mas com taxa de atualização de 120 Hz; e as câmeras também são Leica, mas em vez de uma lente periscópica, o Xiaomi 15T traz uma lente telefoto menos avançada, com zoom óptico de 2x.
Neste modelo, a resolução máxima para gravação de vídeo é de 4K @ 60 fps.
O Poco X8 Pro é o modelo ideal para quem jogar sem pagar o custo de um smartphone premium. O celular é alimentado pelo chip MediaTek Dimensity 8500-Ultra aliado a 8 GB ou 12 GB de RAM e, nos testes do Tecnoblog, o aparelho rodou jogos como Genshin Impact e EA FC 26 sem travamentos.
Para otimizar as jogatinas, o Poco X8 conta com uma tela AMOLED de 6,59″ e 120 Hz, com boa visibilidade em ambientes internos ou externos. Já a bateria de 6.500 mAh pode aguentar um dia inteiro longe das tomadas.
As câmeras são modestas em ambientes iluminados, mas têm limitações em capturas noturnas. E apesar de a câmera traseira gravar em 4K @ 60 fps, a lente de selfie se limita a filmagens em 1080p @ 60 fps.
Ou seja, o Poco X8 Pro se sai muito bem em games, mas pode não ser a melhor opção para quem quer fazer fotos e vídeos de alta qualidade.
O Poco X7 Pro 5G tem o mesmo processador do Xiaomi 15T, o Mediatek Dimensity 8400 Ultra (4 nm), sendo focado em alto desempenho, mas por um preço mais em conta.
Para isso, ele faz alguns cortes de custos em câmeras, trazendo lentes de 50 MP e 8 MP sem zoom óptico e sem a marca Leica. A bateria, no entanto, ganha um upgrade, chegando a 6.000 mAh.
Outro destaque da ficha técnica é a tela AMOLED de 6,67 polegadas com taxa de atualização de 120 Hz, e a proteção IP68 contra água e poeira.
O sucessor do Redmi Note 14 Pro veio com melhorias em bateria, tela, desempenho e resistência, além de manter a câmera principal de 200 megapixels e uma auxiliar de 8 MP (ultrawide).
Focado em durabilidade, o Redmi Note 15 Pro 5G tem certificação IP68+IP69K, que garante proteção com jatos d’água de alta pressão e temperatura, e indica resistência a mergulhos de até 2 metros de profundidade por 30 minutos.
A capacidade de carga é de 6.580 mAh, e a autonomia impressionou nos testes do Tecnoblog, aguentando com folga a um dia intenso longe das tomadas. O celular vem com carregador rápido de 45 W na caixa.
O Poco X8 é tem resistência aprimorada e bateria duradoura como suas principais assinaturas. Ele suporta quedas de até 3 metros e tem proteção total contra água e poeira. Já a bateria de 8.340 mAh de surpreendeu em nossos testes, alcançando uma autonomia de incríveis 59 horas.
A performance, no entanto, não é das mais potentes e o chip Snapdragon 6s Gen 4 (4 nm) é inferior ao Mediatek Dimensity 7300-Ultra visto no modelo antecessor. Ainda assim, o celular aguenta multitarefas e até jogos mais leves, com opções de 6 GB, 8 GB ou 12 GB de RAM LPDDR4X.
O celular ainda conta com uma tela AMOLED ampla de 6,83″ e taxa de atualização de 120 Hz. E traz uma lente de 50 MP (f/1.8) na traseira limitada a filmagens em 1080p @ 30 fps.
Se você quer um celular mais básico para o dia a dia, mas com uma bateria que dure bastante, o Poco C85 5G é o melhor celular da Xiaomi na faixa dos mil reais. O smartphone tem capacidade para 6.000 mAh e suporta carregamento rápido de até 33 W.
A tela tem tecnologia IPS LCD, logo deve entregar cores menos vivas e contrastes menos intensos em relação aos demais modelos da lista. Entretanto, a taxa de atualização de 120 Hz promete trazer a sensação de fluidez gráfica.
A versão vendida oficialmente no Brasil traz NFC para pagamento por aproximação, Bluetooth 5.4 e conector P2 (3,5 mm) para fones de ouvido.
O Redmi 15C também é um smartphone de entrada que foca em entregar boa autonomia de bateria. Inclusive, a bateria de 6.000 mAh pode durar até 82 horas de reprodução de música e ainda suporta carregamento reverso com fio de até 10 W.
No comando do processamento tempos o chip MediaTek Helio G81 Ultra que acompanha 4 GB de RAM. A performance é limitada e o celular é recomendado para tarefas básicas como troca de mensagens no WhatsApp e navegação na internet.
No entanto, ele traz uma tela LCD de 6,9″ com taxa de atualização de até 120 Hz. E pode ser uma boa pedida para orçamentos apertados e usos básicos.
Celulares Xiaomi são conhecidos pelo bom custo-benefício, aliando características premium a preços acessíveis. Em parte, isso se deve ao mercado cinza, já que é comum encontrar modelos muito mais baratos importados ilegalmente em plataformas de comércio eletrônico.
Para evitar problemas com compatibilidade de rede, entre outros riscos referentes à Receita Federal, é importante verificar se o celular Xiaomi é original e comercializado pela DL, distribuidora oficial da marca aqui no Brasil.
A garantia oficial da Xiaomi no Brasil funciona para aparelhos comprados em lojas oficiais, ou pelo site da distribuidora DL Eletrônicos. Produtos importados por outros meios acabam ficando limitados à garantia oferecida pelo vendedor, e podem não ter direito à assistência técnica especializada da Xiaomi no país.
É importante ter a Nota Fiscal e o cartão de garantia com o IMEI do aparelho em mãos ao buscar a garantia do mesmo.
NFC é uma tecnologia para transferência de dados que permite realizar pagamentos por aproximação no celular Xiaomi. Ela também está presente em cartões contactless e maquininhas de pagamento.
É importante observar qual a versão do celular Xiaomi você está comprando, já que modelos destinados a mercados específicos podem não vir com NFC.
A linha Xiaomi tem os celulares mais avançados e caros da marca, incluindo os modelos com processador topo de linha, câmeras Leica e recursos de última geração. Já a linha Redmi engloba celulares intermediários, que podem ter recursos premium, mas focam sobretudo no bom custo-benefício.
O melhor celular Redmi Note vendido oficialmente no Brasil em 2026 é o Redmi Note 15 Pro 5G, que traz alta resistência a quedas, água e poeira, além de câmera de 200 MP, bateria de 6.580 mAh e processador MediaTek Dimensity 7400 Ultra.
O Poco F9 Ultra é o melhor smartphone da linha Poco atualmente. O celular traz o chip Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 (3 nm) com velocidades de até 4,6 GHz e ainda conta com um chip de reforço gráfico para turbinar as jogatinas.
O Poco X8 Pro 5G é um modelo da Xiaomi entre os celulares com melhor custo-benefício em 2026. Ele entrega preço na faixa dos R$ 2,5 mil aliado a bom desempenho em versões com 12 GB de RAM.
As três marcas são as principais em vendas de celulares Android no Brasil, segundo o StatCounter, e avaliar qual é a melhor vai depender das suas necessidades.
No ranking da StatCounter, a Samsung é a marca de smartphones mais popular, enquanto a Motorola ocupa o segundo lugar. Apesar disso, a Xiaomi é vista como uma das marcas que mais cresce na indústria, e ocupa a terceira posição geral na venda de smartphones em todo o mundo.

articles.title: Xreal Aura Review: Android XR combined with lightweight glasses delivers a true next-gen spatial computing experience
articles.text:
Tom's Hardware Verdict
If you can get past the $1,000+ price of entry, the Xreal Aura really ups the ante for low-impact spatial computing.
Reasons to buy
- + Lightweight glasses
- + Powerful Computing Puck adds another form of input
- + Familiar Android XR interface+ Access to the vast Android ecosystem
- + Can be used with Macs, Windows, and SteamOS devices
Reasons to avoid
- - $1,099 starting price might scare off potential customers
Why you can trust Tom's Hardware
Our expert reviewers spend hours testing and comparing products and services so you can choose the best for you. Find out more about how we test.
The world of augmented reality (AR) and extended reality (XR) glasses is really starting to get interesting. This is particularly true of so-called “self-contained” systems that don’t rely solely on your smartphone or tablet to deliver content. The Xreal Aura, which was co-developed with Google, is the latest in the Android XR field, and it’s quite an ambitious project.
Although the Aura looks somewhat similar to previous Xreal glasses that we’ve reviewed, the AR goes a step further with a dedicated puck powered by a Qualcomm Snapdragon Reality Elite SoC, hand/finger tracking, and the ability to interface wirelessly with accessories like keyboards and gamepads. The Aura really promises the ability to leave your smartphone at home and serve as the only computing platform you need (with some caveats).
Design of the Xreal Aura
The Aura’s design is clearly an evolution of the Xreal One Series, but with a few key differences. You’ll find the main changes up front, where you’ll now find two forward-facing, high-precision tracking cameras mounted at the corners of the frame. These cameras are used to continually track your head position, giving you the best possible experience for 6 degrees of freedom tracking for your hands and fingers.
At the center of the frame, there is a fully integrated single high-resolution camera for capturing photos or video. This was previously a separate add-on module for Xreal One Series AR glasses. There’s a red LED that illuminates when you’re recording so that people around you are made well aware of what’s going on if they have objections.
Your primary focal point, however, will be looking through the lenses, which are augmented by dual Sony-manufactured micro-OLED displays. You get one micro-OLED display per eye, each offering 1920 x 1200 resolution, a 120 Hz refresh rate, and maximum brightness of 1,050 nits. However, there’s a major upgrade in the field of view (FoV), as the Aura expands to 70 degrees, up from 57 degrees on the One Pro.
The Aura is available in two SKUs to support the interpupillary distance (IPD) of a wide range of people. The Medium SKU supports people with an IPD of 60 to 66 mm, while the Large SKU ranges from 66 mm to 72 mm.
Given that the Aura is the flagship of Xreal’s AR/XR glasses lineup, it comes with electrochromic dimming for the lenses, which can automatically adjust transparency levels, or you can manually make adjustments (there are five levels of transparency available).
Get Tom's Hardware's best news and in-depth reviews, straight to your inbox.
The arms of the Aura look nearly identical to the ones you find on members of the One Series glasses. On the bottom is a red button, which, when pressed, allows you to manually adjust the brightness levels of the Aura. Directly adjacent is a rocker that allows you to control the volume. There’s another button on the top of the right arm that, when pressed once, takes you to the home menu. Double-pressing the button brings up the capture menu for taking pictures or videos with the forward-facing camera.
Bose-tuned speakers are also built into the arms of the Aura and feature an open-ear design so that you can remain engaged with what’s happening in your environment.
Xreal Aura Specifications
| Display | 1920 x 1200 per eye | 
| Display Type | OLED | 
| Brightness | 1050 nits | 
| Field of View | 70 degrees | 
| Refresh Rate | 120 Hz | 
| Degrees of Freedom | 6 DoF | 
| Audio | Dual open-air speakers | 
| Connectivity | USB-C, Bluetooth 5.3, Wi-Fi 6E, GPS | 
| Weight (Aura glasses) | 3.35 ounces (95 grams) | 
| Weight (Computing Puck) | 9.3 ounces (265 grams) | 
| Battery (Computing Puck) | 4,455 mAh | 
Xreal Aura Computing Puck
Xreal takes a two-pronged approach to hardware with the Aura. At a base level, the Aura is powered by the X1S Spatial Coprocessor, which allows you to experience traditional AR functionality with smartphones, tablets, PCs, and Macs, as you would with previous Xreal glasses.
But the real magic happens with the Xreal Computing Puck, which is a separate device that connects to the Aura using a USB-C cable. The puck looks and feels like a slightly oversized smartphone, albeit without a display. In place of the display, you’ll find a large touch-sensitive surface that can be used to interface with the Android XR interface.
The puck is powered by Qualcomm’s new Snapdragon Reality Elite Platform, which delivers 48 TOPS of AI computing power. It comes in 12GB RAM/256GB storage or 16GB RAM/512GB SKUs — our review unit was spec’d with the former. The puck features a 4,455 mAh battery that powers the glasses, and it even incorporates a fingerprint reader for authentication purposes in Android XR. The puck also fully supports Wi-Fi 6E and Bluetooth 5.3; the latter of which is essential for supporting Bluetooth accessories.
The puck is quite beefy, measuring roughly 5.85 x 2.85 x 0.5 inches and weighing 9.3 ounces. I had no issue just slipping the puck into my pants pocket, but Xreal also includes a detachable clip if you want to attach it to your pants pocket or other clothing. The puck also features a cooling fan to keep temperatures in check. Indeed, the device can get warm to the touch (after all, it’s basically a powerful screenless smartphone with a 4,455 mAh battery) during use – which explains why Xreal includes the clip and probably doesn’t want you putting the puck in your pocket, like I was prone to do.
Xreal Game Controller and Keyboard
My Aura review unit also came with an Xreal Keyboard and an Xreal Game Controller. Both connect to the Aura using Bluetooth and were easily set up by pairing them within the Bluetooth menu under Settings.
The keyboard is battery-powered and is recharged using a USB-C port at the top (just above the F7 key). It’s a nifty design that neatly folds when not in use. Interestingly, I couldn’t find a way to “lock” the hinged part of the keyboard when it’s fully extended. Because of this, you can’t use the keyboard sitting on your lap with your legs spread slightly apart, as the keyboard will simply collapse and fall to the floor if you apply any kind of pressure. You’ll either need to put your legs together or place the keyboard on a desk or table, which isn’t exactly ideal if you like the more “freeing” aspect of using XR glasses.
With that said, the keyboard is a lifesaver when it comes to text entry, be it for entering web addresses, writing emails, or anything that requires frequent use of the keyboard. It sure beats waving your fingers around to input text.
The game controller features an Xbox-style layout with four face buttons for gaming, two thumbsticks, a D-pad, and a Google Gemini/Home button. There are two shoulder buttons at the top and two triggers (with modes to function as microswitch triggers or Hall Effect analog triggers). There are also two remappable macro buttons under the shoulder buttons and two additional macro buttons on the underside of the controller (which can be turned off with physical switches).
View Original
View Original
View Original
View Original
Not only does the controller feature built-in rumble, but it also incorporates a 6-axis gyroscope for aiming and finger controls and a 3.5mm headphone jack built into the bottom of the unit. But perhaps the most interesting feature is a magnetic faceplate that breaks into three pieces. The main piece covers the face buttons, D-pad, and thumbsticks. The other two pieces cover the hand grips. You can purchase separate pieces to customize the look of the controller if you wish.
I found the controller comfortable to use, with a nice textured plastic finish for your palms to rest on (the bottom of the controller features a similar texture, but has a rubber coating over the plastic for better grip). And although the controller is designed for Bluetooth use with the Aura, it does feature a USB-C port and a USB dongle for connecting it wirelessly to a PC.
Another nice touch is that Xreal includes a charging dock for the controller that plugs in with a lengthy USB-A to USB-C cable. The controller itself charges with four pogo pins mounted on top of the dock (or via USB-C if you prefer).
Setting up the Xreal Aura
After removing the Aura from its retail box, I wanted to get into the action quickly and didn’t bother initially charging the puck. I used the included USB-C to USB-C cable to plug from the left arm of the Aura into the dedicated USB-C port on the bottom of the puck. Next, I pressed the power button on the puck, after which the glasses sprang to life and began the setup process.
The setup process first had me perform a few gestures with my fingers to properly set up the viewing window for my eyes. Then, the setup program walked me through pointing, pinch, and drag-and-drop gestures to navigate through the user interface. It was also during this time that I was able to set up my Wi-Fi connection and log in to my Google account. Since I’m an iOS user and rarely, if ever, use Android, I couldn’t speed up setup by logging in with a nearby Android device. So I had to log in to my Google account by pointing and pinching with my fingers to enter my email address and password using the on-screen virtual keyboard. It was a tedious process, but I was eventually able to finish once I completed two-step authentication on my iPhone.
Using the Xreal Aura
After taking some time to get used to dragging and pinching through the Android XR interface using my fingers, the experience began to feel almost natural. I was able to pinch to open apps, have multiple apps open at once, and drag or resize windows in my viewing space on command.
I was able to access all the typical stock apps like Chrome, Gmail, and Google Photos, which, of course, carried over my favorites, emails, and photos/vidoes, respectively. I spent quite a bit of time going down memory lane, watching videos of my two sons when they were toddlers among the hundreds of videos I have stored in Google Photos. It was also great to be navigating around the UI or working in the app, then seeing a notification pop up telling me that an email had arrived. I would then pinch the notification with my fingers to open Gmail.
The possibilities of how you can use the Aura are almost endless, and you can even mix other computing devices into the formula. For example, I was able to plug a USB-C cable from my MacBook Air into the second USB-C port on the puck (that’s usually reserved for recharging the puck). In an instant, my MacBook Air’s display was mirrored onto the glasses in front of me. So I could have Google Docs open as I typed, while having the Android XR native Gmail and YouTube apps flanking the virtual MacBook Air display.
It’s a similar experience with handheld gaming consoles. I was successfully able to connect a Lenovo Legion Go S (SteamOS) and an MSI Claw 8 EX AI+ (Windows 11) to the Aura glasses without issue, enjoying a vast library of games in fully immersive glory.
The native gaming experience isn’t bad either; I loaded up games like Fortnite and spent an hour toiling around in Grand Theft Auto III for a nostalgic treat ahead of the release of Grand Theft Auto VI. The Xreal Game Controller made playing these games a breeze.
But I also used the Aura glasses for more mundane tasks. I was able to walk around the house, performing my usual chores, with a shrunken YouTube window playing videos in the top right corner of my field of view. True multitasking is at hand, folks.
I should note that open-air speakers sounded good, but not great. They sounded similar to the Bose-tuned speakers in the older Xreal One Pro. There's a good level of bass, and overall clarity is good. However, if you want a more immersive audio experience, the design of the Aura allows you to easily throw on a pair of headphones or wireless earbuds to compensate for any audio shortcomings.
Bottom Line
The Xrea Aura is a true workhorse when it comes to spatial computing. By putting the bulk of the computing hardware into a smartphone-shaped Computing Puck, you have a low-impact way of experiencing XR without the hassle of wearing a bulky headset.
You can navigate the user interface using your hands, or the touch service of the puck. And for more specialized tasks, Xreal offers its own-branded keyboard and gamepad accessories (although you are free to use your own Bluetooth-enabled accessories).
Not only do you have access to the vast Android app ecosystem, but you can also connect to devices running Windows, macOS, or even SteamOS.
There’s a lot going on with this device, and there are limitless possibilities for how you could use the Aura. The only problem is that most people don’t have limitless funds, so the $1,099 price tag of our review unit (12GB RAM, 256GB of storage) is sure to give many people pause. Stepping up to 16GB of RAM and 512GB of storage takes the price to $1,299. If you add in the Xreal Keyboard and Xreal Game Controller, the total cost of our review unit comes in at $1,277 ($1,477 for the 16GB/512GB configuration).
That’s a lot to ask for what is essentially a niche device. However, if you want a truly immersive XR experience that is not weighed down by geeky-looking headsets, it’s hard to argue with what Xreal is offering with the Aura.
Brandon Hill is a senior editor at Tom's Hardware. He has written about PC and Mac tech since the late 1990s with bylines at AnandTech, DailyTech, and Hot Hardware. When he is not consuming copious amounts of tech news, he can be found enjoying the NC mountains or the beach with his wife and two sons.

articles.title: Framework Launches Customizable Slim Wireless Touchpad Keyboard With Open-Source CAD Files
articles.text:
Tuesday, November 17th 2026
Framework Launches Customizable Slim Wireless Touchpad Keyboard With Open-Source CAD Files
Framework, the pro-repair laptop company, has officially announced the Framework Wireless Touchpad Keyboard, a compact 75% chiclet keyboard designed for use with devices like the Framework Desktop and its laptops while they're docked in a workstation or couch gaming setup. The Wireless Touchpad Keyboard is currently on pre-order for $99 from Framework's online shop, and two batches have already sold out, with shipping expected to start in Q1 2027. The scissor switches have 1.5 mm of travel and 19 mm key spacing, which is fairly standard key spacing, even among MX-style mechanical keyboards. It has a smoky translucent bottom case and an opaque ABS top case. 
Framework pitches the Wireless Touchpad Keyboard as "a couch keyboard that you want to use," and, it has a number of features that make it stand out from something like the Logitech K400 Plus, which costs just $35. The Framework keyboard, much like the company's laptops, features a serviceable design with a replaceable battery that will be available to consumers via the Framework Marketplace, and it features both 2.4 GHz and Bluetooth wireless connectivity. More importantly to Framework's general audience, who likes to tinker, the Wireless Touchpad Keyboard has ZMK firmware, which is both incredibly efficient and allows for extensive layout customization.Due to the ZMK firmware, Framework claims that the Wireless Touchpad Keyboard should last an entire month on a single charge of the 1,200 mAh battery, and over a year if left in idle mode. The integrated trackpad, measuring in at 85.6 × 68.79 mm, is a portrait-oriented, clickable variant that sits off to the right of the keyboard deck, and it has no physical mouse buttons on the actual trackpad, although it supports Windows Precision and multitouch gestures. Being a keyboard with an integrated pointing device, and given that it measures in at just 118.65 × 357 × 16.9 mm and weighing in at 484.9 g, it should also be ideal for travel use cases.Framework has also published open CAD files for the new keyboard, and it says that it plans to launch a USB Type-A adaptor expansion card, which will allow the USB Type-A dongle of the Wireless Touchpad Keyboard, and other keyboard dongles, to sit flush with Framework laptop cases. Among the aforementioned CAD files, Framework has also published the schematic for the Nordic nRF54LM20A-based control board, allowing users to design their own keyboard layout around Framework's control board, which will also theoretically be sold separately.

articles.title: 800 V et 660 km d'autonomie : la Leapmotor B05 fait un bond de géant… mais pas pour nous !
articles.text:
Fraîchement lancée chez nous, la Leapmotor B05 s’apprête déjà à recevoir des améliorations de circonstance en Chine. La marque a en effet confirmé l’arrivée d’une version optimisée de sa compacte électrique au Salon de l’Automobile de Guangzhou, qui se tiendra le 27 novembre prochain. Outre un équipement enrichi, c’est surtout la technique qui fait un bond de géant, avec l’adoption d’une plateforme 800 V.
Les temps de recharge seront donc logiquement revus à la baisse. Rappelons que le modèle actuel annonce un 10 à 80 % de batterie en 27 minutes grâce à une puissance de charge de 174 kW avec l’accumulateur de 67,1 kWh. Ce n’est déjà pas si mal, les autres modèles du groupe effectuant plutôt le 20 à 80 % en 30 minutes… Aucune information n’a cependant été communiquée sur les nouvelles performances à la borne.
Jusqu’à 660 km d’autonomie : un rayon d’action en nette hausse
On devrait probablement glisser sous les 25 minutes, ce qui renforcera encore l’attractivité du modèle. Passer moins de temps à recharger, c’est bien. Aller plus loin ensuite, c’est encore mieux ! Bonne nouvelle, l’autonomie progressera aussi, avec jusqu’à 660 km sur le cycle CLTC. Cela correspondrait à environ 500 km sur notre norme WLTP, ce qui reste supérieur aux 482 km d’autonomie du modèle actuel.
Côté équipement, cette B05 révisée gagne un affichage tête haute en réalité augmentée, un écran tactile agrandi à 17,3 pouces, des sièges zéro gravité et 14 haut-parleurs. L’habitacle est sinon identique à la version sortante, avec une planche de bord toujours aussi impersonnelle. Et de dehors aussi, la compacte ne change guère. Son design assez standard ne bascule pas outre mesure dans la folie.
Une arrivée en Europe déjà compromise par la stratégie de la marque
Sauf à prendre la version Ultra, qui n’est malheureusement pas disponible chez nous : celle-ci ajoute une lame avant, des jupes latérales, un diffuseur et un aileron plus généreux. La garde au sol a aussi été abaissée d’un petit centimètre. A défaut d’avoir la variante Ultra, avons-nous donc plus de chances de voir cette B05 améliorée arriver en Europe ? Pas vraiment pour des raisons d’ordre stratégique.
Il suffit de voir ce qui s’est passé avec le B10 pour anticiper le même scénario avec la B05. Des responsables voyaient mal remplacer aussi tôt un véhicule fraîchement commercialisé chez nous. Ils évoquent notamment une dynamique d’achat sensiblement différente entre la Chine et l’Europe, où les nouveaux modèles se présentent à intervalles réguliers. Nul doute donc qu’il faudra aussi attendre un cycle de quelques années pour espérer voir une B05 améliorée.

articles.title: OpenAI just launched GPT-6.2, and it's come a long way from writing emails — one developer used it to recreate the whole of Paris as an explorable virtual world
articles.text:
OpenAI just launched GPT-6.2, and it's powerful enough to recreate the whole of Paris as a virtual world you can explore in your browser
The new model walks you around Paris
- OpenAI has just released two new GPT-6.2 models
- GPT-6.2 Astra is for complex projects, and GPT-6.2 Sol is for everyday work
- Both models are for paid subscribers and available today
OpenAI has just released a couple of brand new models to keep us on our toes. The first is GPT-6.2 Astra, designed for complex projects, and the second is GPT-6.2 Sol, designed for everyday work. Both models are available starting today in ChatGPT Work and Codex for Plus, Pro, Enterprise, and Edu users. Additionally, both will be available in the OpenAI API.
You won’t be able to use them from a Free account, and only in Work mode, not Chat mode.
According to OpenAI, both models get better results on demanding tasks while using fewer tokens, which means you’ll get more out of your usage limits. OpenAI reports that on Agents’ Last Exam, GPT-6.2 Astra scored 5.2 points higher than GPT-6 Astra at less than a third of the estimated API cost per task and scored 5.5 points ahead of Claude Fable 5.2 at just 5% of the cost.
To show you what’s possible using the new model, OpenAI developer Thomas Ricouard asked GPT‑6.2 to recreate Paris at full scale so he could walk or drive through it in a browser. The model combined street maps with French survey data on more than 131,000 buildings. Thomas then explored the city and used screenshots to show the model what he wanted to change. You can explore the result yourself in Paris Atlas.
A walk around Paris
I had a play with Paris Atlas, and it takes a while to load, but it is very impressive once it has. You select where on a map of Paris you’d like to walk, and it drops you onto a realistic-looking street, which you can walk around using the arrow keys on your keyboard. 3D models of various well-dressed Parisian residents walk past you on the street, and you can look all around. You actually have to navigate around the people. If you want to get a feeling of what it’s like to walk around Paris, it’s not bad at all.
There’s also another change. For the first time, subscribers to the $200 per month version of ChatGPT Pro will get access to Ultrafast mode when using GPT-6.2 Sol. Ultrafast mode processes requests up to eight times faster than GPT-6 Astra in Standard mode in Codex, and was previously only available to ChatGPT Pro 500 subscribers. Pro 500 subscribers and API developers can use Ultrafast mode with either model. OpenAI says that eligible Enterprise and Edu users can access Ultrafast once their workspace admin enables it.
With the ability to build impressive projects like Paris Atlas, the power of the new models is clearly quite impressive. For most people, the real question is whether any of this will make a difference to the way they use ChatGPT.

articles.title: “Asumo mis errores por completo y estoy comprometido a cooperar con la investigación”: Jensen Huang antiguo CEO de Nvidia
articles.text:
Jensen Huang rompió el silencio tras su salida de Nvidia y abrió la puerta a un posible regreso al cargo de director ejecutivo de la compañía de semiconductores. A través de un mensaje publicado el 17 de noviembre en la red social X, el empresario aseguró que “sería un honor” responder a los pedidos de empleados, inversores y socios comerciales que, según sus palabras, le han pedido que retome las riendas de la firma que fundó.
“Si el Consejo de Administración decide que mi regreso es lo mejor para nuestros accionistas, nuestros empleados, la empresa y Estados Unidos, sería un honor responder a estos llamados y regresar como director ejecutivo”, escribió Huang en su publicación.
El ejecutivo afirmó que, desde su salida, recibió un “aluvión de llamados” de empleados, inversores, socios comerciales y clientes de Nvidia que le pidieron volver mientras la compañía enfrenta “dinámicas tecnológicas, de mercado, competitivas y geopolíticas complejas”.
Huang reconoce “errores graves” y agradece el apoyo recibido
En el mismo mensaje, Huang admitió que “no estuvo a la altura de los estándares esperados de todos en Nvidia” y reconoció haber cometido “errores graves” en su vida personal. “Le creé problemas al Consejo que lamento profundamente. Asumo mis errores por completo y estoy comprometido a cooperar con la investigación independiente del Consejo”, expresó.
El empresario también dedicó parte de su mensaje a agradecer el respaldo recibido durante la última semana. “Me he sentido abrumado por el amor y el apoyo” de amigos, colegas de la industria y personas que nunca ha conocido, escribió.
Huang llegó a Estados Unidos hace 53 años y describió haberse convertido en ciudadano estadounidense como “uno de los mayores regalos y momentos de mayor orgullo” de su vida. Calificó a Nvidia como “el trabajo de su vida” y afirmó que “en ningún otro lugar más que en Estados Unidos” habría sido posible construir una empresa como esa.
El escándalo que derivó en su renuncia
La publicación llega cinco días después de que Huang renunciara a la dirección ejecutiva de Nvidia, según informó el consejo de administración de la empresa el 12 de noviembre. La salida del empresario se produjo luego de que se lo vinculara con una relación sentimental con Alice Huang, exdirectora ejecutiva de Megaspeed, una empresa de centros de datos con sede en Singapur. Ambos comparten apellido, pero no tienen parentesco.
Alice Huang fue señalada por funcionarios estadounidenses, de acuerdo con información publicada por The New York Times, como una presunta espía reclutada por la principal agencia de inteligencia de China. Bloomberg News informó que la mujer reside actualmente en China. Su empresa, además, fue objeto de sospechas por presuntamente ayudar a desviar chips de Nvidia hacia territorio chino, un asunto que la compañía afirmó haber investigado y descartado.
El gobierno de Singapur publicó un comunicado en el que precisó que Alice Huang sí fue investigada en el país, aunque no por espionaje, sino por una pesquisa vinculada a posibles declaraciones falsas en la compra de servidores informáticos que también abarcó a varias empresas, entre ellas Megaspeed. Las autoridades le retiraron el pasaporte en junio de 2025 para impedir que abandonara el país mientras duraban las investigaciones.
En febrero de este año, concluyeron que no existían pruebas suficientes de delitos relacionados con esas declaraciones, aunque determinaron que la mujer “proporcionó información que sabía que era inexacta... con el fin de minimizar su papel en Megaspeed”. Recibió una advertencia severa y una prohibición de ingreso a Singapur; le devolvieron el pasaporte el 26 de febrero y abandonó el país ese mismo día.
El domingo previo a su renuncia, Huang había admitido haberle sido infiel a su esposa y pidió disculpas por haberla lastimado a ella y a sus hijos. Días después, The New York Times publicó que el ejecutivo mantuvo otra relación sentimental con una empleada de su propia compañía. Nvidia ya investiga el vínculo que Huang reconoció públicamente, mientras el FBI realiza sus propias pesquisas sobre el caso.
El consejo de administración de la empresa había señalado previamente que las interacciones de Huang con Alice Huang “no eran inusuales ni inesperadas”, antes de que se conociera la magnitud del escándalo. Tras la publicación de The New York Times el fin de semana del 8 y 9 de noviembre, el directorio inició una investigación externa independiente.
Mientras esa pesquisa avanza, Colette Kress, vicepresidenta ejecutiva y directora financiera de Nvidia, continúa al frente de la compañía de forma interina.

articles.title: Tesla pourrait bientôt fabriquer des Cybercab dans son usine de Berlin
articles.text:
Bientôt des Tesla Cybercabs construits en Europe ? Elon Musk veut agrandir l'usine de Berlin afin d'y fabriquer sa nouvelle voiture autonome.
Tesla va fabriquer ses Cybercabs dans son usine de Grünheide, près de Berlin, à partir de 2029. Le constructeur prévoit d'investir 3 milliards d'euros pour agrandir le site. Cette décision est annoncée quelques jours après l'ouverture des commandes du véhicule autonome biplace à une sélection de clients américains, des commandes assorties d'un abonnement mensuel obligatoire.
Une nouvelle usine en Allemagne pour 2029
Le nouveau bâtiment de Grünheide pourra produire jusqu'à un million de véhicules par an, selon André Thierig, directeur senior de la fabrication pour le site de Tesla, qui l'a annoncé lundi sur LinkedIn.
Le début des travaux est prévu au premier semestre 2027. Parallèlement, Tesla met fin à la production du Cybertruck afin de libérer son usine texane pour le Cybercab.
Un prix d'achat accompagné d'un abonnement
Vendredi, le compte Robotaxi de Tesla sur X a annoncé que certains clients pouvaient désormais acheter le Cybercab pour un usage personnel. Le véhicule est proposé à 29 990 dollars, auxquels s'ajoute un « Autonomy Subscription » obligatoire de 299 dollars par mois.
L'acheteur doit se faire livrer le véhicule dans l'une des cinq villes texanes désignées. Aussi, il ne peut commander qu'une seule voiture et doit verser un acompte de 1 000 dollars non remboursable. Tesla table sur des livraisons en décembre. Le véhicule ne fonctionne que dans les zones de service de son réseau de robotaxis.
Les contrats de commande et d'abonnement, précisent que sans abonnement, la voiture « ne fonctionnera pas ». Les propriétaires ne peuvent pas non plus l'intégrer au service de transport à la demande de Tesla pour en tirer des revenus. Revendre le véhicule sans l'accord de Tesla expose à une pénalité de 50 000 dollars.
Tesla peut par ailleurs racheter la voiture « à tout moment », à une valeur marchande équitable qu'elle fixe elle-même. Le contrat couvre enfin la collecte de données de localisation et des « données d'image de la cabine ».

articles.title: Alphabet’s Isomorphic Labs raises $5B to accelerate drug discovery with AI - SiliconANGLE
articles.text:
Alphabet’s Isomorphic Labs raises $5B to accelerate drug discovery with AI
Isomorphic Labs Ltd. today announced that it has closed a $5 billion investment led by Greenoaks and Sequoia Capital.
The venture capital firms were joined by more than a half-dozen other backers. The group included Isomorphic parent Alphabet Inc., which made a “significant investment.” The search giant provided the capital through its GV and CapitalG startup funds.
Isomorphic offers a software platform called the Isomorphic Labs Drug Design Engine, or IsoDDE for short. It uses artificial intelligence to speed up several of the tasks involved in developing new medicines. The Alphabet unit says that multiple pharmaceutical companies are already using IsoDDE to power drug discovery programs.
Pathogens such as viruses comprise numerous proteins that each power a different biological process. Drugs work by neutralizing a single, particularly important protein without which the pathogen can’t function. Developing a new drug requires researchers to find a vulnerable protein within a pathogen and then develop a compound that can effectively target it.
The first step of the workflow is mapping out the shape of a target protein. Researchers look for so-called binding pockets, recesses on the protein’s surface to which a drug can be attached. The task is highly complicated because proteins don’t have fixed shapes. Their configuration changes when they interact with other molecules or encounter new environmental conditions, which happens often.
Isomorphic says that IsoDDE speeds up the task of finding binding pockets. When there are no such pockets, it helps researchers develop compounds that cause a target protein to form them.
Once scientists identify a binding pocket, they have to find a way of attaching a drug molecule to it. The pharmaceutical industry searches for such binding mechanisms using a method called FEP. FEP algorithms can be highly hardware-intensive, which makes them costly. Moreover, they often require a detailed, three-dimensional model of a target protein.
The process of creating 3D protein models for FEP algorithms is itself a highly complex task. It requires scientists to freeze a target protein in a crystal and scan it using specialized X-ray equipment.
IsoDDE skips that step of the research workflow. Furthermore, Isomorphic says that the software can generate higher-quality output than FEP algorithms.
“Our drug design engine is generating molecules with unprecedented precision and speed,” said Isomorphic Chief Executive Demis Hassabis. “This round enables us to accelerate our progress: building foundational biology models, deepening our systemic disease understanding, and driving our first therapeutic programs towards clinical trials.”
Isomorphic added that it plans to build new bioengineering infrastructure and grow its partner ecosystem.

articles.title: Don't get irrit-AI-ted — new report claims a third of US chatbot users have sworn at or insulted their LLMs
articles.text:
Don't get irrit-AI-ted — new report claims a third of US chatbot users have sworn at or insulted their LLMs
Go prompt yourself
- Anthropic has introduced new policies to prevent abuse of its Claude chatbot
- Bad language directed at chatbots is on the rise, according to research from Searchable
- Chatbots tend to resolve their errors more when users refrain from insulting them, according to the study
If you’ve ever got angry with your preferred AI chatbot, it could be worth rephrasing your angry response to the wrong answer. A report into bad behavior directed against AI tools has found that complaining with bad language or insults is less effective than querying the response with a straightforward statement.
The survey from Searchable found a wholly unsurprising 33% of US-based users swear or insult their chatbot. Compiling the data from an opt-in survey of 8 million messages exchanged with Claude, Gemini, and ChatGPT over 12 months, Searchable also found that residents of Nevada were more likely to insult their AI bots.
Following news of the survey, Anthropic has introduced a new set of usage policies to block cruelty in chats with Claude.
Tolerable behavior
Monitoring of the messaging with chatbots ran between September 2025 and September 2026, with anonymized data and results grouped by age and location. The initial results found that for every 10,000 words in an exchange with an AI chatbot, an average of 19.1 were found to be derogatory. This was where Nevada came out on top, with its score of 22.7 rude or offensive words.
In contrast, New Jersey proved to be the most polite state, with 11.4 words. As far as cities go, what happens in Las Vegas doesn’t necessarily stay there when it comes to bad treatment of AI chatbots. There, 22 swear words or slurs per 10,000 were employed, while New York’s 12.3 words per 10,000 made it the politest city in the US.
The report also highlighted a difference between men and women, age groups, and education levels.
Be civil to the AI
Of course, few people enter into a chatbot discussion with the express intention of causing offense to an LLM (if that was even possible). Rather, the misuse of language and casting aside of civility in this discussions seems to be caused by unsatisfactory results from the chatbots.
Sign up to the TechRadar Pro newsletter to get all the top news, opinion, features and guidance your business needs to succeed!
So, did the bad language have any impact? Well, it seems not.
By following rude exchanges to the end of the conversation, Searchable found that rudeness made the AI chatbot less likely to respond with a desirable result.
“By the end of the conversation, 31% of sweary complaints had been put right,” Content Lead Connor Lahey and Digital PR Lead Sean Fitzsimons wrote, “against 41% of plain corrections, and 35% were still not fixed, against 24%. When a complaint did get fixed, it took about the same number of replies either way.”
The solution, then, is to be nice to your AI chatbot, even when it gets things wrong.

articles.title: Siete medidas para proteger a empresas centroamericanas tras ciberataques operativos en Europa
articles.text:
Un ataque informático contra un equipo de refrigeración puede detener una operación, comprometer mercadería y afectar servicios esenciales. Los incidentes registrados en supermercados europeos durante las últimas semanas, que incluyeron cambios remotos en la temperatura de cámaras frigoríficas, expusieron los riesgos de seguridad que enfrentan los sistemas conectados de las empresas en Centroamérica y el Caribe.
Según la firma de ciberseguridad ESET, una segunda ola de ataques alcanzó el 2 de noviembre a supermercados de siete países europeos, entre ellos Bélgica, Suecia, Irlanda y Países Bajos. Esa misma noche, los atacantes habrían ingresado a través de un proveedor de refrigeración a cámaras frías de un banco de sangre de Francia y modificaron la temperatura programada de −30 °C a 110 °C. Un técnico detectó la anomalía antes de que se produjeran pérdidas.
El episodio muestra que los incidentes digitales pueden ir más allá de la filtración de datos o la interrupción de computadoras. Las fallas de seguridad en sensores, controladores, cámaras, equipos de frío y plataformas de monitoreo remoto pueden generar consecuencias directas sobre procesos físicos, inventarios, cadenas de suministro y servicios destinados a clientes o pacientes.
En la región, la exposición tiene una dimensión particular. El 52.7% de las organizaciones latinoamericanas detectó intentos de ciberataque durante el último año, de acuerdo con el ESET Security Report 2026. A la vez, el 15.4% no pudo confirmar si atravesó un incidente y, entre las compañías que no identificaron ataques, el 25.1% admitió que estos pudieron haber ocurrido sin ser detectados por falta de tecnología suficiente.
Las medidas para reducir los riesgos que deberán tomar en cuenta los negocios:
- Identificar todos los dispositivos conectados: Mantener un inventario actualizado de sensores, cámaras, controladores, sistemas de refrigeración y otros equipos. También conviene precisar quién administra cada dispositivo y qué procesos dependen de su funcionamiento.
- Reducir la exposición directa a Internet: Los sistemas críticos no deberían quedar accesibles desde redes públicas. Cuando se requiera mantenimiento remoto, la conexión debe realizarse mediante mecanismos seguros.
- Gestionar vulnerabilidades y actualizaciones: Actualizar el software y firmware de los equipos conectados, con especial atención sobre aquellos que ya no reciben soporte del fabricante. La explotación de vulnerabilidades estuvo presente en el 29.2% de los incidentes informados en América Latina, según el ESET Security Report 2026.
- Reforzar accesos y credenciales: Eliminar las contraseñas predeterminadas de fábrica, establecer claves únicas y robustas, aplicar autenticación multifactor cuando sea posible y revisar los permisos otorgados a proveedores externos.
- Separar las redes administrativas de las operativas: La segmentación permite limitar la propagación de una intrusión. Los sistemas de correo, facturación o gestión administrativa no deberían compartir el mismo entorno de red con equipos que controlan refrigeración, producción, inventarios o logística.
- Monitorear cambios y comportamientos anómalos: Las compañías deben supervisar accesos remotos, modificaciones en configuraciones y variaciones inesperadas en parámetros operativos, como la temperatura de una cámara de frío. Este seguimiento facilita la detección temprana de un incidente. “Tener visibilidad sobre los dispositivos conectados, corregir vulnerabilidades y monitorear comportamientos anómalos permite detectar un incidente antes de que termine afectando procesos físicos y la operación”, sostuvo Rodrigo Álvarez, especialista en seguridad de ESET Latinoamérica.
- Definir planes de respuesta y continuidad: Es necesario establecer cómo actuará la empresa ante una manipulación o interrupción: quién coordinará la respuesta, cómo se aislarán los equipos comprometidos, qué respaldos de configuración estarán disponibles y cómo se trabajará con los proveedores tecnológicos.
Los datos aislados y las aplicaciones heredadas dificultan una respuesta coordinada
La prevención de ciberataques también depende de la capacidad de las empresas para integrar sus entornos tecnológicos. En Centroamérica y República Dominicana, el 62% de las compañías planea realizar inversiones en tecnología durante 2026, según un estudio de KPMG citado por GBM, empresa regional de tecnología. Pese a ello, solo el 15% considera haber alcanzado una etapa madura de innovación.
Las organizaciones de la región enfrentan aplicaciones heredadas, información distribuida en distintos repositorios y procesos que todavía requieren traslados manuales de datos entre áreas. Esta fragmentación dificulta conocer qué sucede en tiempo real, tanto en una operación comercial como ante una alerta de seguridad.
El 45% de las empresas centroamericanas trabaja con datos aislados y sin una arquitectura centralizada, de acuerdo con KPMG. Esa limitación también afecta el uso de inteligencia artificial, ya que el 46% todavía no identifica con claridad el valor comercial que podría obtener de esa tecnología.
La integración de aplicaciones, datos y procesos permite reducir errores, agilizar la gestión y mejorar la supervisión de los servicios. En materia de seguridad, contar con información conectada ayuda a relacionar alertas, identificar dependencias entre sistemas y medir con mayor rapidez el alcance de una posible intrusión.
Los ciberataques son el principal riesgo de corto plazo para el 61% de las empresas de Centroamérica y República Dominicana, según el sondeo citado por GBM. Frente a ese escenario, las compañías de la región deberán revisar sus equipos conectados, ordenar su infraestructura tecnológica y definir respuestas antes de que una falla digital alcance sus procesos físicos.

articles.title: Nvidia apresenta supercomputador de mesa com 512 GB de RAM • Tecnoblog
articles.text:
Nvidia apresenta supercomputador de mesa com 512 GB de RAM
DGX Spark HPC Developer Kit conecta quatro unidades do DGX Spark e é voltado a aplicações de IA e computação científica.
Resumo IA
- Nvidia apresenta kit que combina quatro DGX Spark, totalizando 512 GB de memória.
- Computadores são conectados diretamente e podem executar modelos de IA com até 700 bilhões de parâmetros.
- Novidade é voltada a pesquisadores e desenvolvedores; preço do conjunto não foi divulgado.
A Nvidia apresentou um supercomputador de mesa que reúne quatro unidades do DGX Spark, totalizando 512 GB de memória RAM. Segundo a empresa, o equipamento foi desenvolvido para pesquisadores, universidades e profissionais que trabalham com inteligência artificial e simulações científicas.
A proposta é permitir a execução de tarefas complexas localmente, sem depender da nuvem. Chamado DGX Spark HPC Developer Kit, o conjunto foi anunciado na segunda-feira (16/11), durante a conferência de supercomputação SC26, realizada em Chicago, nos Estados Unidos.
O novo kit já pode ser adquirido por meio de parceiros comerciais. Empresas como Acer, Asus, Dell, HP, Lenovo e MSI estão entre as fabricantes participantes. A companhia ainda não divulgou o preço do conjunto de quatro máquinas nem informações específicas sobre comercialização no Brasil.
DGX Spark tem quatro máquinas com 128 GB de RAM
O novo kit aproveita o hardware do DGX Spark original, lançado em 2025. Em vez de um computador com 512 GB de RAM, a solução conecta quatro máquinas com 128 GB cada, formando um conjunto capaz de dividir o processamento.
Cada unidade utiliza o GB10 Grace Blackwell, processador desenvolvido pela Nvidia em parceria com a MediaTek. O chip combina uma CPU Arm de 20 núcleos com uma GPU de arquitetura Blackwell, oferecendo desempenho teórico de até 1 petaflop em operações FP4, formato utilizado em aplicações de IA.
A memória LPDDR5X é compartilhada entre CPU e GPU dentro de cada computador. As quatro unidades são interligadas pela tecnologia Nvidia ConnectX-7, mas continuam funcionando como máquinas independentes. Segundo a Nvidia, o conjunto também oferece 20 TB de armazenamento NVMe e permite executar localmente modelos de IA com até 700 bilhões de parâmetros, utilizando o formato NVFP4 para reduzir o consumo de memória.
Kit leva computação de alto desempenho aos laboratórios
Além de modelos de IA, o DGX Spark HPC Developer Kit foi projetado para aplicações de computação de alto desempenho. Entre os exemplos estão simulações de materiais e dinâmica molecular, utilizadas em pesquisas de física, química e biologia. A proposta é permitir que cientistas desenvolvam e testem aplicações em laboratórios antes de executar tarefas mais exigentes em supercomputadores.
A iniciativa amplia as possibilidades de uso do DGX Spark, que já aparece em soluções de IA executadas localmente. A Perplexity utiliza o equipamento como uma das plataformas compatíveis com o Portable Computer, sistema que executa agentes de IA sem depender constantemente da nuvem.

articles.title: Taipei 101 lit up in support of Jensen Huang — skyscraper adorned with messages of support following resignation as Nvidia CEO
articles.text:
Taipei 101 lit up in support of Jensen Huang — skyscraper adorned with messages of support following resignation as Nvidia CEO
Taipei 101 was lit up overnight with messages of support for Huang amid reports that there may be a route back to the Nvidia top job for him.
Following the resignation of Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, a Taiwanese skyscraper became the backdrop for a series of messages in support of the ousted founder, who admitted to having an affair with a woman who has been accused of being a spy for the Chinese government. The U.S. government has since announced a criminal investigation into the company the woman worked for, Megaspeed, over concerns it may have aided in the breaking of export controls related to Nvidia AI chips. Despite that fact, CNA reports that the Taipei 101 building saw messages projected onto its exterior on the night of November 16. The messages included “Taiwan ♡ Jensen,” “Family ♡ Friendship,” and “Thrive Together,” with the driving force likely to be Huang's almost celebrity-like level of fame in the country.
That celebrity status has seen public sympathy for Huang grow within Taiwan, with people within the country's technology industry coming together to fund the project. One technology worker reportedly said that the light show was supposed to “bring back Jensen Huang” and show Taiwan's concern.
That concern may not be needed for too much longer. Recent reports suggest that Huang could be plotting a return to the top job at Nvidia just days after he handed in his resignation. SpaceX CEO Elon Musk and Epic Games CEO Tim Sweeney have already thrown their weight behind the idea of Huang's return to Nvidia. The clamor to force the hand of Nvidia's board has also extended to the White House, with U.S. President Trump also calling for the former CEO to be reinstated. This is despite ongoing uncertainty over whether his love interest was a Chinese spy and, if so, how much Huang may have known about that fact. Trump, however, says that Huang did not put national security at risk.
For its part, it isn't believed that the Nvidia board is seriously considering allowing Huang to pick up where he left off pre-resignation. A source told CNBC that the company is focused on investigating Huang's conduct and a national security investigation and is not discussing his return. That investigation will no doubt also consider reports that Huang had another affair, this time with an Nvidia executive.
For now, Nvidia's former CFO Colette Kress is serving as interim CEO. Kress hasn't had long to settle in ahead of the first big test — the company's first earnings call since the scandal will take place today, November 17.

articles.title: Décevant, le HomeView fait de la publicité aux écrans de Google malgré lui
articles.text:
Certains acheteurs renvoient déjà leur HomeView à cause de bugs de Siri AI, pas encore au niveau. Déçus, les acheteurs se tournent vers le concurrent direct, un écran connecté doté de Google Assistant.
Après avoir largement tardé à entrer sur le marché des écrans connectés, laissant à Google et à Amazon un boulevard devant eux, la marque à la pomme s'est lancée. Mais avec un HomeView vendu pas moins de 299 dollars, le moins que l'on puisse dire, c'est que ce n'est pas vraiment satisfaisant. En effet, de nombreux utilisateurs, fiers de leur nouvel accessoire, l'ont déjà retourné au profit d'un écran connecté concurrent.
Un matériel performant, un logiciel perfectible
Mis en vente le 13 novembre, le HomeView a reçu des éloges pour la qualité matérielle de l'appareil. En revanche, le logiciel qui doit le faire fonctionner semble ne pas être au point. Siri AI, dont l'arrivée tardive aurait retardé le lancement de l'appareil, peine à accomplir les tâches qui font l'intérêt d'un écran connecté : régler un minuteur, lire de la musique ou comprendre des demandes simples.
Sur Reddit, des propriétaires décrivent une expérience qui ressemble davantage à une phase de bêta test qu'autre chose. Certains signalent que la musique se joue sur leur iPhone plutôt que sur le HomeView. D'autres ont dû redémarrer à la fois leur HomeView et leur iPhone pour que le minuteur fonctionne à nouveau.
Les problèmes d'installation sont également à l'origine de retours. Un utilisateur explique avoir renvoyé son appareil après des échecs de configuration répétés, malgré l'intervention du service d'assistance d'Apple. Il indique avoir supprimé son VPN et son profil MDM, essayé un autre point d'accès Wi-Fi et modifié ses réglages domestiques, sans succès. Les problèmes de Siri AI l'ont convaincu de ne même pas attendre une future mise à jour.
D'autres acheteurs saluent le design de l'appareil, mais prévoient eux aussi de le renvoyer, en raison de l'expérience de configuration et du logiciel. Si la marque à la pomme a annoncé une mise à jour du logiciel pour corriger certaines lacunes de Siri AI, cette dernière est très attendue.
Des problèmes similaires chez Google ?
Les utilisateurs de Google Home reconnaissent certaines des critiques que l'on peut faire au HomeView. Certains ont regretté leur mise à jour après avoir effectué le passage de Google Assistant vers Gmini. Cependant, si Google n'est pas non plus un modèle absolu en la matière, le concurrent américain corrige ses failles.
La dernière mise à jour de Google Home améliore les temps de réponse de Gemini pour les minuteries et les alarmes, rend plus fiables les commandes domotiques complexes et corrige des soucis liés aux caméras Nest. Alors, certains utilisateurs voyant les soucis se régler rapidement chez Google, ont tendance à passer chez la concurrence, sans compter le nombre de retours du HomeView.
Source : AndroidAuthority

articles.title: NVIDIA's Canceled RTX 4090 Ti Resurfaces as an Engineering Sample in China
articles.text:
Tuesday, November 17th 2026
NVIDIA's Canceled RTX 4090 Ti Resurfaces as an Engineering Sample in China
A bare PCB that appears to be a GeForce RTX 4090 Ti engineering sample has turned up on Xianyi, which is Alibaba's second-hand marketplace. The listing was shared on X by user 明永, spotted by Videocardz, and it includes a few photos as well as a GPU-Z screenshot of the card. Going through the GPU-Z data, this card apparently has 18,176 CUDA cores, 192 ROPs, and 568 TMUs. That's up from 16,384 CUDA cores, 176 ROPs, and 512 TMUs on the standard retail RTX 4090. There's also a difference in memory configuration, with the "4090 Ti" having 24 GB of Micron GDDR6X VRAM on a 384-bit bus, rated at 24 Gbps, which pushes the bandwidth from 1,008 GB/s to 1,152 GB/s. The clock speeds are 2,340 MHz for the base clock and 2,580 MHz for boost.
Of course, GPU-Z does not recognize the device. The ID is 10DE 2682, compared to 10DE 2684 for the RTX 4090, and the BIOS and driver fields are blurred out. The seller also says that this card only works with an internal NVIDIA driver. What's more interesting is that these specs match the RTX 4090 Ti leaks that were reported in early 2023, which also mentioned a board power of around 600 W. This listing doesn't show the power draw, but the core count and memory configuration do match the leaks. NVIDIA reportedly shelved the RTX 4090 Ti in mid-2023, after months of leaks showing its ridiculous four-slot "cinder block" cooler.There were other "4090 Ti" sightings too before this one. Gamers Nexus got hold of one, but that turned out to be just an RTX 4090 instead. This one does have a GPU-Z readout, but that still doesn't mean it's a verified RTX 4090 Ti engineering sample. However, the core count of this sample is identical to the RTX 6000 Ada workstation card and just shy of the full 18,432-core AD102 die on the TITAN ADA prototype, so that does give the listing some credibility. The card has apparently already sold, but the listing has been kept up for display at a placeholder price of CNY 99,999,999.

articles.title: Plus qu'une montre, un tensiomètre au poignet : notre test complet de la nouvelle Huawei Watch D3
articles.text:
Grâce à son bracelet gonflable, la montre connectée Huawei Watch D3 prend la tension comme un véritable tensiomètre. Mais ce n'est pas son seul atout : elle mesure aussi l'ECG, la fréquence cardiaque, l'oxygénation du sang et même l'arythmie. Et s'il s'agissait de la montre connectée et santé incontournable ?
Le bracelet gonflable est de retour après deux ans d’absence ! Huawei semble avoir une ambition claire : rendre sa Watch D3 attirante pour le grand public afin de la faire sortir de son seul rôle de dispositif médical. Le constructeur chinois a donc revu le design de son boîtier. Plus fin et élégant, il embarque un écran plus grand et lumineux, ainsi que des fonctionnalités santé améliorées. Autant de nouveautés qui ont un prix : la Watch D3 est ainsi lancée à 450 €, soit 50 € de plus que sa grande sœur, la Watch D2.
Nous l'avons dit, la Huawei Watch D3 propose une fonctionnalité quasi exclusive sur le marché grâce à son bracelet gonflable, mais celle-ci semble avoir un revers inattendu : son boîtier n'est pas étanche. Il est donc largement déconseillé de nager avec ou même de se doucher. Huawei indique seulement une certification IP68, équivalente à celle des smartphones, qui autorise une immersion complète dans l'eau (douce et froide) pendant un temps très court. Et c'est bien dommage, car cette Watch D3 se coupe de certains usages proposés par nombre de ses concurrentes.
Autre limite : son bracelet en cuir est fixé par une attache propriétaire. Il faudra donc passer par la boutique du fabricant chinois pour le changer. Heureusement, le besoin ne s'en fait pas sentir immédiatement. En plus d'être assez joli, il a l'avantage d'être à peine plus épais qu'un bracelet classique. Dès lors, on oublie très vite son coussin intégré.
Cette Huawei Watch D3 est par ailleurs particulièrement bien finie. Son boîtier en aluminium se révèle du plus bel effet. Huawei semble également avoir travaillé son design : plus élancé (46,5 x 41 x 11,3 mm), il s'avère aussi moins épais que celui de la Watch D2 (48 x 38 x 13,2 mm). Une performance de miniaturisation qui n'impacte pas le poids, fixé à 40 g et très contenu au regard de la taille de son écran.
L'afficheur (408 x 480 pixels pour une résolution de 328 ppp) a également été revu pour l'occasion. Plus grand (1,92 pouce contre 1,82 sur la Watch D2), il est également deux fois plus lumineux avec 3000 cd/m² annoncés. Il se révèle d'excellente qualité : discret dans l'obscurité, il est capable de rester lisible en plein soleil.
Compatible avec les smartphones iOS et Android, la Watch D3 tourne sous HarmonyOS, le système d'exploitation conçu par Huawei. Elle embarque aussi 64 Go de stockage interne pour installer des apps, télécharger de la musique ou des cartes pour un usage hors ligne.
Cette Watch D3 est très agréable à utiliser. Pour naviguer, il faut utiliser la couronne rotative, le bouton plat et l'écran tactile.
Commençons par la couronne qui sert évidemment à faire défiler les menus, mais pas seulement. Faites-la tourner dans le sens horaire depuis l'écran d'accueil et vous afficherez les notifications. Dans l'autre sens, un volet de raccourcis système s'ouvrira. De là, vous pourrez régler le mode avion, la luminosité de l'écran ou encore accéder aux paramètres.
Ce menu de réglages et les notifications sont également accessibles via le tactile, respectivement par un glissement de doigt de bas en haut et de haut en bas. Cliquez sur la couronne rotative et vous arriverez dans le menu principal de la Watch D3, d'inspiration très californienne. Cliquez à nouveau sur la couronne et vous retournerez sur l'écran d'accueil. Une double pression vous renverra sur la liste des applications ouvertes. De son côté, le bouton plat ouvre le menu de mesure de la tension.
La navigation est également tactile, puisque c'est en tapotant l'écran qu'on sélectionne les options et que l'on revient en arrière d'un glissement de doigt de l'extrémité gauche de l'écran vers le centre. D'ailleurs, le tactile donne accès à deux autres widgets depuis l'accueil : un balayage de gauche à droite affiche le calendrier et la météo, tandis qu'un mouvement inverse ouvre l'historique des mesures de tension artérielle.
Pour lancer la mesure artérielle, rien de plus simple : il suffit de presser le bouton plat et d'appuyer sur Mesurer. La montre indique alors la marche à suivre pour que l'opération soit la plus fiable possible. La prise de tension dure environ 1 min et s'avère assez précise. Sur ce nouveau modèle, il est désormais possible de mesurer sa tension après un exercice physique. La manœuvre se révèle tout aussi simple.
La Watch D3 réalise également un électrocardiogramme et surveille l'arythmie atriale, le sommeil, l'oxygénation du sang ou encore la fréquence cardiaque. Fort de toutes ces données, Huawei propose une sorte de bilan de santé, plutôt complet, qu'il faudra — c'est très important — doubler d'une vérification avec un médecin.
Outre ces fonctionnalités dédiées à la santé, la Watch D3 embarque pas mal de “services citadins”. Ainsi, la montre intégrant un micro et un haut-parleur, on peut donc passer des coups de fil directement depuis son poignet. Le son est alors convenable, que ce soit en émission ou en réception, et la communication s'établit sans problème. La tocante intègre aussi 64 Go de ROM pour stocker de la musique ou des cartes hors ligne, une fonctionnalité taillée pour le trail que nous n'attendions pas forcément sur ce modèle.
Reste l'éternel problème de Huawei : depuis l'embargo étasunien en 2019, le fabricant chinois n'a plus accès aux applications issues des boutiques occidentales. Impossible donc d'installer Spotify, Deezer, Strava ou autres ; il faut faire avec les apps de Huawei qui se contentent des fonctions les plus basiques. Cela limite grandement les possibilités de personnalisation de cette Watch D3. Heureusement, la montre affiche les notifications de façon confortable, notamment grâce à son grand écran, et l'on a même droit aux logos des apps émettrices.
Cette Watch D3 se synchronise avec l'application Huawei Health, qui se découpe en quatre volets principaux. Le premier condense les données mesurées par la montre (calories dépensées, nombre de pas, historique d’exercices, fréquence cardiaque au repos, temps de sommeil ou saturation en oxygène dans le sang). Chacune est détaillée sur des graphiques étalés sur différentes temporalités, de plusieurs jours à plusieurs mois. Le deuxième volet lance un programme de course à pied personnalisé (3 km, 5 km, 10 km, semi-marathon ou marathon). Le troisième réunit divers conseils concernant l'utilisation de la montre. Enfin, le quatrième et dernier regroupe l'ensemble des paramètres : c’est ici que l’on choisit les cadrans, configure les notifications ou règle les alarmes et le suivi de santé.
La Huawei Watch D3 embarque un capteur cardio, un GNSS double bande, un accéléromètre, un gyroscope, une boussole, un baromètre, un capteur de pression, de température, de lumière, ainsi qu'un capteur ECG et un capteur à effet Hall. En revanche, pas d'altimètre dans le lot. Sans surprise, il ne s'agit pas d'une montre taillée pour le trail, malgré la présence de cartes hors ligne.
Son GNSS double bande offre des tracés d'excellente qualité ; il se montre précis et reste pertinent aussi bien en ville que dans un parc.
Côté capteur cardio, nous sommes un peu plus mitigés. Dans l'ensemble, les courbes affichées par la Watch D3 sont très proches de celles du capteur pectoral Polar H10, qui nous sert de référence. Cependant, on remarque parfois des écarts spectaculaires en début de séance. Tout se règle au bout de quelques minutes, heureusement.
Ce constat est identique face à des variations de rythme très rapides (4 x 30 s d'accélération, suivies de 30 s de repos). La montre va parfois s'éloigner des valeurs de la ceinture pectorale, mais elle assure quand cela compte le plus.
Cette Watch D3 étant avant tout pensée pour la santé, elle multiplie donc les fonctionnalités dans ce sens : suivi de la tension artérielle, de l'arythmie, du sommeil et réalisation d'ECG. Malheureusement, comme nous ne disposons pas de laboratoire dédié, nous ne pouvons évaluer avec précision la pertinence de toutes les données recueillies. Cependant, les mesures de tension artérielle s'avèrent assez proches de celles d'un tensiomètre de bras. On regrette simplement une légère surestimation des valeurs — or cela peut être déterminant en cas d'hypertension. La Watch D3 se positionne ainsi comme un dispositif médical ambulatoire et d'appoint, qu'il faudra toujours doubler d'une mesure avec un tensiomètre traditionnel et, bien sûr, d'un suivi médical.
Malgré une utilisation intensive (suivi des notifications, de la fréquence cardiaque, du sommeil et une heure de GPS par jour), notre Watch D3 de test a tenu environs 8 j 6 h. Il faut environ 90 min pour la recharger complètement.
Pari presque réussi pour Huawei qui nous propose une Watch D3 élégante, mais frustrante. Cette montre connectée assure côté hardware avec son GPS double bande et ses huit jours d’autonomie. Et ce n’est pas tout : elle prend la tension, mesure l'ECG et analyse le sommeil. Pourtant, le software souffre toujours d'un vide applicatif criant et de l'absence de paiement au poignet. Heureusement, Huawei multiplie les efforts pour masquer ces lacunes, qui hélas n'échapperont pas à ceux qui aiment personnaliser leur expérience. À noter l'absence d'étanchéité, qui pourrait gêner les nageurs souffrant d’hypertension.
Difficile de placer la Huawei Watch D3 face aux concurrentes habituelles, car la principale raison d'acheter cette montre est son tensiomètre. Il faut donc la comparer à sa grande sœur, la Watch D2. Sur ce duel, c'est le dernier modèle qui l'emporte. Son boîtier, plus élégant et plus fin, rend la montre bien plus agréable au poignet. De plus, les ajustements du côté des mesures sont les bienvenus. Seul point noir : l'absence d'étanchéité, qui pourrait faire pencher la balance dans l'autre sens.

articles.title: En este pueblo asturiano los vecinos se encuentran osos a las puertas de casa: llevan semanas reclamando ayuda
articles.text:
En Villatresmil, parroquia del concejo asturiano de Tineo, anochece temprano y en plena oscuridad ronda por la zona un nuevo inquilino de más de cien kilos. Según 20minutos, los vecinos aseguran que un oso pardo se pasea por las noches entre las casas y que se lo encuentran a las puertas.
Y quizá el oso Yogui era muy gracioso cuando se embadurnaba en miel robada, o Winnie de Pooh no mataría ni a una mosca, pero este oso que ya se ha colado en varios corrales no está haciendo gracia a nadie. Algunos, cuenta el medio, salen con petardos en el bolso para intentar asustarlo (no sirve de mucho). El Ayuntamiento reclama a la Consejería de Medio Rural medidas “urgentes y eficaces”.
Qué ha pasado. Según el Ayuntamiento, el animal lleva días en Villatresmil y pueblos cercanos: ha entrado en una panera, ha recorrido calles, ha dañado alguna vivienda y se ha subido a frutales. La alcaldesa, Montse Fernández, dice que la gente tiene miedo de salir, sobre todo al atardecer. Un vecino contó que el primer día el oso entró en su finca hacia las diez y media de la noche y derribó una colmena sobre el hórreo, y al día siguiente tiró el cobertizo de otra casa.
Las dos versiones del calendario. Para los vecinos, la situación está durando semanas. Pero el Principado tiene el registro del aviso al 112 del 4 de noviembre, no antes. Ese mismo día los agentes de la Patrulla Oso acudieron al pueblo. Hubo vigilancia activa, métodos disuasorios, cámaras de videovigilancia y, el 6 de noviembre, una trampa tipo culvert para capturarlo. Asegura que desde esa fecha no se ha vuelto a ver al animal en el núcleo rural y que no es un oso problemático ni habituado a las personas. Los vecinos, a día de hoy, siguen hablando de un desasosiego generalizado y abandono institucional.
Por qué no se puede “echar”. El oso pardo está catalogado en peligro de extinción en España y en Asturias, y su especie figura en los anexos de la Directiva de Hábitats. La ley del Patrimonio Natural prohíbe dar muerte, dañar, molestar o inquietar adrede a los animales silvestres. El Código Penal castiga matarlos, y la Fiscalía ha pedido 2 años de cárcel para un acusado de matar a un oso con un lazo. Es la pena máxima para estos casos. Asturias dispone además de un plan de recuperación que obliga a mantener una patrulla móvil especializada.
La especie, eso sí, se está recuperando. La población cantábrica se estimó en 370 ejemplares en 2020-2021, frente a los 80-100 de los años noventa, y la Fundación Oso de Asturias cree que ya supera los 400. Y más osos significa más encuentros con pueblos.
El protocolo. Lo que sí existe es un Protocolo para la intervención con osos en la cordillera cantábrica, aprobado en 2019 por las cuatro comunidades y el Ministerio. Primero se vigila y se ahuyenta. Si no basta, se captura al oso con trampas, se le toman muestras y se le coloca un crotal y un collar GPS, para recuperarlo en el mismo sitio o lo más cerca posible si escapa. La captura, según el Principado, es en sí una herramienta de disuasión. Ya en 2025 se reubicaron seis osos habituados a pueblos.
Qué piden unos y otros. La organización URA, que representa a ganaderos, considera que oso y lobo se han recuperado lo suficiente como para revisar los protocolos y permitir más control de la especie; su coordinador habla de ocho ataques en un mes a una misma ganadería de Villatresmil. Fapas replica que el oso sigue siendo frágil (más que el lobo, al menos). Su director honorario, Roberto Hartasánchez, ve un problema de gestión administrativa y no de conservación, y cree que podría capturarse al ejemplar sin cambiar los protocolos.
Los vecinos. Llamar al 112 Asturias es la primera medida. Revisar contenedores, comederos de ganado y frutales, que son su reclamo, la segunda. El Principado, junto a las fundaciones Oso Pardo y Oso de Asturias, ofrece pastores eléctricos para huertas, colmenas y cuadras. Y si hay encuentro, la Fundación Oso Pardo aconseja que el oso te vea y te oiga, pero sin gritar ni correr, y retirarse despacio. Sin embargo, los vecinos de la región no están dispuestos a asumir que un solo viva a su lado.
Cómo lo hacen en otros sitios. En la Columbia Británica canadiense, los osos protagonizan unas 20.000 llamadas al año al Servicio de Agentes de Conservación, y la basura es el principal reclamo. Pero a ver, son animales mucho más grandes en regiones más pobladas. Las autoridades insisten en que reubicar al animal rara vez funciona, porque suele volver o convertirse en problema en otro pueblo. Por eso la apuesta son los programas Bear Smart y las ordenanzas sobre residuos, y los osos ya habituados a la comida humana acaban sacrificados: 2.490 osos negros entre 2015 y 2019.
En Colorado rige la política de “dos aviso”: el oso que se mete en una casa o en un contenedor se captura, se marca con una etiqueta en la oreja y se traslada, y si reincide se le sacrifica. En 2025, 52 osos fueron reubicados y 78 sacrificados, y este año, por la sequía, el sacrificio se ha cuadruplicado hasta casi 300 a finales de agosto. A cambio, la ley estatal castiga ahora a quien deje basura accesible sin esperar a que el oso la toque, con multas de hasta 5.000 dólares en la tercera infracción.
La diferencia con Asturias es de escala y de estatus. Esos osos son negros y se cuentan por decenas de miles; el oso cantábrico apenas alcanza los 400 ejemplares y solo se reubica en casos puntuales. En Rumanía, con unos 11.500 osos frente a los 4.000 de 2007, tienen una ley que prevé abatir 859 al año entre 2026 y 2027, avalada por su Tribunal Constitucional. Pero claro, cuando Eslovaquia anunció que abatiría 350 osos, un eurodiputado español señaló que esa cifra equivale a toda la población de España. No es comparable.
