Source: Harvard University Via: The Verge

articles.title: Rekordquartal und Chefwechsel: Wie es bei Nvidia nach Huangs Rücktritt weitergeht
articles.text:
Rekordquartal und Chefwechsel: Wie es bei Nvidia nach Huangs Rücktritt weitergeht
Der Chip-Riese Nvidia zieht einen Schlussstrich unter die Ära seines einst übermächtigen Chefs Jensen Huang. „Der Verwaltungsrat hat entschieden, dass er Jensen nicht wieder einsetzen wird“, sagte Interimschefin Colette Kress im Sender CNBC.
Huang, der bis zum Rücktritt in der vergangenen Woche das Gesicht von Nvidia war, verkündete wenige Stunden zuvor, dass er ein Rückkehrangebot annehmen würde. Viele Mitarbeiter, Investoren und Geschäftspartner von Nvidia riefen ihn auf, wieder den Chefposten zu übernehmen, erklärte der 63-Jährige.
Bei der Vorlage frischer Quartalszahlen machte Kress deutlich, dass das explosive Wachstum des Nvidia-Geschäfts im KI-Boom auch ohne Huang weitergehen werde. So schraubte sie die Prognose für das Umsatzwachstum im kommenden Geschäftsjahr von 70 auf 75 Prozent hoch. Die Anleger zeigten sich zufrieden: Die Aktie stieg im nachbörslichen US-Handel um mehr als vier Prozent.
Nvidia über Verhalten von Ex-Chef: „Nicht vereinbar“
Huang war vergangene Woche als Nvidia-Chef zurückgetreten. Zuvor wurden zwei außereheliche Affären bekannt. Eine der Frauen war Managerin des Nvidia-Kunden Megaspeed und wird laut Medienberichten von US-Sicherheitskreisen verdächtigt, vom chinesischen Geheimdienst angeworben worden zu sein. Bei der anderen handelte es sich Berichten zufolge um eine Huang unterstellte Top-Managerin von Nvidia.
Verwaltungsratschef Harvey Jones sagte nun, der langjährige Chef habe seinen Rücktritt nach dem Bekanntwerden von Verhalten eingereicht, das „mit dem Verhaltenskodex, den Standards und kulturellen Normen des Unternehmens nicht vereinbar war“, sagte er. „Der Verwaltungsrat nahm seinen Rücktritt einstimmig an und hat nicht vor, Jensen wieder als Chef einzusetzen.“ Es war das erste Mal, dass sich Nvidia zu den Gründen von Huangs Abgang äußerte.
China größeres Problem für Nvidia als Affären?
Inzwischen gibt es auch mehr Fragen dazu, was Nvidia über Lieferungen von KI-Chips nach China wusste. Megaspeed wurde zur Zeit von Huangs Affäre mit der Managerin von Behörden verdächtigt, in Umgehung von US-Verboten Nvidia-Technik nach China weitergeleitet zu haben.
Aus der US-Regierung macht vor allem Finanzminister Scott Bessent nun Druck auf Nvidia, schnell aufzuklären, wer beim Unternehmen wann was wusste. „Haben sie diese scheinbar verbotenen Verkäufe vorangetrieben, um Umsätze und Gewinn hochzutreiben?“, fragte Bessent am Wochenende in einem TV-Interview. Er wolle binnen zehn Tagen Antworten vom Unternehmen.
Anwältin Katie Sweeten, die früher Staatsanwältin in der für Nationale Sicherheit zuständigen Abteilung des US-Justizministeriums war, betonte, dass bewusstes Umgehen solcher Verbote der Regierung schwere Konsequenzen haben könnte. Beteiligten Managern drohten Gefängnisstrafen von bis zu 20 Jahren und einem Unternehmen hohe Strafen, sagte sie bei CNBC.
Ungebremstes Wachstum bei Nvidia
Unter Huangs Führung – er war bis zum Rücktritt der erste und einzige Chef von Nvidia in mehr als 30 Jahren – wurde der Chip-Konzern zum Motor des KI-Booms. Die Firma war ursprünglich auf Grafik-Karten spezialisiert. In den vergangenen Jahren stellte sich aber heraus, dass die Technologie dahinter sich besonders gut für das Training Künstlicher Intelligenz eignet. Chips des Konzerns machte das praktisch unverzichtbar in KI-Rechenzentren.
Im vergangenen Quartal – dem letzten mit Huang an der Spitze – wuchs das Geschäft von Nvidia abermals rasant. Der Umsatz verdoppelte sich im Jahresvergleich auf 115,8 Milliarden Dollar (105,2 Milliarden Euro). Das lag deutlich über den Erwartungen von Analysten, die im Schnitt eher mit 109 Milliarden Dollar gerechnet hatten. Unter dem Strich stieg der Gewinn sprunghaft auf 65,3 Milliarden Dollar – ebenfalls gut doppelt so viel wie vor einem Jahr.
Für das laufende Quartal sagte Nvidia einen Umsatz von 130 Milliarden Dollar vorher, mit der Einschränkung, dass er drei Prozent höher oder niedriger ausfallen könne. Analysten hatten im Schnitt mit 125 Milliarden Dollar gerechnet. Bei 130 Milliarden Dollar wäre es ein Zuwachs von 91 Prozent im Jahresvergleich.
„Bank“ für KI-Branche
Nvidia spielt auch auf andere Weise eine Schlüsselrolle für die KI‑Industrie. Die schnell steigenden Milliardengewinne nutzte der Konzern unter Huangs Regie für Garantien oder Finanzspritzen an zum Teil klamme KI-Start-ups. Ein großer Teil des Geldes landet dann wiederum wieder bei Nvidia über den Kauf von Chips oder Computer-Leistung in Rechenzentren mit Technik des Konzerns.
Eine große Frage nach Huangs Abgang war, ob dieser Kreislauf ohne ihn weitergehen wird. Ohne Nvidia hätten viele sogenannte Neocloud-Anbieter keinen Zugang zum Kapital mehr, warnte der Chef der Finanzfirma Apollo, Marc Rowan, in einem CNBC-Interview.
Die Botschaft von Interimschefin Kress war: Man werde zwar mit Bedacht vorgehen, aber weiterhin diese Rolle für die Branche spielen. Der Investor und langjährige Tech-Analyst Gene Munster frohlockte daraufhin, dass Nvidia als „Bank der KI“ erhalten bleibe. Kress war als langjährige Finanzchefin von Nvidia ebenfalls in die Deals involviert.

articles.title: You can now use your phone’s GPS to track workouts on your Wear OS watch — potentially saving a lot of battery in the process
articles.text:
Wear OS smartwatches just got a big free battery life boost — software update lets you use your Android phone’s GNSS to track workouts
Now your watch can keep going for as long as you do
- The latest Google Play Services update lets you use your phone's GNSS to track your location during Wear OS workouts
- This should save a substantial amount of battery on your smartwatch during runs and other outdoor workouts
- Of course, it means you'll have to take your phone with you
While Wear OS smartwatches generally have enough battery life to get you through a day or more, their tiny batteries can start to struggle a bit during a lengthy outdoor workout — in part because their Global Navigation Satellite System (GNSS) receiver needs to be active. But thanks to the latest Google Play Services update, that’s no longer the case.
As spotted by Android Authority, the latest Google Play Services version (v26.45) adds the ability for your watch to use your phone’s GNSS to track your location during outdoor workouts, thereby helping your watch to conserve its battery life.
Of course, that means you have to bring your phone on your workout with you, and it also only works if your phone isn’t on Battery Saver mode.
Draining one battery or another
It will also drain your phone’s battery, since this will be using GNSS — which covers satellite-based positioning systems such as GPS and Galileo — instead. But phones have much higher-capacity batteries, so using precise location tracking systems on them doesn’t have as much impact as on a smartwatch.
It’s currently unclear whether this update will work with every Wear OS watch or only select models, so you’ll have to see if it works for you once your phone receives the update.
Google Play Services updates are typically installed automatically, but to manually update your phone head to Settings > Google > All services > System services > Google Play services. If there’s an update available you’ll be able to manually apply it from here.

articles.title: Gemini Notebook peut désormais transformer vos projets et cours en sites web interactifs
articles.text:
Gemini Notebook permet dès aujourd’hui à ses utilisateurs de transformer leurs sources de recherche, leurs notes ou tout autre corpus documentaire en un site web interactif. L’objectif est double : faciliter la gestion de projets et mieux comprendre des sujets complexes. Cette fonctionnalité est disponible dès maintenant auprès des utilisateurs web.
Gemini Notebook vous permet dorénavant de transformer des sources en site web
Pour bénéficier de cette fonctionnalité, il suffit de taper dans le chat « créez-moi un site » et de décrire ses besoins et les spécificités du futur site, en fonction de son corpus de sources. À titre d’exemple, l’utilisateur peut créer des présentations visuelles explicatives, des tableaux de bord interactifs, des lignes du temps, des tableaux périodiques interactifs ou encore des outils de suivi détaillant des tâches à effectuer et des échéances à respecter.
Il s’agit donc d’un outil qui s’adresse aussi bien aux étudiants qu’aux professionnels. Les étudiants peuvent ainsi transformer un cours complexe en site interactif et didactique, tandis que les professionnels peuvent, par exemple, créer un site web entièrement dédié au suivi d’un projet ou aux performances de vente d’un trimestre, simplement en donnant quelques indications à Gemini Notebook.
Une fois le site terminé, il est par ailleurs possible de l’ouvrir dans un nouvel onglet afin de l’utiliser indépendamment de Gemini Notebook. L’utilisateur peut également partager le site qu’il a créé avec d’autres personnes.
Une disponibilité sur le web, mais pas encore sur mobile
Cette nouvelle fonctionnalité est déployée mondialement dès aujourd’hui auprès des utilisateurs web de Gemini Notebook, y compris pour les abonnés à Google Workspace. Google précise que cette fonctionnalité arrivera également sur la version mobile, mais sans donner de date de disponibilité. Pour accéder à cette fonctionnalité, il ne faut donc pas cliquer sur un bouton ou télécharger une extension : le simple prompt « créez-moi un site » suffit. Auparavant, créer un site demandait de sérieuses compétences et connaissances. Aujourd’hui, quelques mots suffisent à transformer un cours ou un projet complexe en site web complet et interactif.

articles.title: Nvidia says its open source AI strategy remains intact after Jensen Huang's exit | TechCrunch
articles.text:
Nvidia interim CEO Colette Kress reaffirmed the company’s commitment to open source AI during Tuesday’s earnings call with analysts — the first since CEO Jensen Huang’s resignation.
“At Nvidia, we are committed to fostering a vibrant open model ecosystem, so every country, company, and industry can build its own intelligence,” Kress said in her opening remarks. She also noted that open models were accelerating AI adoption, citing a 35-fold year-over-year surge in weekly token volume on OpenRouter, including a 3.5-fold increase over the past three months.
Kress also spoke about Nvidia’s plans for Hugging Face, a platform for open source AI models that the company agreed to acquire for $12.9 billion in September, in what would be the second-largest acquisition in Nvidia’s history.
The platform, which serves more than 18 million developers and 200,000 companies, is still on track to join Nvidia, despite Huang’s ouster. Huang had heavily advocated for open source AI technology. His departure had raised questions about the company’s future approach to open source AI models, with Hugging Face’s CEO calling Huang’s departure “a sad day,” and promising to “keep fighting for open-source AI, harder than ever.”
So far, Nvidia’s plans for Hugging Face appear unchanged. The acquisition was not directly addressed during the Q&A portion of the earnings call.
“Together, we will scale its platform and make intelligence more open, more capable, and more accessible,” said Kress of Nvidia’s plans for Hugging Face.
Last week, Nvidia founder Huang resigned from his position as CEO following news about his extramarital affairs, including one with Alice Huang, an executive at the Singapore-based company Megaspeed who is suspected of being a Chinese spy. He’s also accused of having extramarital affairs with two direct reports and is now set to testify before Congress by Thanksgiving. Meanwhile, the SEC is investigating Nvidia over whether the company’s disclosures misled investors, The WSJ reported.
Within Nvidia, Huang pushed for the development of the Nemotron family of open-weight AI models built for long-running agentic AI systems and reasoning workloads. On today’s call, Kress noted that Nemotron is now the “most widely used U.S. open model on OpenRouter,” and it’s “where developers start to build their own intelligence.”
“That foundation is empowering the ecosystem,” she said.
Correction: Due to a typo, an earlier version of this article incorrectly stated the number of developers served by Hugging Face; it is 18 million, not 118 million.

articles.title: Kensington Launches the Expert Mouse Pro TB900 EQ Trackball

Kensington Launches the Expert Mouse Pro TB900 EQ Trackball
Kensington, a worldwide leader in desktop computing and mobility solutions for IT, business, and home office professionals, today announced the launch of Expert Mouse Pro TB900 EQ Trackball, a wired and wireless trackball designed for engineers, editors, and creative professionals who need precise cursor control and customizable navigation.The TB900 combines Kensington's DIAMONDEYE dual-sensor optical tracking system with a large 55 mm trackball and polling rates up to 1 kHz for smooth, accurate cursor movement with less hand and wrist motion compared to traditional mice. Designed for precision-intensive applications including CAD, video editing, audio production, graphic design, and professional computing, the advanced dual-sensor system maximizes tracking coverage and enables highly accurate cursor control from nearly the entire surface of the ball.
Users can connect up to four devices at once using two Bluetooth channels, one 2.4 GHz wireless connection, or wired USB-C. The TB900 supports quick switching between connected computers and tablets without re-pairing.Additional features include an adjustable aluminium scroll ring, dual side-scroll controls for horizontal scrolling and zooming, and support for up to 16 programmable functions using Kensington Konnect software. The TB900 also includes access to Avid Pro Tools Intro+ for audio production workflows.
Key Features and Benefits

articles.title: Xiaomi 18 Pro : un deuxième écran pour détourner les regards d'Apple et Samsung
articles.text:
Avec leurs deux capteurs photo Leica de 200 mégapixels, leurs puces Qualcomm en 2 nm et leurs batteries généreuses, les Xiaomi 18 Pro et Pro Max visent le très haut de gamme. Une ambition qui se retrouve dans leurs prix, vraiment élevés. Trop ?
À 1 600 euros en 256 Go, le Xiaomi 18 Pro Max arrive à seulement 30 euros de l’iPhone 18 Pro Max. Le fabricant assume donc de jouer dans la même cour qu’Apple avec sa nouvelle gamme, commercialisée en France ce 17 novembre. Accompagné d’un Xiaomi 18 Pro plus compact, le grand modèle compte séduire les habitués des iPhone et des Galaxy avec un équipement photo ambitieux et une particularité bien visible : son écran arrière.
Un écran arrière qui ne sert pas qu’aux selfies
Retourner son téléphone pour se photographier avec les modules principaux devient plus pratique lorsqu’on peut garder un œil sur le cadrage photo. C’est le premier intérêt de cette dalle LTPO, dont le rafraîchissement varie de 1 à 120 Hz. Elle sert aussi de retour vidéo pour se filmer seul, mais Xiaomi lui confie d’autres tâches comme afficher les notifications, présenter une carte d’embarquement ou, encore, montrer une traduction en temps réel, via intelligence artificielle, à la personne en face de soi.
Le système d'exploitation maison, HyperOS 4, pousse la personnalisation jusqu’à proposer la création de mini-applications à partir d’une simple description de ce que l’on souhaite obtenir. Il faudra toutefois tenir compte des langues et des régions prises en charge pour profiter des fonctions d’IA annoncées.
Doté de bords ultra fins (0,99 mm), l’écran principal a lui aussi sa nouveauté à défendre. Sur le Pro de 6,4 pouces (16,4 cm de diagonale) comme sur le Pro Max de 6,9 pouces (17,5 cm), un mode « anti-curieux » matériel réduit la visibilité latérale. Une fois ce mode activé, seuls les pixels à angle de vision étroit restent allumés, ce qui réduit la visibilité de côté. Le principe est le même que sur le Samsung Galaxy S26 Ultra.
Deux capteurs de 200 Mpx sous la signature Leica
L’écran au dos du téléphone accompagne un module photo qui réunit, sur les deux modèles, un capteur principal de 200 mégapixels (Mpx) au format 1/1,28 pouce et un objectif ouvrant à f/1,67. Le téléobjectif périscopique reprend cette définition de 200 Mpx avec, lui, un capteur de 1/1,56 pouce. Sur le Pro Max, Xiaomi revendique en outre une dynamique de 16,2 EV, censée préserver davantage de détails dans les ombres et les hautes lumières. À voir ce que ça donne en test.
Les amateurs de vidéos disposent d'une captation 8K à 30 images/s et 4K Dolby Vision à 120 images/s ainsi que d’un mode Log 10 bits pour travailler l’étalonnage. De quoi donner une utilité concrète au retour vidéo dans le dos du téléphone.
Le Pro Max se réserve la plus grosse batterie
Le choix du format détermine aussi celui de la puce. Le Xiaomi 18 Pro embarque un processeur Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 alors que le Pro Max intègre un Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6, tous deux annoncés avec une gravure en 2 nm. Pour évacuer la chaleur sur le grand modèle, Xiaomi relie la puce à la chambre à vapeur par un chemin thermique en cuivre.
Le Pro Max accueille également une batterie silicium-carbone de 7 050 mAh, contre 6 000 mAh pour le Pro. À titre de comparaison, le Galaxy S26 Ultra s’en tient à 5 000 mAh. L’écart de capacité est conséquent. À voir quelle sera la réelle différence d'autonomie en pratique. Côté recharge, le Pro Max accepte jusqu’à 100 watts en filaire et le Pro jusqu’à 90W. Ce qui est tout simplement énorme au regard des standards du moment. Cerise sur le gâteau, tous deux sont compatibles avec la charge rapide sans fil à… 50 watts !
Jusqu’au 3 janvier, le stockage double sans bouger le prix des téléphones
Les deux smartphones disposent de 12 Go de mémoire vive et se déclinent en quatre coloris (noir, blanc, bleu et un élégant bordeaux) ainsi que deux capacités de stockage, aux tarifs conseillés suivants :
| Modèle | 256 Go | 512 Go | 
| Xiaomi 18 Pro | 1 399€ | 1 599€ | 
| Xiaomi 18 Pro Max | 1 599€ | 1 799€ | 
Jusqu'au 3 janvier prochain, Xiaomi propose toutefois les versions de 512 Go au prix des 256 Go. Un bonus de 100 euros est également prévu en cas de reprise.
Cette offre rend les Xiaomi 18 Pro et Pro Max plus séduisants au lancement. Mais malgré leurs nombreuses qualités, Xiaomi prend un risque en jouant désormais dans la même cour tarifaire qu’Apple et Samsung.

articles.title: Vivo negocia compra da Vero por cerca de R$ 6,3 bilhões • Tecnoblog
articles.text:
Vivo negocia compra da Vero por cerca de R$ 6,3 bilhões
Segundo o jornal espanhol Expansión, operação é avaliada em 1 bilhão de euros. Aquisição pode adicionar 1,2 milhão de clientes de banda larga à base da Vivo.
A Telefônica Brasil, dona da Vivo, negocia a compra da provedora de internet Vero em uma operação avaliada em cerca de 1 bilhão de euros (R$ 6,3 bilhões, em conversão direta). Segundo apuração do jornal espanhol Expansión, as conversas com os acionistas da empresa giram em torno desse valor.
As negociações envolveriam principalmente a Vinci Partners e a Warburg Pincus, gestoras que controlam aproximadamente 60% da Vero. A primeira detém cerca de 37,5% das ações, enquanto o fundo americano possui outros 22,5%. As informações sobre a possibilidade de compra começaram a circular no mês passado.
A Vero é a sexta maior provedora de banda larga fixa do Brasil, com aproximadamente 1,2 milhão de clientes. A empresa atende 425 municípios em sete estados: Rio Grande do Sul, Santa Catarina, Paraná, São Paulo, Minas Gerais, Mato Grosso do Sul e Goiás. Sua infraestrutura alcança cerca de 7,2 milhões de domicílios.
A aquisição reforçaria principalmente a atuação da Vivo no Sul e no Sudeste. Segundo dados do ranking das maiores operadoras de banda larga, a Telefônica Brasil tinha aproximadamente 8,5 milhões de acessos de internet fixa em agosto de 2026. Com a incorporação da base da Vero, chegaria a cerca de 9,8 milhões, ainda atrás da Claro, que contabilizava 10,8 milhões.
Além da fibra, a Vero atua como operadora móvel virtual (MVNO), utilizando a infraestrutura da TIM para oferecer planos de celular. A companhia encerrou setembro com aproximadamente 420 mil clientes móveis, crescimento de 56,4% em um ano.
A possível venda ocorre em um momento de resultados mistos para a provedora brasileira. No terceiro trimestre de 2026, a Vero registrou prejuízo líquido de R$ 3,7 milhões, revertendo o lucro de R$ 12,2 milhões obtido no mesmo período do ano anterior, segundo o Teletime.
A receita líquida caiu 3,3% na comparação anual, para R$ 419,8 milhões. A base de banda larga também recuou 5,6%, enquanto o negócio de telefonia móvel apresentou o crescimento expressivo.
Para a Telefônica, a aquisição poderia acelerar a expansão da Vivo em cidades onde a operadora ainda tem menor presença, além de ampliar sua infraestrutura e carteira de clientes. Até o momento, porém, as empresas não anunciaram um acordo definitivo nem divulgaram um cronograma para concluir as negociações. O valor atribuído à operação também não foi confirmado oficialmente pela Telefônica Brasil.

articles.title: Arista takes aim at the next AI network battleground: distributed inference - SiliconANGLE
articles.text:
Arista takes aim at the next AI network battleground: distributed inference
Awareness of the network’s role in artificial intelligence has steadily increased, with much of the focus on the back end – larger clusters, faster ports and scale-across fabrics that stitch graphics processing units together across data centers. Arista Networks Inc. has seen continued, accelerated growth and has been one of the biggest winners of that buildout.
This week at SC26, Arista announced a shift in focus to the other side of the network. The company also announced a new set of Etherlink R4 routing platforms designed for what it calls distributed inferencing, along with a pluggable optical line system for data center interconnect. The lineup includes:
- 7020R4 and 7020HR4: Compact 1RU access routers with 25G to 400G ports, deep buffers and optional wire-speed encryption on every port. The HR4 versions are temperature-hardened and add advanced timing for cell sites and outside plant.
- 7282R4: A fixed-edge and core router with dual supervisors for control-plane redundancy.
- 7280R4: A 25.6 terabit “in-betweener” with 64 400G ports, half supporting ZR/ZR+ coherent optics, to bridge local fabrics to the wide area network.
- Pluggable optical line system: A full C-band amplifier carrying 25.6 Tbps over a single fiber pair, plus muxes and a pluggable fiber tester.
All are based on Broadcom’s Jericho and Qumran silicon, designed to deliver up to 60% lower power consumption than competing 7-nanometer and 16-nanometer platforms. Everything is available now, except the 7020HR4, which ships in early 2027. The speeds and feeds always make headlines, but the implications of the launch point to where AI infrastructure is heading.
Inference is about to get distributed
During a pre-briefing, Brendan Gibbs, Arista’s assistant vice president of product line management, argued that the forces driving training across multiple sites will have the same effect on inference. Gibbs also said that roughly 30% of Arista’s AI business is now scale-across, indicating that distributed AI is rapidly becoming commonplace.
Inference will be distributed for three reinforcing reasons:
- Latency. A centralized cluster works well for a chatbot that streams text line by line. It doesn’t work for agentic AI, where a single request can trigger dozens of chained model calls and every millisecond compounds.
- Sovereignty. Regulators increasingly want inference requests and data to stay within national borders. European IT leaders have little appetite for sending data to U.S. cloud providers.
- Power and space. Companies will deploy inference wherever they have capacity, and the network must support it.
The implication is that the front-end network, long treated as plumbing, now needs back-end attributes: deep buffers, traffic engineering, multi-tenancy, and encryption, because traffic now leaves the building.
Arista is going downmarket
This launch is the opposite of the descriptors we typically associate with Arista. Recent announcements focused on dense 800G, 1.6T, and liquid cooling. The products launched at SC26 are smaller and less expensive. Arista dominates big iron and is now rounding out its portfolio. Arista’s customers range from hyperscalers to neoclouds to enterprises building local AI. The front end needs rich features, not massive bandwidth, and Arista hasn’t had a viable option for that tier until now.
These routers are designed as entry-level but ship with 400G uplinks, which may seem like overkill today but offer investment protection. Gibbs said the goal is a 10-year life cycle, with customers swapping optics rather than chassis. No one knows what agents will do to traffic volumes, and I suspect companies that consider this overkill today will think differently in three or four years. Headroom is cheaper than a forklift upgrade at a remote site. Also notable: Arista co-designed the 7280R4 with a hyperscaler seeking a gray-to-coherent bridge, a sign that it’s building with its biggest customers.
The service provider wildcard
The most intriguing product is the hardened 7020HR4, built for 5G and AI-RAN cell sites. Telcos have largely sat out the AI buildout, yet they own the last mile and real estate near users, exactly what low-latency inference requires. This gives a carrier the backbone to offer a managed AI factory.
My view is that this performs better outside the U.S., where enterprises don’t trust carriers beyond connectivity. In Europe and Asia-Pacific, managed services are far more common, and providers such as BT, NTT and Telstra have the footprint to make it work. With sovereignty requirements, the opportunity for telcos to move up the stack has never been better. Telcos have never been a core market for Arista, so any growth from that audience is additive to its already massive market.
Quality and security are the quiet differentiators
Since 2019, Arista has reported a far lower CVE count than competitors, even after the surge in AI-assisted discovery following Anthropic’s Mythos. I’m skeptical of CVE comparisons because counts depend on testing rigor, installed base and reporting practices, and some vendors now bundle multiple issues into a single CVE.
The more relevant benefit is operational. Customers often don’t apply patches because upgrades cause downtime and break things. If they trust the software, they patch faster, and the risk window shrinks. With Mythos accelerating the retirement of end-of-support gear, quality and longevity become buying criteria, not nice-to-haves.
On the call, Gibbs agreed it’s hard to draw conclusions from CVE counts but explained that CVE counts were a measure of Arista’s software quality. This has been Arista’s calling card since it was a startup. While CVEs provide one metric, the bigger proof point is its historical track record of quality software.
Also, wire-speed MACsec and IPsec on every port is a differentiator because AI brings different security requirements. However, integrated security does not replace firewalls. I asked Gibbs about this, and he said that Arista has no intention of replacing firewalls and expects Palo Alto Networks Inc. to continue to sit behind it in the line. I’d like to see that formalized into validated designs for distributed inference, like what Nvidia Corp.-validated designs did for the back end.
The optical line system is a similar simplification play. Arista isn’t an optical company and is reselling these products, but offering dark fiber customers a turnkey, EOS-integrated way to move 25.6 Tbps across a metro network removes a real headache.
Customers have responded positively to Arista’s entry into this market. Douglas Fast Net Chief Technology Officer Jon Vradenburg said the company needs “a compact platform that supports the services our business and carrier customers rely on.” Takayuki Sakou of Japan’s STNet cited “higher throughput and improved power efficiency while maintaining the quality of the EOS software we trust.”
Considerations for network professionals
- Map where inference will run, not just where it runs today. If your AI roadmap includes agents, assume that latency and sovereignty will push inference closer to users, and plan the front end accordingly.
- Treat the front end as part of the AI fabric. Evaluate buffering, traffic engineering, and multi-tenancy at the WAN edge with the same rigor you apply to GPU clusters.
- Make encryption the default. Inference traffic between sites carries prompts and proprietary data. Line-rate encryption should be table stakes.
- Buy for longevity. Prioritize platforms with uplink headroom, modern silicon and a software track record that lets you patch without fear.
Final thoughts
The back end of AI networking is largely a solved architecture at this point. The front end is not, and that’s where the next round of competition will play out. With R4, Arista is betting that its routing credibility, built quietly within hyperscaler backbones, can make it the default there as well. Given how much traffic agentic AI is likely to generate, that’s a bet that, like most Arista bets, will likely pay off.
Zeus Kerravala is a principal analyst at ZK Research, a division of Kerravala Consulting. He wrote this article for SiliconANGLE.

articles.title: Apple tendría estos 18 productos listos para el año 2027: iPhone 20, gafas inteligentes y hasta robots
articles.text:
Apple prepararía hasta 18 productos nuevos para 2027, un despliegue que coincidiría con el 20 aniversario del iPhone. Entre ellos figurarían el iPhone 20 Pro, las primeras gafas inteligentes de la compañía y un robot doméstico, según el periodista Mark Gurman, de Bloomberg, y otras fuentes cercanas a la empresa.
El calendario de lanzamientos de 2026 ya cerró con el iPhone Duo, el centro de control doméstico HomeView y los MacBook Pro con pantalla táctil PROLED XDR. El año próximo, según las filtraciones, Apple repartirá sus novedades en dos ventanas: primavera y otoño.
Los nuevos iPhone del 20 aniversario
En primavera llegarían los modelos más accesibles. El iPhone 18 y el iPhone 18e compartirían el chip A20, 9 gigabytes de memoria RAM y mayor autonomía de batería. A ellos se sumaría el iPhone Air 2, con chip A20 Pro, una cámara ultra gran angular adicional, una Dynamic Island más pequeña y el módem C2 con soporte mmWave en Estados Unidos, que ofrecería velocidades de subida más rápidas que el C1X actual.
La ventana de otoño sería la más relevante por coincidir con el aniversario del primer iPhone. Apple presentaría el iPhone 20 Pro y el iPhone 20 Pro Max, ambos con chip A21 Pro y un diseño con vidrio curvado en todos los bordes y esquinas, además de marcos más delgados alrededor de la pantalla.
Junto a ellos debutaría el iPhone Duo 2, la segunda generación del plegable. Apple ya habría probado en prototipos la incorporación de Face ID a la pantalla exterior del dispositivo, aunque el plazo para cerrar esa función en la versión final de consumo es ajustado.
También se evalúa que el botón Control de Cámara funcione además como botón de Acción, dado el poco uso que los usuarios le dan a la función de cámara.
iPad, Mac y Apple Watch con nuevos chips
El iPad Pro sumaría los chips M6 o M7 y, por primera vez, un sistema de refrigeración por cámara de vapor. El iPad Air dejaría atrás los paneles LCD para pasar a pantalla OLED en sus dos tamaños, con chip M5, un diseño más delgado y la función Acoustic Display, ya presente en el iPad mini. El iPad de entrada incorporaría el chip A19 con soporte para Apple Intelligence, el chip N1 con Wi-Fi 7 y el módem C1X de bajo consumo en los modelos celulares.
En la línea Mac, el MacBook Neo de segunda generación sumaría el chip A19 Pro, 12 gigabytes de RAM y nuevas opciones de color. El MacBook Air pasaría al chip M6, mientras que el MacBook Pro de 14 pulgadas recibiría el chip M7 y, según las filtraciones, podría incorporar una Dynamic Island y un logo de Apple iluminado. La variante con pantalla táctil PROLED XDR llegaría con chips M7 Pro y M7 Max.
El Apple Watch Series 13 tendría un rediseño que incluiría un nuevo sistema de acople magnético para las correas. También se prepararía un Apple Watch Ultra 5, aunque con menos detalles confirmados hasta el momento.
Gafas inteligentes y la apuesta por Siri AI
En 2027 llegarían las primeras gafas inteligentes de Apple, con nombre en código N50. A diferencia de dispositivos de realidad aumentada como el Vision Pro, no proyectarán imágenes sobre la visión del usuario: dentro de la compañía se las describe como “AirPods para la cara”. Incluirán micrófonos, altavoces y cámaras de baja resolución, y dependerán de un iPhone reciente para funcionar, sin compatibilidad con Android.
El eje central del dispositivo será Siri AI, la función que permite controlar aplicaciones mediante comandos de voz sin necesidad de abrirlas.
La compañía ve en esta estrategia una ventaja frente al asistente Muse de Meta, al apoyarse en su ecosistema de App Store.
Los prototipos internos ejecutan una versión reducida de visionOS 28 sobre un procesador derivado de chips antiguos de Apple Watch, e incorporan Wi-Fi propio para mantener ciertas funciones activas sin el iPhone cerca.
AirPods con cámara, HomeView Max y el futuro del hogar inteligente
En paralelo, Apple prepara unos AirPods Pro con cámaras integradas, previstos también para fines de 2027. Incorporarían sensores ópticos infrarrojos o cámaras pequeñas que permitirían a Siri identificar el entorno sin necesidad de sacar el teléfono del bolsillo.
A esta familia de dispositivos con Visual Intelligence se sumaría el HomeView Max, una versión ampliada del centro de control doméstico lanzado este año. Contaría con una pantalla de 9 pulgadas capaz de girar 360 grados sobre un brazo robótico motorizado que seguiría al usuario por la casa.

articles.title: Emerging cryptographic requirements and the transition to quantum-resistant security
articles.text:
Emerging cryptographic requirements and the transition to quantum-resistant security
Encryption forms the backbone of our everyday digital lives including banking transactions, healthcare and communication. However, the rise of quantum computing is challenging our assumptions about how long certain types of security will remain effective.
Imagine a scenario where confidential information that was encrypted and sent years ago is suddenly able to be decrypted. The security systems worked as intended, the information was exchanged, the encryption algorithms were considered secure and there was no evidence of a breach. However, advances in computing have made that formerly secure information vulnerable. This is a concern that is driving the discussion about quantum resistant security.
We use encryption to secure almost every aspect of our digital lives. From banking transactions and healthcare data to industrial communications and defence systems, the encryption algorithms we use to secure sensitive information have been trusted for decades. However, the rise of quantum computing is challenging our assumptions about how long certain types of security will remain effective.
While quantum computers that can crack popular public-key cryptography aren't currently available, the possibility of this is an important consideration for organisations that need to ensure long term security of data.
Understanding the threat of quantum
Cybersecurity as we know it today relies on different types of cryptography for different purposes. We use Advanced Encryption Standard (AES) algorithms to secure data. We use public-key cryptography like RSA and elliptic curve cryptography (ECC) for securing key establishment, authentication and digital signatures.
Quantum computing presents different challenges to these cryptographic systems. With Shor's algorithm, a sufficiently powerful quantum computer could potentially solve the mathematical problems behind RSA and ECC, thus compromising systems that rely on these cryptographic systems.
With Grover's algorithm, we have the theoretical speed up for searching for keys in symmetric encryption. For AES-256, this reduces the theoretical security margin against brute force attacks, however, this doesn't make AES-256 practically breakable with current quantum computing. This is important because we need to know what types of cryptographic systems are most at risk before we can determine what we need to change.
Another concern is that attackers could potentially collect encrypted information today, and hold on to it for decryption in the future. This approach is called harvest now, decrypt later, and it poses risks for information that must be secure for many years. Sensitive defence communications, financial data, intellectual property may remain valuable for a long time after the initial transmission.
Why existing infrastructure makes the transition difficult
While replacing an encryption algorithm may seem like a simple task, the digital infrastructure we use today consists of multiple interconnected systems with different security needs.
For example, imagine an industrial facility with hundreds of connected sensors, controllers and communication devices. Some of these devices may have been installed years ago, and may remain in use for another decade. Others may have limited processing power, memory or network connectivity.We need to consider carefully when introducing new cryptographic mechanisms to these systems.
With post-quantum cryptographic algorithms we may need larger keys, signatures, or more processing compared to current public-key cryptographic mechanisms. These differences can impact communication bandwidth, memory usage and processing performance. For real-time devices, any changes in computational requirements may impact the system design.
Thus, we need to consider the entire security architecture. This includes device authentication, key management, communication protocols and hardware compatibility. It's not just about updating software to make it quantum resistant.
What do emerging cryptographic standards mean?
We are starting to see the shift towards post-quantum cryptography. The US National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) finalised three post-quantum cryptographic standards in August 2024. These are: ML-KEM for key establishment, and ML-DSA and SLH-DSA for digital signatures.
These standards provide organisations with defined cryptographic mechanisms designed to resist attacks from both conventional and quantum computers. However, implementing these standards isn't just a matter of replacing cryptographic algorithms.
We need to identify vulnerable cryptography that we use, understand how encryption keys are generated and exchanged, and consider whether existing systems can support the requirements. Alternative approaches like out-of-band key distribution, and quantum key distribution are also being explored. These approaches offer different security properties, but come with practical considerations such as infrastructure, cost, scalability and interoperability.
There's no one size fits all approach that meets all operational requirements. The right architecture depends on the sensitivity of the information, devices involved and environment where communication occurs.
Building cryptographic agility into security systems
One of the most important things organisations can do to prepare is to build cryptographic agility. This involves designing systems that can adapt to changes in cryptographic algorithms and protocols without major infrastructure changes.
● Firstly, organisations need to understand their cryptographic dependencies. What cryptographic algorithms are being used? Where are the keys being stored? How are devices authenticated? What systems may be challenging to update?
● Secondly, prioritise. Systems protecting sensitive long-lived information, or systems in critical infrastructure may need earlier planning for migration.
Using hybrid cryptographic approaches (using both existing classical mechanisms and post-quantum cryptographic algorithms) can help in managing the transition while still being compatible during the migration process.
For connected and embedded systems, security should also be considered when designing hardware and software. Devices that are expected to be in use for many years should support secure updates and be adaptable to changing cryptographic mechanisms where technically possible.
Preparing before the threat becomes imminent
Transitioning to quantum resistant security will be a gradual process. With existing infrastructure, operational constraints and evolving standards, organisations will need to carefully plan for migration strategies.
This is especially challenging for sectors like banking, telecommunications, manufacturing and defence, where we often have sensitive information and connected infrastructure with long operational lifecycles.
We don't need quantum computing to be an imminent threat to start preparing. Information encrypted today may need to be secure for decades. Systems deployed today may be in use long after the cryptographic requirements have changed.
The focus should be on understanding our current vulnerabilities, considering emerging standards and building systems that can adapt to the changing landscape of cryptographic technology.
The future of cybersecurity will be as much about being able to update and maintain trusted security as it is about the strength of the encryption algorithms we use.
~ By Srinivas Shekar, Co-Founder and CEO, Pantherun Technologies

articles.title: La ciencia quiere jubilar el IMC como medida de la obesidad. Pero sustituirlo por una cinta métrica tampoco es tan sencillo
articles.text:
Durante mucho tiempo, para determinar si una persona tenía obesidad o no, se ha usado el cálculo del IMC, dividiendo el peso en kilos por el cuadrado de la altura en metros. Sin embargo, son muchas las voces que han ido surgiendo en contra de ceñirse únicamente a esta medida, apostando más por el perímetro de la cintura o por un conjunto de datos interrelacionados.
Viene de lejos. La recomendación no es una ocurrencia divulgativa, sino el reflejo directo de un macroestudio publicado en la revista Nature. Un trabajo que supone un nuevo paradigma para redefinir la obesidad, puesto que, tras analizar datos de 844.108 adultos, se ha visto qué ocurre cuando se cruza el clásico índice de masa corporal con el perímetro de la cintura y el índice cintura-talla.
El resultado confirma que el IMC, utilizado en solitario, sobrestimaba la obesidad en entre un 1,2 % y un 3,1 % de los participantes, pero lo más preocupante es que deja escapar entre un 5,2 % y un 8,6 % de los casos reales de exceso de grasa.
¿Por qué pasa? El problema del IMC es matemático y anatómico, puesto que en su concepción nunca fue diseñado para evaluar el estado de salud de una persona en concreto. Y es que la fórmula es ciega a la composición corporal, ya que no distingue si un kilo extra corresponde a masa muscular, tejido óseo o grasa, ni tampoco revela dónde se almacena esa grasa.
Desde el punto de vista fisiopatológico, la diferencia es bastante importante porque la grasa subcutánea no es tan "mala" si la comparamos con la grasa visceral que se infiltra en el abdomen y en el hígado, que sí dispara la inflamación crónica o la resistencia a la insulina.
Se ha ido estudiando. La ciencia lleva más de 15 años acumulando pruebas de esta ceguera individual y ya en 2010 un metaanálisis evaluó el rendimiento del punto de corte de IMC de 30 que marca la obesidad. Aquí lo que se vio es que este índice pasaba por alto a más de la mitad de las personas con un exceso real de grasa corporal.
Se desmorona. Ante todas estas pruebas que hemos recopilado, las instituciones médicas han empezado a desmontar el monopolio del IMC, aunque no sin problemas. En junio de 2023, la AMA aprobó una política oficial reconociendo las severas limitaciones que tiene el IMC e instando a usar los indicadores de grasa visceral, composición corporal, masa grasa relativa o el perímetro de cintura.
El paso más ambicioso llegó en 2025 cuando un artículo publicado por The Lancet Diabetes & Endocrinology apuntó a la necesidad de jubilar el IMC como criterio diagnóstico aislado, ya que para diagnosticar obesidad es necesario medir directamente la grasa corporal total, combinar el IMC con al menos una medida antropométrica adicional o cumplir dos criterios antropométricos independientemente del peso.
El segundo cambio consiste en dividir la condición en dos categorías: obesidad preclínica, cuando existe exceso de grasa pero los órganos y tejidos funcionan con normalidad, y obesidad clínica, cuando esa adiposidad ya está provocando alteraciones funcionales o enfermedades crónicas.
La cinta métrica tampoco. Si el IMC resulta insuficiente, la tentación inmediata en consulta y en casa es sustituirlo por una simple cinta métrica alrededor del abdomen. Pero la evidencia fisiológica recuerda que el perímetro de la cintura tiene sus propias limitaciones técnicas y dista de ser una medida perfecta de la grasa peligrosa.
El primer problema es que una cinta métrica rodea todo el contorno abdominal sin poder distinguir qué parte del volumen corresponde a grasa visceral, que está alojada en profundidad entre las vísceras, y qué parte es simple grasa subcutánea situada justo bajo la piel. Dicho de otro modo, medir la cintura sigue siendo, en gran medida, un reflejo de la grasa subcutánea abdominal más que una ventana directa al tejido adiposo metabólicamente tóxico.
Otro problema. Hay que tener en cuenta que tampoco existe un protocolo anatómico universalmente aceptado para colocar la cinta. Mientras unas guías indican medir en el punto medio entre la última costilla y la cresta ilíaca, otras toman como referencia el ombligo, la parte más estrecha del torso o el borde superior de la cresta ilíaca.
Y esto es importante, puesto que, según el punto anatómico elegido, la proporción de personas clasificadas con perímetro de cintura elevado fluctúa entre un 10 % y un 20 % en mujeres y entre un 6 % y un 10 % en hombres, y en todos los puntos analizados la medición sigue correlacionando mejor con la grasa subcutánea que con la visceral.

articles.title: Attention à ce GTA 6 qui circule avant la sortie du jeu : c’est un piège pour voler vos données
articles.text:
Le jeu le plus attendu de la décennie, GTA VI, débarque ce jeudi sur PS5 et Xbox Series. Un événement mondial pour les joueurs…et les cybercriminels qui tentent de profiter de leur impatience. Spécialiste en sécurité, Avast alerte sur l’existence d’une campagne qui promet de télécharger la version complète du jeu avant tout le monde, et gratuitement.
Une offre évidemment trop belle pour être vraie. À la place du jeu de Rockstar, les victimes récupèrent un logiciel malveillant.
Un PDF, un faux site et une fausse page Google Drive
Comme à chaque lancement très attendu, ce type de piège se dévoile. Avast explique que l’arnaque commence par un document PDF soigné, présenté comme un « guide de téléchargement » de GTA 6, qui reprend les informations officielles sur le jeu, ses personnages et sa date de sortie pour paraître crédible. Un gros bouton « Download now » renvoie vers un site baptisé Getallsoft (ou Getarsoft ou dans le PDF), qui se présente comme une plateforme de téléchargement de logiciels et affirme que GTA 6 y est « disponible en téléchargement gratuit ». En cliquant de nouveau, l’internaute atterrit sur une page imitant Google Drive, qui héberge une archive ZIP de plus de 700 Mo censée contenir le jeu.
Une fois lancé, le contenu de l’archive installe en réalité un infostealer. Ce type de malware est conçu pour aspirer discrètement les données stockées sur l’ordinateur, comme les identifiants et mots de passe enregistrés dans le navigateur, les cookies de session ou encore des informations bancaires, qui sont ensuite revendues ou exploitées par les pirates. Avast avait déjà repéré, il y a quelques semaines, plus de 200 noms de domaine liés à GTA 6 créés en seulement 24 heures. Près de 10 % présentaient un risque élevé ou moyen, à base de fausses précommandes, de sites imitant les boutiques de Rockstar ou de PlayStation, ainsi que de faux jeux-concours.
Il n’existe aucune version PC de GTA 6
Pour éviter de tomber dans le piège, un détail suffit pourtant. GTA 6 ne sortira jeudi que sur PlayStation 5 et Xbox Series X|S, et Rockstar n’a annoncé aucune version PC à ce jour. Un fichier ZIP à installer sur un ordinateur ne peut donc pas contenir le jeu. Même sur console, le téléchargement passe exclusivement par le PlayStation Store ou le Microsoft Store, y compris pour les versions vendues en boîte. Rappelons que ces dernières ne contiennent qu’un code. Enfin, le jeu pèse plus de 200 Go, bien loin des 700 Mo de l’archive proposée par les escrocs.
